p_2023_schwettmann_multimodal_neurons_in.title: Multimodal Neurons in Pretrained Text-Only Transformers
p_2023_schwettmann_multimodal_neurons_in.venue: 2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision Workshops (ICCVW)

abstract.en: Language models demonstrate remarkable capacity to generalize representations learned in one modality to downstream tasks in other modalities. Can we trace this ability to individual neurons? We study the case where a frozen text transformer is augmented with vision using a self-supervised visual encoder and a single linear projection learned on an image-to-text task. Outputs of the projection layer are not immediately decodable into language describing image content; instead, we find that translation between modalities occurs deeper within the transformer. We introduce a procedure for identifying "multimodal neurons" that convert visual representations into corresponding text, and decoding the concepts they inject into the model’s residual stream. In a series of experiments, we show that multimodal neurons operate on specific visual concepts across inputs, and have a systematic causal effect on image captioning. Project page: mmns.csail.mit.edu
abstract.zh: 语言模型展现出显著能力，可以把在一种模态上学习到的表征泛化到其他模态的下游任务。我们能否把这种能力追踪到单个神经元？本文研究这样一种情形：使用自监督视觉编码器和一个在图像到文本任务上学习的线性投影，为冻结的文本 Transformer 增加视觉能力。投影层的输出无法立即被解码成描述图像内容的语言；相反，我们发现模态之间的转换发生在 Transformer 内部更深的位置。我们提出一种方法，用于识别把视觉表征转换成对应文本的“多模态神经元”，并解码它们注入模型残差流的概念。通过一系列实验，我们表明，多模态神经元能够跨输入处理特定视觉概念，并对图像描述任务产生系统性的因果影响。项目页面：mmns.csail.mit.edu。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks where image semantics are converted into language when a separately trained vision encoder is connected to a frozen text-only Transformer by one learned linear adapter. It distinguishes immediate translation by the adapter from conversion by individual multilayer-perceptron neurons inside the language model, and tests whether those neurons causally shape captions.

**Method.** In LiMBeR-BEIT, 196 self-supervised BEIT patch vectors are projected into GPT-J-6B's embedding space. For each generated noun, an activation-times-gradient score ranks all 16,384 neurons per multilayer perceptron by first-order contribution to its logit. A neuron's output weight is decoded through GPT-J's unembedding to name the concept it writes; spatial activation masks test visual selectivity, and ranked zero ablation tests causal effect.

**Validation.** Analyses use MS COCO 2017 validation images, with 1,000-image samples for semantic scoring. Projected image prompts are no closer to image semantics than random vectors (CLIPScore Kolmogorov–Smirnov \(D=.037,p>.5\)), whereas decoded top neurons reach CLIPScore 0.3848 and BERTScore 23.43, close to generated captions' 0.5251 and 23.62. Across 12 COCO categories, neuron masks have higher intersection-over-union with objects than same-layer random units; ten ImageNet classes test category selectivity using 200 training images per class. Ablating up to 6,400 top-ranked neurons lowers the target noun probability by about 80% on average, while matched random ablation has little effect.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Cross-modal translation occurs substantially inside GPT-J—especially MLP layers 5–10—rather than being readable directly from the linear image adapter, and identifiable neurons consistently inject object-related language. Semantic agreement, spatial selectivity, cross-dataset activation, and targeted ablation jointly provide strong evidence for multimodal neurons in this model. The study covers only LiMBeR-BEIT; the gradient score is approximate, large multi-neuron ablations do not prove each unit is independently causal, and upstream construction of these concepts remains unexplained.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究当独立训练的视觉编码器通过单个线性适配器连接到冻结的纯文本 Transformer 时，图像语义在哪里被转换成语言；它区分“适配器直接完成翻译”和“语言模型内部多层感知机神经元完成转换”，并检验这些神经元是否因果性地影响图像描述。

**方法。** 在 LiMBeR-BEIT 中，196 个自监督 BEIT 图像块向量被投影到 GPT-J-6B 的嵌入空间。对每个生成名词，激活乘梯度分数按一阶 logit 贡献排序每个多层感知机的 16,384 个神经元；再通过 GPT-J 反嵌入解码神经元输出权重，命名其写入概念。空间激活掩码检验视觉选择性，按排名置零则检验因果影响。

**实验验证。** 分析使用 MS COCO 2017 验证图像，其中语义计分取 1,000 张。投影后的图像提示与随机向量在图像语义上没有显著区别（CLIPScore 的 Kolmogorov–Smirnov 检验 \(D=.037,p>.5\)）；排名靠前神经元的解码词元达到 CLIPScore 0.3848、BERTScore 23.43，接近生成描述的 0.5251 和 23.62。12 个 COCO 类别上，神经元掩码与物体的交并比高于同层随机单元；另以每类 200 张训练图测试 10 个 ImageNet 类别的选择性。消融最多 6,400 个高分神经元后，目标名词概率平均下降约 80%，匹配随机消融影响很小。

**结论与证据。** 跨模态翻译相当一部分发生在 GPT-J 内部，尤其第 5—10 层 MLP，而不是已经能从线性图像适配器直接读出；可识别神经元会稳定写入物体相关语言。语义一致性、空间选择性、跨数据集激活和定向消融共同为该模型中的多模态神经元提供较强证据。但研究只覆盖 LiMBeR-BEIT，梯度分数只是近似，大规模多神经元消融不能证明每个单元都独立因果，上游如何构造这些概念也未解释。

p_2023_stolfo_a_mechanistic_interpretati.title: A Mechanistic Interpretation of Arithmetic Reasoning in Language Models using Causal Mediation Analysis
p_2023_stolfo_a_mechanistic_interpretati.venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing

abstract.en: Mathematical reasoning in large language models (LMs) has garnered significant attention in recent work, but there is a limited understanding of how these models process and store information related to arithmetic tasks within their architecture. In order to improve our understanding of this aspect of language models, we present a mechanistic interpretation of Transformer-based LMs on arithmetic questions using a causal mediation analysis framework. By intervening on the activations of specific model components and measuring the resulting changes in predicted probabilities, we identify the subset of parameters responsible for specific predictions. This provides insights into how information related to arithmetic is processed by LMs. Our experimental results indicate that LMs process the input by transmitting the information relevant to the query from mid-sequence early layers to the final token using the attention mechanism. Then, this information is processed by a set of MLP modules, which generate result-related information that is incorporated into the residual stream. To assess the specificity of the observed activation dynamics, we compare the effects of different model components on arithmetic queries with other tasks, including number retrieval from prompts and factual knowledge questions.
abstract.zh: 大语言模型（LM）的数学推理近来受到广泛关注，但人们对这些模型如何在其架构内部处理和存储与算术任务有关的信息仍了解有限。为加深对此问题的理解，我们使用因果中介分析框架，对基于 Transformer 的语言模型回答算术问题的过程给出机制解释。通过干预特定模型组件的激活并测量预测概率随之发生的变化，我们识别出负责特定预测的参数子集，从而揭示语言模型如何处理与算术有关的信息。实验结果表明，语言模型首先利用注意力机制，把与问题相关的信息从序列中部的早期层传送至最后一个 token；随后，一组 MLP 模块对这些信息进行处理，生成与结果有关的信息并将其写入残差流。为评估所观察到的激活动力学是否具有任务特异性，我们比较了不同模型组件对算术问题和其他任务的影响，后者包括从提示中检索数字以及回答事实知识问题。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks how Transformer language models route operand information and construct results for simple arithmetic. It separates effects of operands, operators, and result tokens; compares arithmetic with mere number retrieval and factual recall; and asks how this information flow changes after arithmetic fine-tuning.

**Method.** Causal mediation analysis treats each attention or multilayer-perceptron output at each token and layer as a mediator. For paired prompts with different operands, an activation from one prompt is inserted into the other and the indirect effect is the induced change in probability of the original and counterfactual results. Layer–position heatmaps trace information flow; result-preserving operand pairs isolate input-related from answer-related effects, and neuron-level interventions refine the final-token analysis.

**Validation.** Experiments cover GPT-J, Pythia-2.8B, LLaMA-7B, and arithmetic-tuned Goat on addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, with digit and numeral-word prompts. Baseline overall accuracies are 67.8%, 59.9%, 97.2%, and 85.6%, respectively. Controls use direct number retrieval and six T-REx relations from the LAMA factual benchmark, where GPT-J reaches 65.0%; an alternate log-probability effect checks metric dependence. Pythia's three-operand accuracy increases from 0.9% to 39.7% after fine-tuning, and the intervention heatmaps are compared before and after.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Across models, early and middle components route operand information, while late attention and multilayer-perceptron activity at the final token is strongly tied to producing the result; this pattern strengthens or reorganizes when arithmetic ability is fine-tuned and differs from retrieval or factual completion. Replication across four models, matched counterfactuals, task controls, and alternate metrics supports a task-specific causal-flow account. It remains a coarse localization rather than a complete algorithm: interventions aggregate whole modules, attention heads are not individually resolved, prompt templates are simple, and correct output does not show how multi-step arithmetic is represented.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究 Transformer 语言模型如何传递操作数信息并构造简单算术结果，具体区分操作数、运算符和结果词元的效应；将算术与数字提取、事实回忆比较；并考察算术微调如何改变信息流。

**方法。** 因果中介分析把每个层和词元位置上的注意力或多层感知机输出视为中介变量。对操作数不同的配对提示，将一条提示的激活插入另一条提示，以原结果和反事实结果概率的变化定义间接效应。层—位置热图追踪信息流；结果相同但操作数不同的配对分离输入相关与答案相关效应，神经元级干预进一步细化末词元分析。

**实验验证。** 实验覆盖 GPT-J、Pythia-2.8B、LLaMA-7B 和算术微调 Goat，任务含加减乘除及数字/英文数词提示；总体基线准确率分别为 67.8%、59.9%、97.2% 和 85.6%。对照包括直接数字提取和 LAMA 事实基准中 6 种 T-REx 关系，GPT-J 在后者为 65.0%；另用对数概率效应检查指标依赖。Pythia 的三操作数准确率经微调由 0.9% 升至 39.7%，并比较微调前后的干预热图。

**结论与证据。** 多个模型中，早中层组件传递操作数信息，末位置的晚层注意力和多层感知机活动则与输出结果强相关；算术能力微调会强化或重组该模式，而且它不同于数字提取和事实补全。四模型复现、匹配反事实、任务对照及替代指标支持任务特定的因果信息流解释。但这仍是粗粒度定位而非完整算法：干预聚合整个模块，没有解析单独注意力头，提示模板较简单，正确输出也不能说明模型如何表示多步算术。

p_2023_syed_attribution_patching_outperf.title: Attribution Patching Outperforms Automated Circuit Discovery
p_2023_syed_attribution_patching_outperf.venue: NeurIPS 2023 Workshop on Attributing Model Behavior at Scale

abstract.en: Automated interpretability research has recently attracted attention as a potential research direction that could scale explanations of neural network behavior to large models. Existing automated circuit discovery work applies activation patching to identify subnetworks responsible for solving specific tasks (circuits). In this work, we show that a simple method based on attribution patching outperforms all existing methods while requiring just two forward passes and a backward pass. We apply a linear approximation to activation patching to estimate the importance of each edge in the computational subgraph. Using this approximation, we prune the least important edges of the network. We survey the performance and limitations of this method, finding that averaged over all tasks our method has greater AUC from circuit recovery than other methods.
abstract.zh: 自动化可解释性研究近期受到关注，被视为一种可能把神经网络行为解释扩展到大模型的研究方向。现有自动回路发现工作应用激活修补，识别负责解决特定任务的子网络，即回路。本文表明，一种基于归因修补的简单方法优于所有现有方法，而且只需要两次前向传播和一次反向传播。我们对激活修补作线性近似，以估计计算子图中每条边的重要性，并利用该近似剪除网络中最不重要的边。我们系统考察该方法的性能和局限，发现对所有任务取平均后，该方法在回路恢复上的 AUC 高于其他方法。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether automated circuit discovery needs repeated expensive activation patching, or whether a first-order gradient approximation can rank all computational-graph edges more efficiently and recover known circuits at least as well. It also asks where that approximation fails and whether a slower search still adds value afterward.

**Method.** Edge Attribution Patching (EAP) estimates the metric change from replacing a clean edge activation \(e_c\) by a corrupted one \(e_r\) as \((e_r-e_c)^\top\nabla_e L\). Two forward passes and one backward pass produce scores for all residual and query/key/value edges; sorting absolute scores and retaining the top \(k\) yields a circuit. Task-specific logit metrics avoid the zero gradient that Kullback–Leibler divergence has at the uncorrupted global minimum.

**Validation.** Recovery is benchmarked against published ground-truth circuits for indirect-object identification, Python docstring completion, and greater-than prediction using receiver-operating-characteristic curves and area under the curve (AUC). EAP has the best AUC on two tasks; Automated Circuit Discovery (ACDC) with KL divergence wins the third, while repeated exact activation patching is feasible only for the small docstring model. Score distributions place most high-magnitude Indirect Object Identification (IOI) edges inside the reference circuit and align signs with mover versus negative-mover roles. Interpolating selected edges exposes concave response curves where the linear approximation overestimates effects; applying ACDC after EAP pre-pruning improves true/false-positive trade-offs.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** A single-gradient edge ranking is generally faster and at least competitive with iterative activation-patching search, making EAP a useful first stage and ACDC a refinement stage. Multi-task circuit-recovery curves and role-consistent signs support the ranking claim, but the benchmark treats hand-built circuits as ground truth and does not prove discovered subnetworks are uniquely faithful. First-order errors can be large, gradients fail for locally flat metrics, and AUC recovery does not directly measure behavioral sufficiency under simultaneous edge ablation.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究自动电路发现是否必须反复执行昂贵的激活修补，还是一阶梯度近似就能更高效地排序计算图全部边，并至少同样好地恢复已知电路；同时分析近似何处失败，以及慢速搜索在后处理阶段是否仍有价值。

**方法。** 边归因修补（Edge Attribution Patching, EAP）把干净边激活 \(e_c\) 替换为污染激活 \(e_r\) 后的指标变化近似为 \((e_r-e_c)^\top\nabla_e L\)。两次前向和一次反向传播即可得到所有残差边及查询/键/值边的分数，再按绝对值排序并保留前 \(k\) 条形成电路。方法使用任务特定 logit 指标，避免 Kullback–Leibler 散度在未污染全局最小点梯度为零的问题。

**实验验证。** 以间接宾语识别、Python docstring 补全和“大于”预测的已发表人工电路为真值，用受试者工作特征曲线及曲线下面积（Area Under the Curve, AUC）评测恢复。EAP 在两项任务取得最高 AUC，使用 KL 散度的自动电路发现（Automated Circuit Discovery, ACDC）在第三项胜出；反复精确激活修补只在较小的 docstring 模型上可承受。IOI 中多数高绝对值边位于参考电路内，正负号也符合搬运头与负搬运头角色。对边做连续插值则发现凹响应会令线性近似高估效应；先用 EAP 剪枝再运行 ACDC 可改善真假阳性权衡。

**结论与证据。** 单梯度边排序通常比迭代激活修补搜索更快且至少具有竞争力，因此 EAP 适合作为第一阶段、ACDC 作为细化阶段。多任务电路恢复曲线和与角色一致的符号支持排序结论，但评测把人工电路当作真值，并未证明发现的子网是唯一忠实解释。一阶误差可能很大，局部平坦指标会使梯度失效，而 AUC 恢复也不直接等于同时消融多条边后的行为充分性。

p_2023_tigges_linear_representations_of.title: Linear Representations of Sentiment in Large Language Models

abstract.en: Sentiment is a pervasive feature in natural language text, yet it is an open question how sentiment is represented within Large Language Models (LLMs). In this study, we reveal that across a range of models, sentiment is represented linearly: a single direction in activation space mostly captures the feature across a range of tasks with one extreme for positive and the other for negative. Through causal interventions, we isolate this direction and show it is causally relevant in both toy tasks and real world datasets such as Stanford Sentiment Treebank. Through this case study we model a thorough investigation of what a single direction means on a broad data distribution. We further uncover the mechanisms that involve this direction, highlighting the roles of a small subset of attention heads and neurons. Finally, we discover a phenomenon which we term the summarization motif: sentiment is not solely represented on emotionally charged words, but is additionally summarized at intermediate positions without inherent sentiment, such as punctuation and names. We show that in Stanford Sentiment Treebank zero-shot classification, 76% of above-chance classification accuracy is lost when ablating the sentiment direction, nearly half of which (36%) is due to ablating the summarized sentiment direction exclusively at comma positions.
abstract.zh: 情感是自然语言文本中普遍存在的特征，但情感如何在大语言模型（LLM）内部得到表征仍是一个开放问题。在本研究中，我们发现，在一系列模型中，情感都以线性方式表征：激活空间中的一个方向基本能够跨多种任务捕捉这一特征，其两个极端分别对应正面和负面情感。通过因果干预，我们分离出这一方向，并表明它在玩具任务和 Stanford Sentiment Treebank 等真实数据集中都具有因果相关性。借助这一案例研究，我们示范了如何在广泛的数据分布上深入考察“单一方向”的含义。我们进一步揭示了涉及这一方向的机制，并突出少量注意力头和神经元所发挥的作用。最后，我们发现一种称为“汇总模体”（summarization motif）的现象：情感不仅表征在带有强烈情绪色彩的词上，还会汇总到本身不含情感的中间位置，例如标点符号和人名。在 Stanford Sentiment Treebank 的零样本分类中，消融情感方向会使高于随机水平的分类准确率损失 76%；其中近一半（36%）来自仅在逗号位置消融汇总后的情感方向。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether positive–negative sentiment is represented by one approximately linear direction across words, contexts, and tasks; whether that direction causally controls predictions; and how model circuits move and compress sentiment information before using it.

**Method.** Sentiment directions are estimated from paired toy reviews using principal components, class-mean difference, logistic regression, \(k\)-means, and Distributed Alignment Search (DAS). Projection tests correlation; directional activation patching swaps only the component along a candidate direction between matched positive and negative prompts, while directional ablation and activation addition test necessity and steering. Path patching and attention analysis then trace a “summarization motif” in which valence is accumulated at punctuation or repeated-name positions and later read by output heads.

**Validation.** Models range from 85M to 2.8B parameters, with GPT-2 Small, Pythia-1.4B, and Pythia-2.8B used for toy movie reviews, multi-person mood stories, OpenWebText, and the 10,662-sentence Stanford Sentiment Treebank (SST). Directions are trained on 55 adjectives and tested on 30 unseen adjectives and unseen verbs. On 460 matched SST pairs that Pythia classifies correctly, one-layer DAS patching flips 53.5% of outputs; random directions flip 0.6%. Directional ablation removes 76% of above-chance zero-shot SST accuracy, including 36% attributable solely to comma-position summaries; component and path interventions validate nine-head toy circuits.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** A broadly shared linear axis captures much of sentiment, and models repeatedly summarize that information at seemingly neutral bottleneck tokens before final prediction. Cross-method direction agreement, out-of-domain SST effects, steering, and targeted circuit ablations provide substantial causal support. The axis is not necessarily a unique universal representation: datasets are mostly binary sentiment, SST evaluation excludes 17% of examples the model misses, GPT-4 supplies one lexical-label check, and other valence-related directions or redundant circuits may coexist.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究正负情感是否在不同词、上下文和任务中由一条近似线性方向表示，该方向是否因果性地控制预测，以及模型电路在使用情感前如何搬运并压缩这些信息。

**方法。** 研究从配对玩具影评中用主成分、类别均值差、逻辑回归、\(k\)-means 和分布式对齐搜索（Distributed Alignment Search, DAS）估计情感方向。投影检验相关性；方向激活修补只在匹配正负提示间交换候选方向上的分量，方向消融和激活加法分别检验必要性与操控性。路径修补和注意力分析进一步追踪“摘要母题”：情感先汇集到标点或重复姓名位置，再被输出注意力头读取。

**实验验证。** 模型规模为 8500 万至 28 亿参数，重点使用 GPT-2 Small、Pythia-1.4B 和 Pythia-2.8B；数据包括玩具影评、多人情绪故事、OpenWebText 和含 10,662 个句子的斯坦福情感树库（Stanford Sentiment Treebank, SST）。方向用 55 个形容词训练，在 30 个未见形容词和未见动词上测试。对 Pythia 原本分类正确的 460 对匹配 SST 短语，单层 DAS 修补翻转 53.5% 输出，随机方向仅 0.6%；方向消融移除 76% 的高于随机零样本准确率，其中 36% 仅来自逗号位置摘要；组件和路径干预还验证了九头玩具电路。

**结论与证据。** 一条广泛共享的线性轴能捕获大部分情感，模型会在最终预测前反复把信息摘要到表面中性的瓶颈词元。多方法方向一致、SST 分布外效应、表示操控和定向电路消融共同提供较强因果支持。但该轴未必是唯一的普适表示：数据大多是二元情感，SST 评测排除了模型答错的 17% 样本，一项词汇标签检查依赖 GPT-4，而且模型可能并存其他效价方向或冗余电路。

p_2023_todd_function_vectors_in.title: Function Vectors in Large Language Models

abstract.en: We report the presence of a simple neural mechanism that represents an input-output function as a vector within autoregressive transformer language models (LMs). Using causal mediation analysis on a diverse range of in-context-learning (ICL) tasks, we find that a small number attention heads transport a compact representation of the demonstrated task, which we call a function vector (FV). FVs are robust to changes in context, i.e., they trigger execution of the task on inputs such as zero-shot and natural text settings that do not resemble the ICL contexts from which they are collected. We test FVs across a range of tasks, models, and layers and find strong causal effects across settings in middle layers. We investigate the internal structure of FVs and find while that they often contain information that encodes the output space of the function, this information alone is not sufficient to reconstruct an FV. Finally, we test semantic vector composition in FVs, and find that to some extent they can be summed to create vectors that trigger new complex tasks. Our findings show that compact, causal internal vector representations of function abstractions can be explicitly extracted from LLMs. Our code and data are available at https://functions.baulab.info.
abstract.zh: 我们报告了一种简单神经机制的存在：它在自回归 Transformer 语言模型（LM）内部用一个向量表示输入—输出函数。通过对多种上下文学习（ICL）任务进行因果中介分析，我们发现，少量注意力头会传递所示范任务的紧凑表征，我们称之为函数向量（FV）。函数向量对上下文变化具有鲁棒性：在零样本设置和自然文本等与其提取来源 ICL 上下文并不相似的输入中，它们仍能触发任务执行。我们跨多种任务、模型和层测试函数向量，并在不同设置的中间层发现了很强的因果效应。我们进一步考察函数向量的内部结构，发现它们虽经常包含编码函数输出空间的信息，但仅凭这些信息不足以重建函数向量。最后，我们测试函数向量的语义向量组合，发现它们在一定程度上可以相加，形成能够触发新复杂任务的向量。我们的发现表明，可以从大语言模型中显式提取对函数抽象的紧凑、具有因果作用的内部向量表征。代码和数据见 https://functions.baulab.info。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks how a language model infers and executes a task from in-context examples, whether that task can be compressed into a single transferable hidden-state vector, and whether the vector acts as a genuine function trigger rather than a simple semantic word offset.

**Method.** For each task, causal mediation patches individual attention-head outputs from a correct few-shot prompt into a shuffled-label prompt and ranks heads by restored task performance. Averaging the outputs of a small fixed set of high-causal heads across demonstrations yields a function vector (FV), which is added to the residual stream at a chosen layer. Portability tests vary prompt correctness and input, vocabulary decoding interprets the vector, and vector addition/composition tests whether several functions can be invoked together.

**Validation.** Experiments span GPT-J-6B, GPT-NeoX-20B, and Llama-2 7B/13B/70B. Six representative tasks include antonyms, capitalization, country–capital, English–Spanish, pluralization, and present-to-past conversion; another 34 tasks broaden the test. For GPT-J, ten selected heads form each FV. On the six-task average, adding an FV raises shuffled-label accuracy from 39.1% to 90.8% and zero-shot accuracy from 5.5% to 57.5%; for Llama-2 70B across the broader task set, FV results reach 93.0% with shuffled labels and 74.2% zero-shot. Cross-layer, cross-input, cyclic-task, scale, and function-composition experiments provide controls.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** A compact additive state extracted from causally important heads can carry the task inferred during in-context learning and trigger the model to execute it even when demonstrations are absent or misleading. Large intervention gains across models, tasks, and prompt regimes support a causal and partially compositional function representation. FVs are averages tied to chosen datasets and layers rather than a fully decoded algorithm; they do not identify all upstream inference steps, some tasks fail or compose imperfectly, and behavior may combine function triggering with ordinary semantic offsets.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究语言模型如何从上下文示例推断并执行任务，该任务能否压缩为单个可迁移隐藏状态向量，以及此向量究竟触发真实函数，还是仅相当于简单语义词向量偏移。

**方法。** 对每个任务，因果中介实验把正确少样本提示中的单个注意力头输出修补到标签打乱提示，按任务恢复程度筛选注意力头。将少量高因果头在多个示例上的输出求平均，得到函数向量（Function Vector, FV），再加到指定层的残差流。迁移测试改变提示正确性和输入，词表解码解释向量内容，向量加法与组合则检验能否同时调用多个函数。

**实验验证。** 实验覆盖 GPT-J-6B、GPT-NeoX-20B 和 Llama-2 7B/13B/70B。六个代表任务含反义词、大小写、国家—首都、英译西、复数化和现在时转过去时，另用 34 项任务扩展评测。GPT-J 每个 FV 使用 10 个筛选注意力头；六任务平均中，加入 FV 后打乱标签准确率由 39.1% 升至 90.8%，零样本准确率由 5.5% 升至 57.5%。Llama-2 70B 在扩展任务上的 FV 结果达到打乱标签 93.0%、零样本 74.2%；跨层、跨输入、循环任务、规模和函数组合实验提供对照。

**结论与证据。** 从因果重要注意力头提取的紧凑加性状态能够承载上下文学习所得任务，并在示例缺失或误导时触发模型执行。跨模型、任务和提示条件的大幅干预增益支持一种具有因果性且部分可组合的函数表示。但 FV 是依赖所选数据和层的平均量，并非完整解码算法；它没有定位全部上游推断步骤，部分任务失败或组合不完整，行为也可能混有普通语义偏移。

p_2023_varma_explaining_grokking_through.title: Explaining grokking through circuit efficiency

abstract.en: One of the most surprising puzzles in neural network generalisation is grokking: a network with perfect training accuracy but poor generalisation will, upon further training, transition to perfect generalisation. We propose that grokking occurs when the task admits a generalising solution and a memorising solution, where the generalising solution is slower to learn but more efficient, producing larger logits with the same parameter norm. We hypothesise that memorising circuits become more inefficient with larger training datasets while generalising circuits do not, suggesting there is a critical dataset size at which memorisation and generalisation are equally efficient. We make and confirm four novel predictions about grokking, providing significant evidence in favour of our explanation. Most strikingly, we demonstrate two novel and surprising behaviours: ungrokking, in which a network regresses from perfect to low test accuracy, and semi-grokking, in which a network shows delayed generalisation to partial rather than perfect test accuracy.
abstract.zh: 神经网络泛化中最令人惊讶的谜题之一是“顿悟”（grokking）：一个训练准确率完美但泛化能力很差的网络，在继续训练后会转变为完美泛化。我们提出，当一项任务同时存在泛化解和记忆解，而泛化解虽然学习较慢、效率却更高——即在相同参数范数下产生更大的 logits——时，顿悟就会发生。我们假设，随着训练数据集增大，记忆回路的效率会降低，而泛化回路不会，因此存在一个临界数据集规模，使记忆与泛化具有相同效率。我们针对顿悟提出并证实了四项新预测，为上述解释提供了有力证据。最引人注目的是，我们展示了两种新颖且出人意料的行为：反顿悟，即网络从完美测试准确率退化为较低准确率；以及半顿悟，即网络延迟泛化后只达到部分而非完美的测试准确率。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks why continued optimization can turn a network that already memorizes its training set into one that suddenly generalizes. It proposes three required ingredients—coexisting memorizing and generalizing circuits, greater norm efficiency of the generalizing circuit, and slower learning of that circuit—and derives predictions about dataset size, “ungrokking,” and partial “semi-grokking.”

**Method.** Circuit efficiency is defined as correct-logit strength produced per parameter norm under cross-entropy plus weight decay. Theory shows that when circuits give the same training logits, regularization allocates more weight to the efficient circuit. Because a memorizer must store each added example but an algorithmic circuit need not change, their efficiencies should cross at a critical dataset size \(D_{crit}\). Random-label runs isolate memorization; the Fourier/trigonometric subspace isolates modular-addition generalization.

**Validation.** One-layer, four-head Transformers with 128-dimensional residuals and 512-unit multilayer perceptrons are trained by full-batch AdamW on \(a+b\bmod 113\); the full input space has 12,769 pairs. Sweeps over dataset size, weight decay, seed, and logit/norm show memorization efficiency falling with data size while generalization efficiency stays roughly fixed. Already-grokked models retrained on subsets exhibit a sharp, weight-decay-independent collapse below \(D_{crit}\); 7 subset sizes from 390 to 1,494 with 10 seeds support this, and nine additional group/arithmetic tasks replicate ungrokking. Near 12% data, selected runs pause at partial accuracy (about 55–83%) before sometimes reaching full generalization.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** With weight decay, grokking can arise because a slowly learned structured circuit eventually produces the same confident answers with less norm than a memorizing circuit; dataset size controls which is efficient enough to dominate. The successful advance predictions of ungrokking and semi-grokking, together with norm–logit sweeps, strongly support this mechanism in the studied algorithmic setting. It is not a complete theory: grokking can occur without explicit weight decay, circuit separation uses proxy subspaces, \(D_{crit}\) varies with seed and optimization history, and realistic tasks contain many interacting circuit families.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究为何继续优化会让已经记住训练集的网络突然转向泛化。解释包含三个条件：记忆电路与泛化电路并存、泛化电路的参数范数效率更高、但学习更慢；并据此推导数据规模、“反顿悟”和部分“半顿悟”的预测。

**方法。** 电路效率定义为在交叉熵加权重衰减下，单位参数范数产生的正确 logit 强度。理论证明，当多个电路给出相同训练 logit 时，正则化会把更多权重分配给高效率电路。记忆器需为每个新增样本付出容量，而算法电路无需改变，因此两者应在临界数据规模 \(D_{crit}\) 处发生效率交叉。随机标签训练隔离记忆，Fourier/三角子空间则隔离模加法泛化。

**实验验证。** 使用一层四头 Transformer，残差维度 128、多层感知机 512 单元，以 full-batch AdamW 训练 \(a+b\bmod 113\)，完整输入空间含 12,769 对。对数据规模、权重衰减、随机种子及 logit/范数扫描发现，记忆效率随数据增多下降，而泛化效率近似不变。已顿悟模型改用小子集继续训练时，在 \(D_{crit}\) 以下出现与权重衰减强度近乎无关的陡峭性能坍塌；7 个 390—1,494 的子集规模、每个 10 个种子支持该现象，另 9 个群论/算术任务也复现反顿悟。约 12% 数据附近，部分运行先停留在约 55%—83% 准确率，之后有时再达到完全泛化。

**结论与证据。** 在权重衰减存在时，顿悟可由一个学习较慢但用更小范数产生同等置信答案的结构化电路最终压过记忆电路来解释，数据规模决定谁的效率占优。事先预测并观察到反顿悟和半顿悟，加上范数—logit 扫描，为算法任务中的机制提供强支持。但理论并不完整：无显式权重衰减时也可能顿悟，电路分离依赖代理子空间，\(D_{crit}\) 随种子和优化历史变化，真实任务还包含许多相互作用的电路族。

p_2023_voita_neurons_in_large.title: Neurons in Large Language Models: Dead, N-gram, Positional
p_2023_voita_neurons_in_large.venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics

abstract.en: We analyze a family of large language models in such a lightweight manner that can be done on a single GPU. Specifically, we focus on the OPT family of models ranging from 125m to 66b parameters and rely only on whether an FFN neuron is activated or not. First, we find that the early part of the network is sparse and represents many discrete features. Here, many neurons (more than 70% in some layers of the 66b model) are"dead", i.e. they never activate on a large collection of diverse data. At the same time, many of the alive neurons are reserved for discrete features and act as token and n-gram detectors. Interestingly, their corresponding FFN updates not only promote next token candidates as could be expected, but also explicitly focus on removing the information about triggering them tokens, i.e., current input. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first example of mechanisms specialized at removing (rather than adding) information from the residual stream. With scale, models become more sparse in a sense that they have more dead neurons and token detectors. Finally, some neurons are positional: them being activated or not depends largely (or solely) on position and less so (or not at all) on textual data. We find that smaller models have sets of neurons acting as position range indicators while larger models operate in a less explicit manner.
abstract.zh: 我们以一种可在单块 GPU 上完成的轻量方式，分析一系列大语言模型。具体而言，我们聚焦参数量从 1.25 亿到 660 亿的 OPT 模型家族，并且只考察 FFN 神经元是否激活。首先，我们发现网络的早期部分较为稀疏，并表征许多离散特征。这里有大量神经元处于“死亡”状态——例如 660 亿参数模型的某些层中超过 70%——即它们在大量多样数据上从不激活。与此同时，许多活跃神经元专门负责离散特征，充当 token 和 n-gram 检测器。有趣的是，它们对应的 FFN 更新不仅会像预期那样提升下一 token 候选项，还会明确地移除有关触发这些神经元之 token、也就是当前输入的信息。据我们所知，这是首个专门从残差流中移除信息而非添加信息的机制实例。随着规模增大，模型会变得更稀疏，即拥有更多死亡神经元和 token 检测器。最后，一些神经元具有位置性：它们是否激活主要或完全取决于位置，而较少或完全不取决于文本数据。我们发现，小模型具有充当位置范围指示器的神经元集合，而大模型则以不那么显式的方式运作。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks how feed-forward-network neurons change with language-model scale and what can be learned from the lightweight binary question of whether each ReLU neuron activates. It focuses on dead units, token/n-gram detectors, the content of their residual updates, and neurons whose firing depends on absolute position rather than text.

**Method.** For each neuron, activation frequency is measured across domains. A neuron is “dead” if never positive; an n-gram detector is identified when one to five triggers cover at least 95% of both the neuron's activations and occurrences of those triggers. Multiplying its output row through the unembedding reveals promoted and suppressed vocabulary. Positional neurons are selected by mutual information \(I(\text{active};\text{position})>0.05\) and categorized by oscillatory, threshold, or weaker activation patterns.

**Validation.** The analysis covers the OPT family from 125M to 66B parameters on more than 20M tokens for dead-neuron estimates and more than 5M for other tests, drawn from Pile domains, Reddit, and CodeParrot. One layer at a time is loaded so even 66B fits the single-GPU workflow. Some early 66B layers have over 70% dead units; that model contains 5,351 token detectors, covers over 10,000 distinct tokens across layers, and more than 80% of detectors write negatively toward their triggers. Full 2,048-token sequences test position effects. Separately trained 125M models with and without positional embeddings on 3B OpenWebText tokens both develop positional neurons.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Early feed-forward layers become sparser and more discretely specialized with scale: many units detect lexical patterns, jointly cover different vocabulary across layers, and explicitly remove current-token identity while promoting likely continuations. Small models encode absolute position with coordinated range indicators, whereas larger models use less explicit patterns. The evidence is broad and reproducible across one architecture family, but mainly observational: “dead” means unseen on sampled data, output-weight projections do not prove behavioral necessity, the 350M post-LayerNorm outlier shows architectural sensitivity, and no neuron interventions quantify causal effects.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究前馈网络神经元如何随语言模型规模变化，以及仅利用 ReLU 神经元是否激活这一轻量信息能揭示什么；重点包括死亡单元、词元/ n-gram 检测器、它们写入残差流的内容，以及由绝对位置而非文本决定激活的神经元。

**方法。** 研究跨领域统计每个神经元的激活频率；从未为正者定义为“死亡”，若 1—5 个触发 n-gram 同时覆盖至少 95% 的神经元激活和这些触发的出现，则判为检测器。把输出行经反嵌入投影可查看被促进与抑制的词表项。位置神经元以互信息 \(I(\text{active};\text{position})>0.05\) 筛选，并按振荡、阈值或较弱位置模式分类。

**实验验证。** 分析覆盖 1.25 亿至 660 亿参数的 OPT 系列；死亡神经元统计使用超过 2,000 万词元，其余实验超过 500 万词元，来自 Pile 多领域、Reddit 和 CodeParrot。逐层加载使 660 亿模型也能在单 GPU 上分析。部分 66B 早层超过 70% 单元死亡，整个模型含 5,351 个词元检测器，跨层覆盖超过 1 万个不同词元，且 80% 以上检测器的写入方向会抑制自身触发词。位置分析使用长度 2,048 的完整序列；另在 30 亿 OpenWebText 词元上分别训练有/无位置嵌入的 125M 模型，两者都形成位置神经元。

**结论与证据。** 随规模增大，早期前馈层更稀疏、离散专门化更明显：许多单元检测词汇模式，不同层协同覆盖不同词表，并在促进可能续词的同时显式移除当前词元身份。小模型以协调的位置区间指示器编码绝对位置，大模型的模式更不显式。证据跨同一架构族较广，但主要是观察性：所谓“死亡”只代表采样数据上未激活，输出权重投影不证明行为必要性，350M 的后置 LayerNorm 异常说明结果依赖架构，且没有神经元干预量化因果效应。

p_2023_zhang_towards_best_practices.title: Towards Best Practices of Activation Patching in Language Models: Metrics and Methods

abstract.en: Mechanistic interpretability seeks to understand the internal mechanisms of machine learning models, where localization -- identifying the important model components -- is a key step. Activation patching, also known as causal tracing or interchange intervention, is a standard technique for this task (Vig et al., 2020), but the literature contains many variants with little consensus on the choice of hyperparameters or methodology. In this work, we systematically examine the impact of methodological details in activation patching, including evaluation metrics and corruption methods. In several settings of localization and circuit discovery in language models, we find that varying these hyperparameters could lead to disparate interpretability results. Backed by empirical observations, we give conceptual arguments for why certain metrics or methods may be preferred. Finally, we provide recommendations for the best practices of activation patching going forwards.
abstract.zh: 机制可解释性旨在理解机器学习模型的内部机制，其中，定位——即识别重要的模型组件——是关键步骤。激活修补又称因果追踪或互换干预，是完成这一任务的标准技术（Vig 等，2020）；但现有文献包含许多变体，对于超参数或方法论的选择几乎没有共识。在本研究中，我们系统考察激活修补中各项方法细节的影响，包括评估指标和扰动方法。在语言模型的多种定位与回路发现设置中，我们发现改变这些超参数可能产生截然不同的可解释性结果。基于经验观察，我们从概念层面论证为何某些指标或方法可能更值得采用。最后，我们为今后实施激活修补提出最佳实践建议。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks how activation-patching conclusions depend on two analyst choices: how a clean input is corrupted and which output metric scores recovery. It also tests whether patching several adjacent layers creates localization peaks that single-layer interventions do not support.

**Method.** Gaussian-noise (GN) corruption is compared with symmetric token replacement (STR), which pairs grammatical, in-distribution prompts with different answers. Clean activations are restored into corrupted runs and scored by correct-answer probability, correct-minus-counterfactual logit difference, or Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence. Single components and sliding windows are patched; activation statistics and attention patterns test whether corruption has moved the model off distribution.

**Validation.** Factual-recall experiments use 145 paired CounterFact/Known-1000 prompts on GPT-2 Large/XL and GPT-J; GN peaks are 2–5 times larger than STR despite different layer profiles. On 500 indirect-object identification prompts, corruption/metric combinations recover different subsets of known name-mover, inhibition, duplicate, and induction heads; probability misses negative movers. Further studies use 200 correct GPT-J arithmetic prompts, 200 Python-docstring examples, and 300 GPT-2 Small greater-than prompts. In arithmetic STR can create peaks up to four times sharper than GN, while greater-than GN produces noisy, largely disjoint heads and STR recovers four previously reported ones. Single-layer factual patches do not reproduce the strong early-middle peak from multi-layer windows.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Activation patching does not yield a method-independent map of where a computation resides: corruption defines the counterfactual question, metrics emphasize different output changes, and window interventions can introduce nonlinear joint recovery. Repeated results across tasks, models, and known circuits strongly support this methodological warning and favor in-distribution replacements plus logit difference when a meaningful alternative exists. These are recommendations rather than a universally optimal recipe; STR requires carefully matched pairs, KL is useful when the whole distribution matters, and the evidence for GN-induced off-distribution mechanisms remains suggestive rather than definitive.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究激活修补的定位结论在多大程度上依赖两个分析选择：如何污染干净输入，以及用何种输出指标衡量恢复；同时检验连续修补多层是否会产生单层干预并不支持的定位峰值。

**方法。** 高斯噪声（Gaussian Noise, GN）污染与对称词元替换（Symmetric Token Replacement, STR）比较，后者把答案不同但语法正确、分布内的提示配成对。将干净激活恢复到污染运行后，分别用正确答案概率、正确与反事实答案的 logit 差、或 Kullback–Leibler（KL）散度计分。实验既修补单组件也修补滑动层窗口，并以激活统计和注意力模式检查污染是否把模型推到分布外。

**实验验证。** 事实回忆使用 CounterFact/Known-1000 构造的 145 对提示，在 GPT-2 Large/XL 和 GPT-J 上测试；GN 峰值比 STR 高 2—5 倍，但层分布不同。500 条间接宾语识别提示上，不同污染/指标组合找回的已知姓名搬运、抑制、重复和归纳头子集不同，概率指标还漏掉负向搬运头。进一步实验含 200 条 GPT-J 正确算术提示、200 条 Python docstring 和 300 条 GPT-2 Small 大于任务提示：算术中 STR 峰可比 GN 尖锐 4 倍，大于任务中 GN 噪声很大且定位头几乎不同，STR 则找回 4 个已报道注意力头。单层事实修补也未复现多层窗口的强早中层峰。

**结论与证据。** 激活修补不会给出与方法无关的“计算位置图”：污染方式定义了反事实问题，指标强调不同输出变化，窗口干预还可能产生非线性联合恢复。跨任务、模型和已知电路的重复结果强烈支持这一方法学警告；在存在有意义替代答案时，更倾向分布内替换与 logit 差。但这不是普适最优配方：STR 依赖精心匹配提示，关注完整分布时 KL 仍有价值，而“GN 导致分布外内部机制”的证据仍偏提示性。

p_2023_zou_representation_engineering_a.title: Representation Engineering: A Top-Down Approach to AI Transparency

abstract.en: In this paper, we identify and characterize the emerging area of representation engineering (RepE), an approach to enhancing the transparency of AI systems that draws on insights from cognitive neuroscience. RepE places population-level representations, rather than neurons or circuits, at the center of analysis, equipping us with novel methods for monitoring and manipulating high-level cognitive phenomena in deep neural networks (DNNs). We provide baselines and an initial analysis of RepE techniques, showing that they offer simple yet effective solutions for improving our understanding and control of large language models. We showcase how these methods can provide traction on a wide range of safety-relevant problems, including honesty, harmlessness, power-seeking, and more, demonstrating the promise of top-down transparency research. We hope that this work catalyzes further exploration of RepE and fosters advancements in the transparency and safety of AI systems.
abstract.zh: 本文识别并刻画了新兴的表征工程（Representation Engineering，RepE）领域。这种增强 AI 系统透明度的方法借鉴了认知神经科学的认识。RepE 将群体层面的表征置于分析中心，而不是聚焦神经元或回路，从而为监测和操纵深度神经网络（DNN）中的高层认知现象提供新方法。我们给出 RepE 技术的基线和初步分析，表明它们能够以简单而有效的方式改善我们对大语言模型的理解和控制。我们展示了这些方法如何推动一系列与安全相关的问题，包括诚实性、无害性、权力寻求等，由此体现自上而下透明度研究的潜力。我们希望本工作能够促进对 RepE 的进一步探索，并推动 AI 系统透明度与安全性的进步。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether high-level properties of language models—such as honesty, harmlessness, power seeking, emotion, and factuality—can be studied and controlled directly in representation space. It reframes interpretability from locating individual neurons or circuits to finding population-level directions that encode behaviorally meaningful concepts.

**Method.** Representation Engineering (RepE) separates representation reading from representation control. Linear Artificial Tomography builds contrastive prompt pairs, extracts hidden states at selected layers and token positions, and estimates a concept direction with principal components or class-mean differences. Projection scores read the concept; adding, subtracting, or erasing the direction tests whether it steers behavior. The framework distinguishes correlational evidence from stronger manipulation, termination, and recovery interventions.

**Validation.** Experiments use open-source language models and contrastive stimuli for truthfulness, lying and hallucination detection, morality, power seeking, emotion, harmlessness, fairness, knowledge editing, and memorization. On TruthfulQA, unsupervised honesty steering improves accuracy by 18.1 percentage points over zero-shot prompting. Additional tests project hidden states to classify truthful versus deceptive responses, intervene on directions during generation, and alter agents' choices in interactive moral and power-related scenarios; controls vary layers, prompt templates, and direction construction.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Many high-level concepts are recoverable as simple linear patterns whose intervention changes model behavior, supporting RepE as a broad diagnostic and control interface. The evidence is strongest where the same direction predicts held-out examples and produces reversible behavioral changes, but weaker for demonstrations without standardized metrics. The results do not show that concepts are intrinsically one-dimensional or that RepE identifies the underlying computation; prompt construction, linearity assumptions, benchmark definitions, and possible entanglement with style remain important limitations.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究诚实、无害、追求权力、情绪和事实性等语言模型高层属性，能否直接在表示空间中被研究和控制。它把可解释性视角从定位单个神经元或电路，转向寻找承载行为概念的群体级表示方向。

**方法。** 表示工程（Representation Engineering, RepE）区分“读取表示”与“控制表示”。线性人工断层成像用对比提示对，在指定层和词元位置提取隐藏状态，再以主成分或类别均值差估计概念方向；投影分数用于读取概念，加、减或擦除该方向用于测试行为操控。框架还把相关性证据与更强的操纵、终止和恢复干预区分开来。

**实验验证。** 实验在开源语言模型上构造对比刺激，覆盖 TruthfulQA 真话回答、谎言与幻觉检测、道德、权力倾向、情绪、无害性、公平、知识编辑和记忆。无监督诚实方向在 TruthfulQA 上比零样本提示提高 18.1 个百分点。其余实验用隐藏状态投影区分真实与欺骗回答，在生成时注入方向，并改变交互式道德或权力场景中的行动选择；层位置、提示模板和方向构造方式作为对照。

**结论与证据。** 多种高层概念可以由简单线性模式读取，而且干预这些模式会改变行为，说明 RepE 可作为广覆盖的诊断与控制接口。若同一方向既预测留出样本又产生可逆行为变化，证据较强；只有示例而缺少标准指标的任务则较弱。结果并未证明概念本质上是一维的，也没有揭示底层计算；提示构造、线性假设、基准对概念的定义及与表达风格纠缠都是限制。

p_2024_arditi_refusal_in_language.title: Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction

abstract.en: Conversational large language models are fine-tuned for both instruction-following and safety, resulting in models that obey benign requests but refuse harmful ones. While this refusal behavior is widespread across chat models, its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this work, we show that refusal is mediated by a one-dimensional subspace, across 13 popular open-source chat models up to 72B parameters in size. Specifically, for each model, we find a single direction such that erasing this direction from the model's residual stream activations prevents it from refusing harmful instructions, while adding this direction elicits refusal on even harmless instructions. Leveraging this insight, we propose a novel white-box jailbreak method that surgically disables refusal with minimal effect on other capabilities. Finally, we mechanistically analyze how adversarial suffixes suppress propagation of the refusal-mediating direction. Our findings underscore the brittleness of current safety fine-tuning methods. More broadly, our work showcases how an understanding of model internals can be leveraged to develop practical methods for controlling model behavior.
abstract.zh: 对话式大语言模型同时针对指令遵循和安全性进行微调，因此会服从无害请求、拒绝有害请求。尽管拒绝行为广泛存在于聊天模型中，其底层机制仍未得到充分理解。在本研究中，我们表明，在 13 个常用开源聊天模型中——模型规模最大达到 720 亿参数——拒绝行为均由一个一维子空间介导。具体而言，对每个模型，我们都找到了一个方向：从模型残差流激活中擦除该方向，会使模型不再拒绝有害指令；加入该方向，则会使模型连无害指令也予以拒绝。利用这一认识，我们提出一种新的白盒越狱方法，以外科手术般的方式禁用拒绝机制，同时尽量减少对其他能力的影响。最后，我们从机制层面分析对抗性后缀如何抑制拒绝介导方向的传播。我们的发现凸显了当前安全微调方法的脆弱性。更广泛地说，本工作展示了如何利用对模型内部机制的理解，开发控制模型行为的实用方法。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether refusal in instruction-tuned language models is mediated by a low-dimensional representation shared across harmful requests, and whether that representation is causally necessary and sufficient for refusing. It also asks how jailbreak prompts suppress the mechanism and whether editing model weights can remove it without broadly damaging capability.

**Method.** A refusal direction is computed as the difference between mean residual-stream activations for harmful and harmless prompts. Directional ablation removes its component throughout the residual stream, activation addition inserts it at one layer, and weight orthogonalization projects the direction out of every matrix that writes to the residual stream. Attention and projection analyses trace how adversarial suffixes prevent the direction from being written.

**Validation.** Tests cover 13 open-source chat models from 1.8B to 72B parameters. Directions use 128 harmful prompts from AdvBench, MaliciousInstruct, TDC2023, and HarmBench plus 128 harmless Alpaca prompts, with 32+32 held out. On 100 JailbreakBench behaviors, refusal is scored by string matching and Llama Guard 2; HarmBench's 159 standard behaviors measure attack success after weight editing. Ablation suppresses refusal and addition induces it on harmless prompts across models. MMLU, ARC, GSM8K, and TruthfulQA check collateral capability; most edited scores remain within the original 99% confidence interval, although some models degrade. A learned adversarial suffix on Qwen-1.8B provides a mechanistic jailbreak case study.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** A single linear direction mediates a large fraction of refusal behavior across diverse chat models: removing it disables refusal, adding it induces refusal, and deleting it from weights creates a broadly effective white-box jailbreak. Cross-model necessity/sufficiency interventions provide strong causal evidence for this specific behavior. The claim is not that safety or harmfulness is globally one-dimensional; the experiments concern open-weight chat models and benchmarked prompts, some orthogonalized models lose capability, and substring or classifier judgments imperfectly measure safe, coherent responses.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究指令微调语言模型的拒答是否由跨有害请求共享的低维表示介导，该表示对拒答是否既必要又充分；同时分析越狱提示如何压制这一机制，以及能否通过权重编辑移除它而不普遍损害能力。

**方法。** 拒答方向由有害与无害提示在残差流中的平均激活差得到。方向消融在整个残差流中移除该分量，激活加法在单层注入该分量，权重正交化则从所有写入残差流的矩阵中投影掉该方向。注意力与投影分析进一步追踪对抗后缀如何阻止模型写入拒答方向。

**实验验证。** 测试覆盖 13 个 18 亿至 720 亿参数的开源聊天模型。方向使用来自 AdvBench、MaliciousInstruct、TDC2023 和 HarmBench 的 128 条有害提示及 128 条 Alpaca 无害提示，另留出各 32 条。100 项 JailbreakBench 行为用字符串规则和 Llama Guard 2 判断拒答，HarmBench 的 159 项标准行为衡量权重编辑后的攻击成功率。跨模型实验中，消融会压制拒答，加法会让无害提示也被拒绝；MMLU、ARC、GSM8K 和 TruthfulQA 检查副作用，多数编辑后分数仍处于原模型 99% 置信区间内，但部分模型下降。Qwen-1.8B 上学习得到的对抗后缀用于机制个案分析。

**结论与证据。** 单一线性方向介导了多种聊天模型中的大部分拒答：移除它可关闭拒答，加入它可诱发拒答，从权重中删除它则形成广泛有效的白盒越狱。跨模型的必要性与充分性干预为这一特定行为提供强因果证据。但结论不等于安全或有害性整体是一维的；实验限于开放权重聊天模型和基准提示，部分正交化模型会损失能力，而字符串或分类器判断也不能完美衡量回答是否安全且连贯。

p_2024_braun_identifying_functionally_im.title: Identifying Functionally Important Features with End-to-End Sparse Dictionary Learning

abstract.en: Identifying the features learned by neural networks is a core challenge in mechanistic interpretability. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs), which learn a sparse, overcomplete dictionary that reconstructs a network's internal activations, have been used to identify these features. However, SAEs may learn more about the structure of the datatset than the computational structure of the network. There is therefore only indirect reason to believe that the directions found in these dictionaries are functionally important to the network. We propose end-to-end (e2e) sparse dictionary learning, a method for training SAEs that ensures the features learned are functionally important by minimizing the KL divergence between the output distributions of the original model and the model with SAE activations inserted. Compared to standard SAEs, e2e SAEs offer a Pareto improvement: They explain more network performance, require fewer total features, and require fewer simultaneously active features per datapoint, all with no cost to interpretability. We explore geometric and qualitative differences between e2e SAE features and standard SAE features. E2e dictionary learning brings us closer to methods that can explain network behavior concisely and accurately. We release our library for training e2e SAEs and reproducing our analysis at https://github.com/ApolloResearch/e2e_sae
abstract.zh: 识别神经网络学到的特征，是机制可解释性中的核心挑战。稀疏自编码器（SAE）会学习一个用于重构网络内部激活的稀疏过完备字典，并已被用于识别这类特征。然而，SAE 学到的内容可能更多反映数据集结构，而非网络的计算结构。因此，人们只有间接理由相信这些字典中发现的方向对网络具有功能重要性。我们提出端到端（e2e）稀疏字典学习：通过最小化原始模型与插入 SAE 激活后模型的输出分布之间的 KL 散度，训练 SAE 并确保所学特征具有功能重要性。与标准 SAE 相比，e2e SAE 实现了帕累托改进：它们能解释更多网络性能，需要的特征总数更少，每个数据点同时激活的特征也更少，同时不损害可解释性。我们还探索了 e2e SAE 特征与标准 SAE 特征之间的几何和定性差异。端到端字典学习使我们更接近能够简洁、准确解释网络行为的方法。用于训练 e2e SAE 和复现分析的代码库见 https://github.com/ApolloResearch/e2e_sae。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether sparse autoencoders trained only to reconstruct one layer's activations waste capacity on variance that does not matter to model behavior. It tests whether end-to-end objectives can learn sparser features that preserve the language model's output and whether an auxiliary downstream loss also preserves the original computational route.

**Method.** Three frozen-model dictionaries are compared. A local sparse autoencoder minimizes activation mean-squared error plus an (L_1) penalty; an end-to-end autoencoder replaces the activation and minimizes the Kullback–Leibler divergence between original and reconstructed output distributions plus sparsity; an end-to-end-plus-downstream variant additionally matches later-layer activations. Reconstruction–sparsity and behavior–sparsity Pareto frontiers separate local fidelity from functional fidelity.

**Validation.** Main experiments insert 46,080-feature dictionaries before layer 6 of GPT-2 Small and train on 400,000 OpenWebText contexts of length 1,024; layers 2 and 10 and TinyStories-1M provide replications. Evaluation on 500 held-out OpenWebText contexts reports average active features ((L_0)), language-model cross-entropy increase, live features, local and downstream mean-squared error, and automated feature-interpretability scores. At matched (L_0), end-to-end models produce less than 45% of the local model's cross-entropy increase, while the local model needs more than twice as many active features to match behavior. Larger local dictionaries and more training data do not close the frontier; seed, geometry, and training-time analyses provide controls.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Optimizing for downstream output identifies features that are substantially more efficient at preserving model function than activation reconstruction alone, and the downstream-state penalty recovers much of the original pathway without losing that advantage. Matched-sparsity Pareto curves across models and layers give strong comparative evidence. The result is not proof that the learned features are uniquely causal or human-meaningful: end-to-end training can Goodhart on the chosen output metric, automated interpretability is noisy, experiments use small models and a few insertion layers, and training costs about 2–3.5 times more.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究仅以单层激活重构训练稀疏自编码器，是否会把容量浪费在不影响模型行为的方差上；并检验端到端目标能否学习更稀疏但保留语言模型输出的特征，以及加入下游损失能否同时保留原有计算路径。

**方法。** 比较三种冻结语言模型的字典。局部稀疏自编码器最小化激活均方误差与 (L_1) 稀疏惩罚；端到端版本把重构激活插回模型，以原输出和重构输出分布的 Kullback–Leibler 散度加稀疏项训练；端到端加下游版本还匹配后续层激活。重构—稀疏和行为—稀疏 Pareto 前沿用于区分局部保真与功能保真。

**实验验证。** 主实验在 GPT-2 Small 第 6 层前插入含 46,080 个特征的字典，用 40 万段、每段 1,024 词元的 OpenWebText 训练；第 2、10 层及 TinyStories-1M 用于复现。500 段留出 OpenWebText 上报告平均激活特征数 (L_0)、语言模型交叉熵增量、存活特征数、局部/下游均方误差和自动特征可解释性分数。在相同 (L_0) 下，端到端模型的交叉熵增量低于局部模型的 45%；局部模型要使用两倍以上激活特征才能匹配行为。扩大局部字典或训练数据仍未追平，另有随机种子、特征几何和训练时间对照。

**结论与证据。** 直接优化下游输出能找到比局部激活重构更高效地保留模型功能的特征；加入下游状态惩罚后，还能恢复更多原始计算路径而不牺牲该优势。跨模型、层和匹配稀疏度的 Pareto 曲线提供较强比较证据。但这不证明特征具有唯一因果性或人类可理解语义：端到端训练可能对所选输出指标产生 Goodhart 效应，自动解释分数有噪声，实验只覆盖小模型和少数插入层，训练成本也高约 2—3.5 倍。

p_2024_chanin_a_is_for.title: A is for Absorption: Studying Feature Splitting and Absorption in Sparse Autoencoders

abstract.en: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) aim to decompose the activation space of large language models (LLMs) into human-interpretable latent directions or features. As we increase the number of features in the SAE, hierarchical features tend to split into finer features ("math"may split into"algebra","geometry", etc.), a phenomenon referred to as feature splitting. However, we show that sparse decomposition and splitting of hierarchical features is not robust. Specifically, we show that seemingly monosemantic features fail to fire where they should, and instead get"absorbed"into their children features. We coin this phenomenon feature absorption, and show that it is caused by optimizing for sparsity in SAEs whenever the underlying features form a hierarchy. We introduce a metric to detect absorption in SAEs, and validate our findings empirically on hundreds of LLM SAEs. Our investigation suggests that varying SAE sizes or sparsity is insufficient to solve this issue. We discuss the implications of feature absorption in SAEs and some potential approaches to solve the fundamental theoretical issues before SAEs can be used for interpreting LLMs robustly and at scale.
abstract.zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）旨在把大语言模型（LLM）的激活空间分解为人类可解释的潜在方向或特征。随着 SAE 中特征数量增加，层级特征往往会拆分为更细的特征（例如“数学”可能拆分成“代数”“几何”等），这种现象称为特征拆分。然而，我们表明，稀疏分解和层级特征拆分并不稳健。具体而言，看似单义的特征会在本应激活的位置失去响应，反而被其子特征“吸收”。我们把这种现象称为特征吸收，并表明，只要底层特征构成层级结构，SAE 对稀疏性的优化就会导致特征吸收。我们提出一个检测 SAE 特征吸收的指标，并在数百个语言模型 SAE 上经验验证了相关发现。研究结果表明，仅改变 SAE 规模或稀疏度不足以解决该问题。我们讨论了 SAE 特征吸收的影响，以及在 SAE 能够稳健且大规模地用于解释语言模型之前，解决这些基础理论问题的一些潜在方法。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks why sparse autoencoders sometimes fail to expose a concept even when the base model linearly represents and causally uses it. It isolates two failure modes—feature splitting and feature absorption—and asks whether dictionary size or sparsity reliably fixes them.

**Method.** A toy hierarchy shows that a child feature can absorb part of a broader parent feature because activating one mixed latent is cheaper than activating both. In language models, a linear probe predicts the first letter of a single-token English word from residual states; cosine matching and sparse probes locate candidate autoencoder latents. Precision/recall measures splitting, while causal ablation tests absorption: the parent-aligned latent is inactive, but ablating an active child latent removes the parent's logit effect. Latent replacement then attempts to edit one initial letter into another.

**Validation.** The main study uses Gemma-2-2B and Gemma Scope residual-stream autoencoders with 16K or 65K latents across layers and sparsity levels. Independent autoencoders trained for the first eight layers of Qwen2-0.5B and Llama-3.2-1B on 500 million tokens each test architecture generality. Prompts ask the model to output the first letter of a displayed word; data are split 80/20, and evaluation reports probe accuracy, latent precision/recall/F1, correct-letter logit effects under ablation, and edit success. No single latent consistently matches the linear probe; multiple-feature probes recover more information. Low-(L_0) dictionaries favor precision, high-(L_0) dictionaries favor recall, and wider dictionaries can worsen splitting or absorption.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Sparse autoencoders can reconstruct activations well yet obscure a causally used hierarchical feature by distributing it across latents or embedding it in more specific features. Toy optima, causal ablations, edits, and replication across three model families provide substantial evidence that the problem is structural rather than an isolated training failure. The first-letter task is deliberately narrow, absorption thresholds are heuristic and conservative, the relevant signal changes after later Gemma layers, and the paper diagnoses rather than solves the failure mode.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究为何基础模型已经线性表示并因果使用某个概念时，稀疏自编码器仍可能无法显式揭示它。重点区分“特征分裂”和“特征吸收”两种失败，并检验增大字典或改变稀疏度能否可靠解决。

**方法。** 层级玩具模型说明：若激活一个混合的子特征潜变量比同时激活父、子两个潜变量更省稀疏成本，子特征会吸收一部分更宽泛的父特征。在语言模型中，线性探针从残差状态预测单词首字母，余弦匹配和稀疏探针寻找候选自编码器潜变量。精确率/召回率刻画分裂；因果消融识别吸收——父特征对应潜变量未激活，但消融活跃子潜变量会移除父特征对 logit 的作用。潜变量替换还尝试把一个首字母编辑为另一个。

**实验验证。** 主实验使用 Gemma-2-2B 及 Gemma Scope 在多层、多稀疏度下的 16K/65K 残差流自编码器；另在各 5 亿词元上训练 Qwen2-0.5B 和 Llama-3.2-1B 前八层自编码器，检验跨架构性。提示要求模型输出所给单词的首字母，数据按 80/20 划分；指标含探针准确率、潜变量精确率/召回率/F1、消融后的正确字母 logit 效应和编辑成功率。没有单一潜变量能稳定匹配线性探针，多特征探针可恢复更多信息；低 (L_0) 字典偏高精确率，高 (L_0) 偏高召回率，扩大字典有时反而加重分裂或吸收。

**结论与证据。** 稀疏自编码器即使很好地重构激活，也可能通过跨潜变量分散信息，或把宽泛特征嵌入更具体特征，而遮蔽模型因果使用的层级概念。玩具最优解、因果消融、表示编辑及三个模型家族复现，较有力地说明这是结构性问题而非单次训练失败。但首字母任务刻意狭窄，吸收判据依赖启发式阈值且较保守，Gemma 后层相关信号会转移，论文主要诊断问题而未提供解决方案。

p_2024_draguns_unelicitable_backdoors_in.title: Unelicitable Backdoors in Language Models via Cryptographic Transformer Circuits

abstract.en: The rapid proliferation of open-source language models significantly increases the risks of downstream backdoor attacks. These backdoors can introduce dangerous behaviours during model deployment and can evade detection by conventional cybersecurity monitoring systems. In this paper, we introduce a novel class of backdoors in transformer models, that, in contrast to prior art, are unelicitable in nature. Unelicitability prevents the defender from triggering the backdoor, making it impossible to properly evaluate ahead of deployment even if given full white-box access and using automated techniques, such as red-teaming or certain formal verification methods. We show that our novel construction is not only unelicitable thanks to using cryptographic techniques, but also has favourable robustness properties. We confirm these properties in empirical investigations, and provide evidence that our backdoors can withstand state-of-the-art mitigation strategies. Additionally, we expand on previous work by showing that our universal backdoors, while not completely undetectable in white-box settings, can be harder to detect than some existing designs. By demonstrating the feasibility of seamlessly integrating backdoors into transformer models, this paper fundamentally questions the efficacy of pre-deployment detection strategies. This offers new insights into the offence-defence balance in AI safety and security.
abstract.zh: 开源语言模型的迅速普及显著增加了下游后门攻击的风险。这些后门可能在模型部署期间引入危险行为，并逃过常规网络安全监控系统的检测。本文提出 Transformer 模型中的一类新型后门；不同于以往设计，这类后门在本质上无法被诱发。不可诱发性使防御者无法触发后门，因此即使拥有完整白盒访问权限并使用红队测试或某些形式化验证方法等自动化技术，也无法在部署前对其进行适当评估。我们表明，借助密码学技术，我们的新构造不仅不可诱发，而且具有良好的鲁棒性。我们通过经验研究确认这些性质，并给出证据说明该后门能够抵御最先进的缓解策略。此外，我们扩展了此前工作，表明这种通用后门在白盒设置下虽非完全不可检测，却可能比某些现有设计更难发现。本文证明了把后门无缝集成进 Transformer 模型的可行性，从根本上质疑了部署前检测策略的有效性，并为 AI 安全与安保中的攻防平衡提供了新认识。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether a Transformer can contain a precisely implemented backdoor whose malicious behavior is present but computationally infeasible to elicit through prompt search. It separates ordinary password triggers, triggers based on NP-complete search, and cryptographically hidden triggers, and asks which are defeated by input optimization or latent-space adversarial training.

**Method.** Explicit Transformer circuits verify candidate triggers and gate a target behavior. A domain-specific compiler maps register operations into attention and multilayer-perceptron blocks; the cryptographic construction implements hash-style bit operations such as shifts, rotations, Boolean logic, and modular addition. A password circuit checks equality, an NP-complete circuit verifies a 3-SAT witness, and an encrypted circuit checks a hash preimage. Complexity arguments relate trigger discovery to the underlying search problem.

**Validation.** Constructed backdoors are attacked with gradient-based input optimization and latent adversarial training (LAT), which directly optimizes hidden states. Password locks are recoverable; 3-SAT resists input-space attacks but is elicited by LAT. The encrypted circuit remains unelicited during up to (10^4) LAT optimization steps across repeated runs and noise settings. Because a full SHA-256 circuit is expensive, the principal LAT experiment uses a weakened two-round SHA-style hash rather than all 64 rounds; auxiliary circuit checks verify gate behavior and noise sensitivity.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Elicitation difficulty can be engineered independently of whether a dangerous behavior exists: moving from password to NP-complete and cryptographic triggers defeats progressively stronger search procedures. Constructive circuits, attack comparisons, and the conditional cryptographic argument provide strong existence evidence, but not evidence that naturally trained language models contain such backdoors. The evaluated encrypted primitive is deliberately weakened, asymptotic security assumptions do not guarantee practical parameters, and compiled modules may be detectable or removable through weight inspection, fine-tuning, noise, provenance controls, or anomaly detection even when prompting cannot activate them.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究 Transformer 是否能包含一种精确实现的后门：恶意行为确实存在，但通过提示搜索在计算上难以触发。研究区分普通密码触发、基于 NP 完全搜索的触发和密码学隐藏触发，并检验输入优化或潜空间对抗训练能攻破哪一类。

**方法。** 显式 Transformer 电路验证候选触发并控制目标行为。一个领域专用编译器把寄存器操作映射为注意力和多层感知机模块；密码学构造实现移位、循环移位、布尔逻辑和模加等哈希位运算。密码电路检查字符串相等，NP 完全电路验证 3-SAT 见证，加密电路检查哈希原像；复杂度论证把发现触发条件归约到相应搜索问题。

**实验验证。** 构造的后门接受基于梯度的输入优化和直接优化隐藏状态的潜对抗训练（Latent Adversarial Training, LAT）攻击。密码锁可以恢复；3-SAT 能抵抗输入空间攻击，却可被 LAT 触发；加密电路在多次运行和噪声设置下经历最多 (10^4) 步 LAT 仍未被触发。由于完整 SHA-256 电路代价高，主要 LAT 实验使用弱化的两轮 SHA 风格哈希，而非全部 64 轮；辅助电路测试检查逻辑门正确性与噪声敏感性。

**结论与证据。** 危险行为是否存在，可以与它能否被轻易触发分离：从密码、NP 完全到密码学触发，逐级击败更强搜索。显式构造、攻击对比和有条件密码学论证为“这种后门可以存在”提供强证据，但不能说明自然训练的语言模型已有此类后门。实验中的加密原语被刻意弱化，渐近安全假设不保证具体参数安全，而且即使提示无法触发，编译模块仍可能通过权重检查、微调、噪声、来源控制或异常检测被发现和移除。

p_2024_dunefsky_transcoders_find_interpr.title: Transcoders Find Interpretable LLM Feature Circuits
p_2024_dunefsky_transcoders_find_interpr.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2024)

abstract.en: A key goal in mechanistic interpretability is circuit analysis: finding sparse subgraphs of models corresponding to specific behaviors or capabilities. However, MLP sublayers make fine-grained circuit analysis on transformer-based language models difficult. In particular, interpretable features -- such as those found by sparse autoencoders (SAEs) -- are typically linear combinations of extremely many neurons, each with its own nonlinearity to account for. Circuit analysis in this setting thus either yields intractably large circuits or fails to disentangle local and global behavior. To address this we explore transcoders, which seek to faithfully approximate a densely activating MLP layer with a wider, sparsely-activating MLP layer. We introduce a novel method for using transcoders to perform weights-based circuit analysis through MLP sublayers. The resulting circuits neatly factorize into input-dependent and input-invariant terms. We then successfully train transcoders on language models with 120M, 410M, and 1.4B parameters, and find them to perform at least on par with SAEs in terms of sparsity, faithfulness, and human-interpretability. Finally, we apply transcoders to reverse-engineer unknown circuits in the model, and we obtain novel insights regarding the "greater-than circuit" in GPT2-small. Our results suggest that transcoders can prove effective in decomposing model computations involving MLPs into interpretable circuits. Code is available at https://github.com/jacobdunefsky/transcoder_circuits/.
abstract.zh: 机制可解释性的一个关键目标是回路分析，即寻找与特定行为或能力对应的模型稀疏子图。然而，MLP 子层使基于 Transformer 的语言模型难以进行细粒度回路分析。特别是，稀疏自编码器（SAE）发现的可解释特征通常是数量极多的神经元的线性组合，而每个神经元还各自具有需要考虑的非线性。因此，这种设置下的回路分析要么产生大到难以处理的回路，要么无法解耦局部行为与全局行为。为解决该问题，我们研究 transcoder；它试图使用更宽、稀疏激活的 MLP 层忠实近似一个稠密激活的 MLP 层。我们提出一种使用 transcoder 对穿过 MLP 子层的计算进行基于权重的回路分析的新方法，所得回路可以整齐地分解为依赖输入和不随输入变化的两类项。随后，我们在参数量为 1.2 亿、4.1 亿和 14 亿的语言模型上成功训练 transcoder，并发现其稀疏性、忠实性和人类可解释性至少与 SAE 相当。最后，我们应用 transcoder 对模型中的未知回路进行逆向工程，并获得了有关 GPT2-small“大于”回路的新认识。结果表明，transcoder 可以有效地把涉及 MLP 的模型计算分解为可解释回路。代码见 https://github.com/jacobdunefsky/transcoder_circuits/。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks how to obtain sparse, interpretable circuits through nonlinear multilayer perceptron (MLP) sublayers. Sparse autoencoder features are distributed over many MLP neurons, so the study tests whether a sparse surrogate that maps MLP inputs directly to outputs can expose both input-specific and input-invariant feature connections.

**Method.** A transcoder is a wide one-hidden-layer rectified-linear network trained to reproduce an original MLP's output from its input with an (L_1) activation penalty. Because both encoder and decoder are linear around sparse feature activations, feature-to-feature attributions through MLPs factor into an activation-dependent term and a weight-only connection. Attention value/output paths and de-embedding scores extend this into a greedy feature-circuit tracing algorithm.

**Validation.** Transcoders and sparse autoencoders are trained on GPT-2 Small, Pythia-410M, and Pythia-1.4B and evaluated on the same 3.2 million OpenWebText tokens using mean active features and next-token cross-entropy increase after module replacement. Their sparsity–fidelity Pareto frontier is equal to or better than the autoencoder frontier. A blinded human inspection compares 50 random Pythia transcoder features with 50 autoencoder features. Nine blind GPT-2 circuit case studies infer feature semantics without viewing source tokens. On 100 “year greater-than” prompts, zero-ablation shows that a handful of layer-10 transcoder features recover most surrogate performance more compactly than the top MLP neurons, and the traced paths reproduce known attention-head structure.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Transcoders provide an interpretable sparse approximation of MLP computation and make weight-level feature circuits tractable without an observed interpretability or fidelity penalty relative to sparse autoencoders. Matched quantitative comparisons, blinded feature reading, and causal ablation in a known circuit provide moderate-to-strong support. The surrogate does not fully recover the original model, the autoencoder learning rate was not separately optimized, only a few qualitative circuits were analyzed, and approximation error can omit behaviorally important computation.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究如何穿过非线性的多层感知机（Multilayer Perceptron, MLP）子层得到稀疏、可解释的电路。由于稀疏自编码器特征分布在大量 MLP 神经元上，研究检验直接从 MLP 输入映射到输出的稀疏替代模块，能否同时揭示输入相关和输入无关的特征连接。

**方法。** 转码器（transcoder）是一个宽的单隐层 ReLU 网络，以 MLP 输入预测原 MLP 输出，并加入 (L_1) 激活稀疏惩罚。借助稀疏特征两侧的线性编码/解码，穿过 MLP 的特征归因可分解为激活相关项与只由权重决定的连接项；再结合注意力值/输出路径和反嵌入分数，形成贪心特征电路追踪算法。

**实验验证。** 在 GPT-2 Small、Pythia-410M 和 Pythia-1.4B 上训练转码器与稀疏自编码器，并在相同的 320 万 OpenWebText 词元上，以平均活跃特征数和替换模块后的下一词元交叉熵增量评测；转码器的稀疏—保真 Pareto 前沿不差于自编码器。盲评由人工比较 50 个随机 Pythia 转码器特征和 50 个自编码器特征；9 个 GPT-2 盲电路案例在不看原词元的情况下推断语义。100 条“年份大于”提示上，零消融显示少数第 10 层转码器特征比高方差 MLP 神经元更紧凑地恢复替代模型表现，追踪路径也复现已知注意力头结构。

**结论与证据。** 转码器能以可解释的稀疏近似表示 MLP 计算，并使权重级特征电路可追踪，相对稀疏自编码器未观察到解释性或保真度代价。匹配量化比较、盲特征解读和已知电路中的因果消融提供中到强证据。但替代模块未完全恢复原模型，自编码器学习率没有单独优化，电路分析仅含少数定性案例，而且近似误差可能遗漏行为关键计算。

p_2024_ferrando_information_flow_routes.title: Information Flow Routes: Automatically Interpreting Language Models at Scale
p_2024_ferrando_information_flow_routes.venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing

abstract.en: Information flows by routes inside the network via mechanisms implemented in the model. These routes can be represented as graphs where nodes correspond to token representations and edges to computations. We automatically build these graphs in a top-down manner, for each prediction leaving only the most important nodes and edges. In contrast to the existing workflows relying on activation patching, we do this through attribution: this allows us to efficiently uncover existing circuits with just a single forward pass. Unlike with patching, we do not need a human to carefully design prediction templates, and we can extract information flow routes for any prediction (not just the ones among the allowed templates). As a result, we can analyze model behavior in general, for specific types of predictions, or different domains. We experiment with Llama 2 and show that some attention head roles are overall important, e.g. previous token heads and subword merging heads. Next, we find similarities in Llama 2 behavior when handling tokens of the same part of speech. Finally, we show that some model components can be specialized on domains such as coding or multilingual texts.
abstract.zh: 信息沿着由模型内部机制实现的路径在网络中流动。这些路径可以表示为图，其中节点对应 token 表征，边对应计算。我们针对每次预测，以自上而下的方式自动构建这些图，只保留最重要的节点和边。不同于依赖激活修补的现有工作流，我们通过归因完成这一过程，因此只需一次前向传播即可高效发现已有回路。与修补方法不同，我们不需要人工精心设计预测模板，并且能为任意预测提取信息流路径，而不限于允许模板中的预测。因此，我们可以从整体上分析模型行为，也可以针对特定预测类型或不同领域展开分析。我们在 Llama 2 上进行实验，发现某些注意力头角色总体上很重要，例如前一 token 注意力头和子词合并注意力头。随后，我们发现 Llama 2 在处理词性相同的 token 时具有相似行为。最后，我们表明，一些模型组件可能专门处理编程或多语言文本等特定领域。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether important computation paths for arbitrary next-token predictions can be extracted without the costly contrastive templates and repeated interventions required by activation patching. It also asks what such routes reveal about generally important heads, token-type processing, and domain-specific components in larger language models.

**Method.** An information-flow graph treats residual states as nodes and attention, feed-forward, and residual updates as edges. Linearized layer normalization and value/output decomposition split each attention output into source-token/head subedges. An attribution score measures each edge's contribution to the destination representation, and a top-down thresholding procedure recursively keeps the important subgraph from a selected prediction. Route frequencies aggregate explanations across examples.

**Validation.** On GPT-2 Small and OPT-125M, routes for Indirect Object Identification (IOI) and year “greater-than” prompts recover previously reported task-specific heads while separating them from generic previous-token heads; changing the greater-than corruption from 01 to 00 shows why contrastive baselines alter patching results. For a 50-example IOI batch, route extraction takes 5 seconds versus 8 minutes for patching-based Automated Circuit Discovery. Llama-2-7B is then analyzed on 1,000 C4 sentences using part-of-speech and subword labels, and on 1,000 examples each from C4, FLORES-200 English/Russian/Italian/Spanish, CodeParrot, and arithmetic data to identify previous-token, subword-merging, language-, code-, and arithmetic-specialized components.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Attribution-derived routes offer a roughly 100-fold faster, template-free view of all components contributing to a prediction and scale to broad domain comparisons. Agreement with known circuits and coherent specialization patterns support the method as an exploratory map. The scores are linearized local attributions rather than causal necessity tests; threshold choices affect graphs, feed-forward blocks remain coarse, and qualitative agreement or activation frequency does not establish that retained routes are sufficient or uniquely mechanistic.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究能否不依赖激活修补所需的对比模板和反复干预，就为任意下一词元预测提取重要计算路径；并进一步考察这些路径能揭示哪些普遍重要的注意力头、词元类型处理规律和领域专用组件。

**方法。** 信息流图把残差状态视为节点，把注意力、前馈网络和残差更新视为边。通过线性化层归一化及分解值/输出矩阵，每个注意力输出被拆成来源词元—注意力头子边；归因分数衡量每条边对目标表示的贡献，自顶向下阈值算法从目标预测递归保留重要子图，跨样本的路径出现频率用于汇总规律。

**实验验证。** GPT-2 Small 和 OPT-125M 上，间接宾语识别（Indirect Object Identification, IOI）及年份“大于”任务的路径找回已报道的任务专用注意力头，同时把它们与通用前一词元头分开；把“大于”任务反事实从 01 改成 00，显示对比基线会改变修补结论。50 条 IOI 样本上，路径提取用时 5 秒，而基于修补的自动电路发现需 8 分钟。随后在 Llama-2-7B 的 1,000 条 C4 句子上按词性和子词分析，并分别使用 C4、FLORES-200 英/俄/意/西语、CodeParrot 和算术数据各 1,000 条，定位前一词元、子词合并、语言、代码和算术专用组件。

**结论与证据。** 基于归因的路径能以约百倍速度、无需模板地展示对预测有贡献的全部组件，并扩展到广泛领域比较。与已知电路吻合及连贯的专门化模式支持其作为探索性地图。但这些分数是线性化局部归因，不是因果必要性检验；阈值会影响图，前馈块仍很粗粒度，而定性一致或高出现频率不能证明保留路径足够解释行为或具有唯一机制。

p_2024_ghandeharioun_patchscopes_a_unify.title: Patchscopes: A Unifying Framework for Inspecting Hidden Representations of Language Models

abstract.en: Understanding the internal representations of large language models (LLMs) can help explain models' behavior and verify their alignment with human values. Given the capabilities of LLMs in generating human-understandable text, we propose leveraging the model itself to explain its internal representations in natural language. We introduce a framework called Patchscopes and show how it can be used to answer a wide range of questions about an LLM's computation. We show that many prior interpretability methods based on projecting representations into the vocabulary space and intervening on the LLM computation can be viewed as instances of this framework. Moreover, several of their shortcomings such as failure in inspecting early layers or lack of expressivity can be mitigated by Patchscopes. Beyond unifying prior inspection techniques, Patchscopes also opens up new possibilities such as using a more capable model to explain the representations of a smaller model, and multihop reasoning error correction.
abstract.zh: 理解大语言模型（LLM）的内部表征，有助于解释模型行为并验证其是否与人类价值观一致。鉴于语言模型能够生成人类可理解的文本，我们提出利用模型自身，以自然语言解释其内部表征。我们引入名为 Patchscopes 的框架，并展示如何用它回答有关语言模型计算的广泛问题。我们说明，许多把表征投影到词汇空间并干预语言模型计算的既有可解释性方法，都可以视为这一框架的实例。此外，Patchscopes 可以缓解这些方法的若干缺陷，例如无法检查早期层或表达能力不足。Patchscopes 不仅统一了以往的检查技术，还带来新的可能性，例如使用能力更强的模型解释较小模型的表征，以及纠正多跳推理错误。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether vocabulary projection, probing, and activation interventions can be unified as a single operation that decodes hidden states through a language model's own computation. It further asks whether changing the target prompt or model can make early-layer inspection more expressive and can repair latent multi-hop reasoning errors.

**Method.** A Patchscope takes a source state (h_i^\ell), maps it with (f), and replaces a state at position (i^*), layer (ell^*), in a target model running target prompt (T). Choices of (T,i^*,f,M^*,ell^*) recover logit lens, tuned lens, probing-related lenses, and causal interventions. New configurations use few-shot token-identity prompts, relation-specific prompts, natural-language entity-description prompts, affine cross-model mappings, and a chain-of-thought patch that reroutes an intermediate answer without emitting the reasoning chain.

**Validation.** Next-token decoding uses LLaMA-2-13B, Vicuna-13B, GPT-J-6B, and Pythia-12B with 10,000 Pile examples for tuned mappings and 2,000 for evaluation; precision@1 and surprisal show the token-identity Patchscope outperforming baselines from layer 10 onward, with gains up to 98% in layers 18–22. On GPT-J, 1,453 WikiText-103 contexts across 12 factual/commonsense relations evaluate attribute accuracy; the training-free method significantly beats logistic probes on 6 tasks and is comparable on 5. Entity resolution is assessed with Rouge-1, Rouge-L, and Sentence-BERT, while cross-model patching reaches precision up to 0.7 for Vicuna and 0.8 for Pythia. Of 1,104 two-hop queries, 46 meet the controlled prerequisite that both hops work separately; patching solves 50%, versus 35.71% for chain-of-thought and 19.57% for direct generation.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Hidden-state inspection can be expressed as targeted representation transfer, and letting a model continue computation often decodes information more flexibly than direct projection. Multi-model quantitative comparisons and a causal multi-hop repair demonstrate genuine utility. Evidence for a universal interpretability framework is conceptual rather than proof of faithful explanation: outputs can reflect target-prompt priors or placeholder contamination, attribute data are filtered to facts already generatable by the model, and the multi-hop result rests on only 46 selected cases.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究词表投影、探针和激活干预能否统一为一种利用语言模型自身计算来解码隐藏状态的操作；并进一步考察改变目标提示或目标模型，能否让早层检查更有表达力，以及能否修复潜在的多跳推理错误。

**方法。** Patchscope 取来源状态 (h_i^\ell)，经映射 (f) 后替换目标模型运行目标提示 (T) 时在位置 (i^*)、层 (ell^*) 的状态。不同的 (T,i^*,f,M^*,ell^*) 选择可涵盖 logit lens、tuned lens、探针相关透镜和因果干预。新配置包括少样本词元恒等提示、关系提示、自然语言实体描述提示、跨模型仿射映射，以及把中间答案改接到下一步而不显式生成推理链的思维链修补。

**实验验证。** 下一词元解码覆盖 LLaMA-2-13B、Vicuna-13B、GPT-J-6B 和 Pythia-12B，用 10,000 条 Pile 样本训练 tuned 映射、2,000 条评测；precision@1 与惊讶度显示词元恒等 Patchscope 从第 10 层起优于基线，在第 18—22 层最高提升 98%。GPT-J 上使用 12 种事实/常识关系、共 1,453 个 WikiText-103 上下文评测属性准确率；无训练方法在 6 项显著优于逻辑探针、5 项相当。实体解析用 Rouge-1、Rouge-L 和 Sentence-BERT 评价，跨模型修补在 Vicuna/Pythia 上最高 precision 分别约 0.7/0.8。1,104 条双跳查询中，46 条满足两步单独都能回答的控制条件；修补准确率 50%，思维链为 35.71%，直接生成 19.57%。

**结论与证据。** 隐藏状态检查可以表述为定向表示迁移，让模型继续计算往往比直接投影更灵活地解码信息。多模型量化比较和因果性多跳修复证明了实用性。但“统一框架”的证据主要是概念统一而非忠实解释证明：输出可能受目标提示先验或占位符污染影响，属性数据筛选为模型本来就能生成的事实，多跳结果也只基于 46 个选择样本。
