p_2024_hanna_have_faith_in.title: Have Faith in Faithfulness: Going Beyond Circuit Overlap When Finding Model Mechanisms

abstract.en: Many recent language model (LM) interpretability studies have adopted the circuits framework, which aims to find the minimal computational subgraph, or circuit, that explains LM behavior on a given task. Most studies determine which edges belong in a LM's circuit by performing causal interventions on each edge independently, but this scales poorly with model size. Edge attribution patching (EAP), gradient-based approximation to interventions, has emerged as a scalable but imperfect solution to this problem. In this paper, we introduce a new method - EAP with integrated gradients (EAP-IG) - that aims to better maintain a core property of circuits: faithfulness. A circuit is faithful if all model edges outside the circuit can be ablated without changing the model's performance on the task; faithfulness is what justifies studying circuits, rather than the full model. Our experiments demonstrate that circuits found using EAP are less faithful than those found using EAP-IG, even though both have high node overlap with circuits found previously using causal interventions. We conclude more generally that when using circuits to compare the mechanisms models use to solve tasks, faithfulness, not overlap, is what should be measured.
abstract.zh: 近期许多语言模型（LM）可解释性研究采用回路框架，其目标是找出能够解释语言模型在特定任务上行为的最小计算子图，即回路。大多数研究通过分别对每条边进行因果干预来判断它是否属于语言模型回路，但这种方法难以随模型规模扩展。边归因修补（EAP）是对干预的梯度近似，已成为解决该问题的一种可扩展但并不完美的方案。本文提出一种新方法——采用积分梯度的 EAP（EAP-IG），旨在更好地维持回路的一项核心属性：忠实性。如果消融回路之外的所有模型边都不会改变模型在该任务上的表现，那么这个回路就是忠实的；正是忠实性使研究回路而非完整模型具有合理性。实验表明，尽管 EAP 与 EAP-IG 找到的回路都与此前使用因果干预发现的回路具有很高的节点重叠度，但 EAP 找到的回路不如 EAP-IG 找到的回路忠实。更一般地说，我们的结论是：使用回路比较模型解决任务所采用的机制时，应当衡量的是忠实性，而不是重叠度。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks how automated circuit-finding methods should be judged when overlap with a published circuit does not guarantee preservation of model behavior. It tests whether integrated gradients can improve Edge Attribution Patching (EAP), and whether circuit overlap predicts faithfulness within or across tasks.

**Method.** Circuit faithfulness is measured by ablating every graph edge outside a selected subgraph and normalizing the retained task performance between corrupted and full-model baselines. EAP with Integrated Gradients (EAP-IG) averages edge gradients along a path from corrupted to clean activations before ranking absolute edge scores; a greedy search forms circuits of varying size. Activation-patching circuits, ordinary EAP, variants, and overlap metrics provide comparisons.

**Validation.** GPT-2 Small experiments span six tasks, including Indirect Object Identification (IOI), greater-than, subject–verb agreement, gender bias, hypernymy, and capital–country; logit or probability differences define behavior. EAP-IG uses five integration steps after sweeps show three or more are usually sufficient. It improves faithfulness over EAP across tasks and retrieves the manual greater-than circuit with better node/edge precision–recall, although on IOI both EAP variants plateau around 0.6 faithfulness while activation patching exceeds 0.8. A circuit containing at least 90% of the manual IOI nodes can still have 0% faithfulness; cross-task overlap is similarly unreliable except at extremes. Replications on GPT-2 XL and Pythia-2.8B use 100 examples per task and preserve the EAP-IG advantage.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Behavioral faithfulness must be tested directly; moderate node or edge overlap is not a dependable proxy for sharing a mechanism. Integrated-gradient scoring is a low-cost improvement over first-order EAP, but does not uniformly match exact patching. Six-task comparisons, explicit outside-circuit ablations, overlap counterexamples, and larger-model replications strongly support the methodological conclusion. Faithfulness alone does not guarantee completeness or uniqueness, depends on the corruption and task metric, and becomes expensive to compute as graphs grow.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究当“与已发表电路重合”不能保证保留模型行为时，应如何评价自动电路发现；具体检验积分梯度能否改进边归因修补（Edge Attribution Patching, EAP），以及电路重合度能否预测同任务或跨任务保真度。

**方法。** 电路保真度通过消融所选子图之外的全部计算图边，并在污染基线与完整模型表现之间归一化剩余任务性能来衡量。积分梯度边归因修补（EAP with Integrated Gradients, EAP-IG）沿污染激活到干净激活的路径平均边梯度，再按绝对边分数排序；贪心搜索形成不同规模电路。精确激活修补、普通 EAP、若干变体及重合指标用于比较。

**实验验证。** GPT-2 Small 上覆盖 6 项任务，包括间接宾语识别（Indirect Object Identification, IOI）、大于判断、主谓一致、性别偏见、上下位词和首都—国家，以 logit 差或概率差衡量行为。步数扫描表明通常 3 步以上即可，主实验采用 5 步。EAP-IG 跨任务比 EAP 更保真，并以更好的节点/边精确率—召回率恢复人工“大于”电路；但 IOI 中二者约停在 0.6，精确修补超过 0.8。包含人工 IOI 电路至少 90% 节点的子图仍可能是 0% 保真，跨任务中除极端情况外重合度同样不可靠。GPT-2 XL 与 Pythia-2.8B 上每任务 100 样本的复现保留了 EAP-IG 优势。

**结论与证据。** 行为保真度必须直接检验，中等节点或边重合不是共享机制的可靠代理。积分梯度是相对一阶 EAP 的低成本改进，但不能稳定达到精确修补。六任务比较、子图外消融、重合反例和大模型复现强力支持该方法学结论。不过保真不保证完整性或唯一性，并依赖污染方式和任务指标；随着图规模增长，保真评测本身也很昂贵。

p_2024_he_dictionary_learning_improves.title: Dictionary Learning Improves Patch-Free Circuit Discovery in Mechanistic Interpretability: A Case Study on Othello-GPT

abstract.en: Sparse dictionary learning has been a rapidly growing technique in mechanistic interpretability to attack superposition and extract more human-understandable features from model activations. We ask a further question based on the extracted more monosemantic features: How do we recognize circuits connecting the enormous amount of dictionary features? We propose a circuit discovery framework alternative to activation patching. Our framework suffers less from out-of-distribution and proves to be more efficient in terms of asymptotic complexity. The basic unit in our framework is dictionary features decomposed from all modules writing to the residual stream, including embedding, attention output and MLP output. Starting from any logit, dictionary feature or attention score, we manage to trace down to lower-level dictionary features of all tokens and compute their contribution to these more interpretable and local model behaviors. We dig in a small transformer trained on a synthetic task named Othello and find a number of human-understandable fine-grained circuits inside of it.
abstract.zh: 稀疏字典学习正在迅速成为机制可解释性中的重要技术，用于处理叠加现象并从模型激活中提取更易于人类理解的特征。基于所提取的、单义性更强的特征，我们进一步提出一个问题：如何识别连接海量字典特征的回路？我们提出一个可替代激活修补的回路发现框架。该框架较少受到分布外问题的影响，并且在渐近复杂度方面更为高效。框架的基本单元是从所有向残差流写入信息的模块中分解出的字典特征，这些模块包括嵌入、注意力输出和 MLP 输出。从任意 logit、字典特征或注意力分数出发，我们都能向下追踪到所有 token 的底层字典特征，并计算它们对这些更具可解释性、更局部的模型行为所作的贡献。我们深入研究了一个在名为 Othello 的合成任务上训练的小型 Transformer，并在其中发现了多个可由人类理解的细粒度回路。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether dictionary learning can replace feature-level activation patching when discovering Transformer circuits. It specifically seeks a decomposition that traces output/value and query/key computations from logits or high-level features back to lower-level interpretable features, then tests the framework on a learned Othello world model.

**Method.** Sparse dictionaries are trained separately on embeddings and every attention or multilayer-perceptron output that writes to the residual stream. Linearized layer normalization decomposes an output/value contribution into lower-feature activations and weight-defined connections; query/key attention scores are decomposed into source–destination feature pairs. For nonlinear multilayer perceptron (MLP)s, approximate direct contribution uses local attribution. Recursive selection of the largest terms yields a patch-free feature circuit.

**Validation.** A six-layer, 1.2M-parameter Othello-GPT with 128-dimensional states and 512-unit MLPs is trained on about (10^9) game sequences and reaches 99.5% legal-move prediction performance. Each dictionary maps 128 dimensions through 1,024 latent features. Top-activating-board statistics recover unsupervised “mine,” “opponent,” empty-square, move, and flipped-piece features previously found by probes. Case studies trace a local board-state feature through specific attention heads, decompose “attend to mine/theirs” query/key scores, and trace three consecutive moves into an early-MLP flipped-piece feature; head-level output/value contributions account for roughly 105–113% in the highlighted paths.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Dictionary features plus algebraic attribution can expose coherent Othello circuits without running a separate patch for every feature edge, and recover both known state variables and previously implicit information-flow structure. The evidence is detailed but mainly case-based: the paper explicitly does not claim a universal Othello circuit, dictionaries have about 75% dead latents and late-layer (L_0) can approach the 128-dimensional state size, nonlinear MLP attribution is approximate, and no real language-model circuit or systematic causal sufficiency test is reported.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究字典学习能否在发现 Transformer 电路时替代特征级激活修补；具体希望把 logit 或高层特征的输出/值与查询/键计算追溯到低层可解释特征，并在学得 Othello 世界模型上验证该框架。

**方法。** 研究分别在嵌入以及每个写入残差流的注意力或多层感知机输出上训练稀疏字典。线性化层归一化把输出/值贡献分解为低层特征激活与权重连接，查询/键注意力分数则分解为来源—目标特征对；对非线性 MLP 使用近似直接贡献进行局部归因。递归保留最大贡献项可得到无需修补的特征电路。

**实验验证。** 六层、120 万参数的 Othello-GPT 使用 128 维状态和 512 单元 MLP，在约 (10^9) 局游戏序列上训练，合法走子预测达到 99.5%。每个字典把 128 维映射到 1,024 个潜在特征；基于最高激活棋盘的统计，无监督恢复此前探针发现的“己方/对方”、空格、落子和翻转棋子特征。案例追踪局部棋盘状态经特定注意力头形成，分解“关注己方/对方”的查询/键分数，并把连续三步落子追到早层 MLP 的翻转特征；高亮路径中单个注意力头的输出/值贡献约占总量 105%—113%。

**结论与证据。** 字典特征结合代数归因，能在不逐边修补的情况下展示连贯的 Othello 电路，并恢复已知状态变量及过去未显式呈现的信息流结构。证据细致但主要是案例：论文明确不宣称得到通用 Othello 电路，字典约 75% 潜变量死亡，晚层 (L_0) 可接近 128 维状态大小，非线性 MLP 归因只是近似，也没有真实语言模型电路或系统性因果充分性测试。

p_2024_he_llama_scope_extracting.title: Llama Scope: Extracting Millions of Features from Llama-3.1-8B with Sparse Autoencoders

abstract.en: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a powerful unsupervised method for extracting sparse representations from language models, yet scalable training remains a significant challenge. We introduce a suite of 256 SAEs, trained on each layer and sublayer of the Llama-3.1-8B-Base model, with 32K and 128K features. Modifications to a state-of-the-art SAE variant, Top-K SAEs, are evaluated across multiple dimensions. In particular, we assess the generalizability of SAEs trained on base models to longer contexts and fine-tuned models. Additionally, we analyze the geometry of learned SAE latents, confirming that \emph{feature splitting} enables the discovery of new features. The Llama Scope SAE checkpoints are publicly available at~\url{https://huggingface.co/fnlp/Llama-Scope}, alongside our scalable training, interpretation, and visualization tools at \url{https://github.com/OpenMOSS/Language-Model-SAEs}. These contributions aim to advance the open-source Sparse Autoencoder ecosystem and support mechanistic interpretability research by reducing the need for redundant SAE training.
abstract.zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）已成为从语言模型中提取稀疏表征的强大无监督方法，但可扩展训练仍是一项重大挑战。我们推出一套包含 256 个 SAE 的资源，它们分别在 Llama-3.1-8B-Base 模型的每一层和子层上训练，特征数量为 32K 或 128K。我们从多个维度评估了对先进 SAE 变体 Top-K SAE 的修改。特别是，我们评估在基础模型上训练的 SAE 对更长上下文和微调模型的泛化能力。此外，我们分析所学 SAE 潜变量的几何结构，确认特征拆分能够发现新特征。Llama Scope 的 SAE 检查点公开于 https://huggingface.co/fnlp/Llama-Scope；可扩展训练、解释和可视化工具见 https://github.com/OpenMOSS/Language-Model-SAEs。这些贡献旨在推动开源稀疏自编码器生态发展，并通过减少重复训练 SAE 的需要来支持机制可解释性研究。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether sparse autoencoders (SAEs) can be trained comprehensively across every major activation site of an 8B-parameter language model, which training design gives the best sparsity–fidelity trade-off, and whether the learned dictionaries generalize to longer contexts and instruction-tuned variants.

**Method.** Llama Scope trains Top-(K) and vanilla SAEs at the post-multilayer perceptron (MLP) residual stream, attention output, MLP output, and transcoder site in all 32 Llama-3.1-8B layers, with 32K and 128K dictionaries. The Top-(K) recipe incorporates decoder-column norms into selection, anneals (K) during early training, and converts the model post hoc to independent JumpReLU thresholds. Input/output norm normalization and mixed parallelism support consistent large-scale training.

**Validation.** The 256 SAEs are trained on SlimPajama activations and evaluated on 50 million held-out tokens using latent (L_0), explained variance, and language-model loss increase after insertion. Across layers, sites, and widths, Top-(K) models reduce typical (L_0) from about 150 to 50 while matching or improving fidelity; 128K dictionaries improve reconstruction at matched sparsity. GPT-4o labels and scores 768 randomly selected features from layers 7, 15, and 23, followed by manual checking; about 10% are judged uninterpretable and Top-(K) is not worse than vanilla. Additional tests extend sequence length and insert base-model SAEs into instruction-tuned models, with substantial degradation mainly at the last residual site.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Industrial-scale, layer-complete SAE dictionaries can be trained with favorable reconstruction/sparsity metrics and reused across nearby deployment conditions, providing an open feature basis for subsequent analysis. The broad held-out evaluation strongly supports engineering scalability, but not the causal or unique validity of every feature. Automated labels inspect only top activations, downstream circuit usefulness is not tested, feature splitting complicates ontology, and fidelity metrics can reward reconstructions that remain hard to interpret.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究能否在 80 亿参数语言模型的每类主要激活位置上系统训练稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoder, SAE），哪种训练设计具有更好的稀疏—保真权衡，以及所得字典能否泛化到更长上下文和指令微调模型。

**方法。** Llama Scope 在 Llama-3.1-8B 的 32 层上，分别对 多层感知机（Multilayer Perceptron, MLP） 后残差流、注意力输出、MLP 输出和转码器位置训练 Top-(K) 与普通 SAE，字典宽度为 32K 或 128K。Top-(K) 配方把解码列范数纳入选择，训练早期逐步退火 (K)，训练后再转换为各特征独立阈值的 JumpReLU；输入/输出范数归一化和混合并行支持大规模一致训练。

**实验验证。** 256 个 SAE 用 SlimPajama 激活训练，在 5,000 万留出词元上以潜变量 (L_0)、解释方差和插入 SAE 后的语言模型损失增量评测。跨层、位置和宽度，Top-(K) 把典型 (L_0) 从约 150 降到 50，同时持平或改善保真度；128K 字典在相同稀疏度下重构更好。GPT-4o 对第 7、15、23 层随机抽取的 768 个特征生成标签和评分，并由人工复核；约 10% 不可解释，Top-(K) 不差于普通 SAE。另测试更长序列，并把基础模型 SAE 插入指令微调模型，明显退化主要发生在最后残差位置。

**结论与证据。** 可以为工业规模模型训练覆盖全层的 SAE 字典，并在重构—稀疏指标上取得良好结果，且能在相近部署条件间复用，为后续分析提供开放特征基底。大规模留出评测强力支持工程可扩展性，但不能证明每个特征都具有因果性或唯一性。自动标签只看最高激活，下游电路用途尚未验证，特征分裂会扰乱本体，而保真指标也可能奖励仍难解释的重构。

p_2024_hinck_why_do_llava.title: Why do LLaVA Vision-Language Models Reply to Images in English?
p_2024_hinck_why_do_llava.venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing

abstract.en: We uncover a surprising multilingual bias occurring in a popular class of multimodal vision-language models (VLMs). Including an image in the query to a LLaVA-style VLM significantly increases the likelihood of the model returning an English response, regardless of the language of the query. This paper investigates the causes of this loss with a two-pronged approach that combines extensive ablation of the design space with a mechanistic analysis of the models' internal representations of image and text inputs. Both approaches indicate that the issue stems in the language modelling component of the LLaVA model. Statistically, we find that switching the language backbone for a bilingual language model has the strongest effect on reducing this error. Mechanistically, we provide compelling evidence that visual inputs are not mapped to a similar space as text ones, and that intervening on intermediary attention layers can reduce this bias. Our findings provide important insights to researchers and engineers seeking to understand the crossover between multimodal and multilingual spaces, and contribute to the goal of developing capable and inclusive VLMs for non-English contexts.
abstract.zh: 我们揭示了一个出现在常见多模态视觉语言模型（VLM）类别中的意外多语言偏差：向 LLaVA 风格视觉语言模型的查询中加入图像，会显著提高模型用英语回答的概率，而无论查询使用什么语言。本文采用双管齐下的方法调查这种能力损失的原因：一方面对设计空间开展大规模消融，另一方面从机制层面分析模型对图像和文本输入的内部表征。两种方法都表明，问题源自 LLaVA 模型的语言建模组件。从统计结果看，把语言骨干替换为双语语言模型，对减少这一错误的作用最强。从机制角度看，我们提供了有力证据，说明视觉输入并未映射到与文本输入相似的空间，而对中间注意力层进行干预可以减少这种偏差。我们的发现为希望理解多模态空间与多语言空间交叉关系的研究者和工程师提供了重要认识，也有助于面向非英语环境开发能力强且具有包容性的视觉语言模型。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks why adding a language-agnostic image to a non-English query makes LLaVA-style vision–language models more likely to answer in English. It separates effects of the language backbone, vision encoder, and training-data language, then asks where image-induced fidelity loss is represented and whether a training-free intervention can reduce it.

**Method.** Semantically paired treatments replace an image with its textual description while keeping the query language fixed. A controlled 14-configuration design swaps Vicuna for Chinese–English Yi or German–English Leo, CLIP for DINOv2, and English for translated training data. Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection and Centered Kernel Alignment compare image/text representations. A steering vector, estimated from one text example per language at an intermediate language-model layer, is added to each generated-token state.

**Validation.** Four pretrained LLaVA-style models produce 15,480 responses each on 7,740 paired tasks from MaXM, PALO-LLaVA-Bench-In-The-Wild, and ViSIT across 14 languages. GlotLID language labels are debiased with 1,000 expert annotations. Images reduce fidelity by 5.9–13.7 percentage points for LLaVA-7B, 10.8–19.2 for LLaVA-13B, and 42.9–52.9 for LLaVA-Gemma-2B. In Chinese/German ablations, bilingual backbones reduce the loss by 17/7 points, whereas DINOv2 and translated data worsen it; accuracy effects are statistically inconclusive. Representation analyses show image tokens separated from text and structurally stable across models, and the single-example intermediate-layer intervention significantly improves fidelity across pretrained models.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Image-induced language drift is systematic and is driven chiefly by how the language backbone interprets out-of-distribution visual embeddings, rather than by the projector placing images near English tokens. Paired inputs, controlled retraining, confidence intervals, representation comparisons, and successful steering provide convergent but not complete causal evidence. Language identification and GPT-4o accuracy proxies require debiasing, the visualization does not prove semantic separation, interactions among design factors are underpowered, and results are limited to LLaVA-style systems and 14 languages.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究为何向非英语查询加入本应与语言无关的图像，会使 LLaVA 风格视觉—语言模型更倾向用英语作答。研究分离语言骨干、视觉编码器和训练数据语言的作用，并定位图像诱发语言忠实度损失（Image-induced Fidelity Loss, IFL）的内部来源及训练外干预可能性。

**方法。** 配对处理在保持查询语言不变时，用图像的文字描述替换图像。受控的 14 配置设计把 Vicuna 换成中英 Yi 或德英 Leo，把 CLIP 换成 DINOv2，并改变训练数据语言。Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection 与中心核对齐比较图文表示；另从每种语言一个文字样本估计中间语言模型层的引导向量，并加到每个生成词元状态。

**实验验证。** 四个预训练 LLaVA 风格模型分别在 MaXM、PALO-LLaVA-Bench-In-The-Wild 和 ViSIT 的 14 种语言、7,740 对任务上生成 15,480 个回答；GlotLID 语言标签用 1,000 条专家标注去偏。图像使 LLaVA-7B 忠实度下降 5.9—13.7 个百分点、13B 下降 10.8—19.2 点、LLaVA-Gemma-2B 下降 42.9—52.9 点。中/德语消融中，双语骨干分别减少损失 17/7 点，DINOv2 和翻译训练数据反而恶化，准确率差异统计上不确定。表示分析显示图像词元与文本分离且跨模型结构稳定，单样本中间层干预则在各预训练模型上显著改善忠实度。

**结论与证据。** 图像诱发的语言漂移是系统现象，主因更像是语言骨干如何解释分布外视觉嵌入，而非投影器把图像映射到英语词元附近。配对输入、受控重训、置信区间、表示比较和成功引导提供汇聚但不完整的因果证据。语言识别与 GPT-4o 准确率代理需要去偏，可视化不证明语义空间分离，设计因素交互统计力不足，结果也只覆盖 LLaVA 风格系统和 14 种语言。

p_2024_hsu_efficient_automated_circuit.title: Efficient Automated Circuit Discovery in Transformers using Contextual Decomposition

abstract.en: Automated mechanistic interpretation research has attracted great interest due to its potential to scale explanations of neural network internals to large models. Existing automated circuit discovery work relies on activation patching or its approximations to identify subgraphs in models for specific tasks (circuits). They often suffer from slow runtime, approximation errors, and specific requirements of metrics, such as non-zero gradients. In this work, we introduce contextual decomposition for transformers (CD-T) to build interpretable circuits in large language models. CD-T can produce circuits of arbitrary level of abstraction, and is the first able to produce circuits as fine-grained as attention heads at specific sequence positions efficiently. CD-T consists of a set of mathematical equations to isolate contribution of model features. Through recursively computing contribution of all nodes in a computational graph of a model using CD-T followed by pruning, we are able to reduce circuit discovery runtime from hours to seconds compared to state-of-the-art baselines. On three standard circuit evaluation datasets (indirect object identification, greater-than comparisons, and docstring completion), we demonstrate that CD-T outperforms ACDC and EAP by better recovering the manual circuits with an average of 97% ROC AUC under low runtimes. In addition, we provide evidence that faithfulness of CD-T circuits is not due to random chance by showing our circuits are 80% more faithful than random circuits of up to 60% of the original model size. Finally, we show CD-T circuits are able to perfectly replicate original models' behavior (faithfulness $ = 1$) using fewer nodes than the baselines for all tasks. Our results underscore the great promise of CD-T for efficient automated mechanistic interpretability, paving the way for new insights into the workings of large language models.
abstract.zh: 自动化机制解释研究因有望将神经网络内部机制的解释扩展到大型模型而受到广泛关注。现有自动回路发现工作依赖激活修补或其近似方法，来识别模型中负责特定任务的子图（即回路）。这些方法往往运行缓慢、存在近似误差，并对指标有特殊要求，例如梯度必须非零。本文引入面向 Transformer 的上下文分解方法（CD-T），用于在大型语言模型中构建可解释回路。CD-T 可以产生任意抽象层级的回路，也是首个能够高效生成细化到特定序列位置上注意力头级别回路的方法。CD-T 由一组用于分离模型特征贡献的数学方程组成。通过使用 CD-T 递归计算模型计算图中所有节点的贡献并进行剪枝，与当前最佳基线相比，我们将回路发现时间从数小时缩短至数秒。在三个标准回路评估数据集——间接宾语识别、大于比较和文档字符串补全——上，CD-T 对人工回路的恢复优于 ACDC 和 EAP，在低运行时间下平均达到 97% ROC AUC。此外，通过证明所得回路比规模最高达到原模型 60% 的随机回路忠实度高 80%，我们提供了 CD-T 回路的忠实性并非随机偶然的证据。最后，在所有任务上，CD-T 回路使用比基线更少的节点即可完全复现原模型行为（忠实度 $=1$）。这些结果凸显了 CD-T 在高效自动化机制可解释性方面的潜力，为理解大型语言模型的工作机制铺平了道路。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether Transformer circuits can be recovered automatically in seconds without training, repeated activation patching, or nonzero-gradient requirements, while retaining or improving recovery of known mechanisms and behavioral faithfulness.

**Method.** Contextual Decomposition for Transformers (CD-T) propagates separate relevant and irrelevant constituent tensors through embeddings, layer normalization, attention, residual connections, and multilayer perceptrons. It recursively scores how candidate source nodes contribute to selected targets, greedily expands the circuit, and prunes low-contribution nodes. The same equations can operate at layer, head, position, or finer constituent granularity.

**Validation.** CD-T is compared with Automated Circuit Discovery (ACDC) and Edge Attribution Patching (EAP) on GPT-style models for Indirect Object Identification (IOI), greater-than comparison, and Python docstring completion, using the published manual circuits as imperfect references. Receiver-operating-characteristic area under the curve (ROC-AUC), runtime, faithfulness under outside-circuit ablation, circuit size, and random-circuit controls are reported on an NVIDIA A100. CD-T averages 97% ROC-AUC, reduces hours-scale searches to seconds, and finds faithfulness-1 circuits with fewer nodes on all three tasks. Its circuits are up to 80% more faithful than random subgraphs even when the latter retain 60% of model nodes.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Algebraic decomposition can make automated node-level circuit discovery substantially faster while matching known circuits and preserving full-model task behavior. Cross-task recovery, ablation-based faithfulness, and size-matched random controls provide strong evidence for efficiency and utility. They do not establish a unique ground-truth mechanism: manual circuits may be incomplete, only three small benchmarks are used, relevance scores ignore contribution sign, and heuristic expansion parameters still require tuning.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究能否在无需训练、反复激活修补或非零梯度条件的情况下，以秒级速度自动恢复 Transformer 电路，同时保持或改善已知机制的恢复率和行为保真度。

**方法。** Transformer 上下文分解（Contextual Decomposition for Transformers, CD-T）让“相关”与“不相关”组成张量分别穿过嵌入、层归一化、注意力、残差连接和多层感知机。算法递归计算候选来源节点对目标的贡献，贪心扩展电路并剪除低贡献节点；同一组公式可在层、注意力头、位置或更细组成粒度上运行。

**实验验证。** 在 GPT 类模型的间接宾语识别（Indirect Object Identification, IOI）、大于比较和 Python docstring 补全任务上，与自动电路发现（Automated Circuit Discovery, ACDC）和边归因修补（Edge Attribution Patching, EAP）比较，并把已发表人工电路作为不完美参考。NVIDIA A100 上报告受试者工作特征曲线下面积（ROC-AUC）、运行时间、子图外消融保真度、电路规模和随机电路对照。CD-T 平均 ROC-AUC 为 97%，把数小时搜索降到数秒，并在三任务上用更少节点得到保真度 1 的电路；即使随机子图保留 60% 模型节点，CD-T 电路保真度仍最高高出 80%。

**结论与证据。** 代数分解能显著加速自动节点级电路发现，同时匹配已知电路并保留完整模型任务行为。跨任务恢复、消融保真和同规模随机对照为效率与效用提供强证据，但不能确立唯一真值机制：人工电路可能不完整，实验仅含三个小型基准，相关度分数忽略贡献正负，启发式扩展参数仍需调节。

p_2024_huang_ravel_evaluating_interpreta.title: RAVEL: Evaluating Interpretability Methods on Disentangling Language Model Representations
p_2024_huang_ravel_evaluating_interpreta.venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics

abstract.en: Individual neurons participate in the representation of multiple high-level concepts. To what extent can different interpretability methods successfully disentangle these roles? To help address this question, we introduce RAVEL (Resolving Attribute-Value Entanglements in Language Models), a dataset that enables tightly controlled, quantitative comparisons between a variety of existing interpretability methods. We use the resulting conceptual framework to define the new method of Multi-task Distributed Alignment Search (MDAS), which allows us to find distributed representations satisfying multiple causal criteria. With Llama2-7B as the target language model, MDAS achieves state-of-the-art results on RAVEL, demonstrating the importance of going beyond neuron-level analyses to identify features distributed across activations. We release our benchmark at https://github.com/explanare/ravel.
abstract.zh: 单个神经元会参与多个高层概念的表征。不同可解释性方法能在多大程度上成功解耦这些作用？为帮助回答这一问题，我们推出 RAVEL（Resolving Attribute-Value Entanglements in Language Models），这是一个可对多种现有可解释性方法进行严格控制和定量比较的数据集。我们利用由此形成的概念框架，定义一种新方法——多任务分布式对齐搜索（MDAS）；它使我们能够找到同时满足多项因果标准的分布式表征。以 Llama2-7B 为目标语言模型，MDAS 在 RAVEL 上取得最先进结果，证明分析不能止于神经元层面，而应识别分布于激活中的特征。基准见 https://github.com/explanare/ravel。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether interpretability methods can isolate one causally used entity attribute from correlated attributes, rather than merely decode it. It operationalizes four requirements—faithfulness, causality, generalization, and isolation—and asks which representation-learning methods satisfy them on unseen entities and contexts.

**Method.** RAVEL constructs base/source prompt pairs for interchange interventions: an identified feature for attribute (A) is swapped between examples, then Cause measures whether the target (A) changes correctly and Isolation measures whether other attributes remain fixed; their sum forms a Disentangle score. Principal components, sparse autoencoders, relaxed linear adversarial probes, Differential Binary Masking (DBM), and Distributed Alignment Search (DAS) are compared. Multi-task DBM/DAS jointly supervise all attributes so each subspace is penalized for changing the others.

**Validation.** The full dataset contains cities, Nobel laureates, verbs, physical objects, and occupations—6,828 entities, 420 templates, and 23 attributes. A filtered Llama-2-7B instance contains 2,800 entities the model predicts reliably and evaluates interventions on held-out entities or contexts. Methods search residual-stream states above the final entity token; per-attribute Cause, Isolation, and Disentangle scores are computed after counterfactual swaps. Multi-task supervision improves DBM by 1.5/4.1 points and DAS by 3.6/8.3 on entity/context splits; multi-task DAS ranks best, while principal components and sparse autoencoders rank lowest. Layer sweeps show Isolation rising roughly from 0.5 at layer 8 to 0.8 at layer 16.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Decodability does not imply disentanglement: methods trained directly on counterfactual causal objectives, especially multi-task DAS, isolate attributes more successfully than unsupervised decompositions. Large controlled intervention sets and held-out entity/context splits strongly support the benchmark comparison. The benchmark filters for facts Llama-2-7B already answers, evaluates one model and one residual position, uses constructed attributes with available counterfactual values, and therefore does not establish that the winning method generalizes to free-form concepts or distributed multi-token mechanisms.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究可解释性方法能否真正把一个被模型因果使用的实体属性与相关属性分离，而不只是把它解码出来。基准把忠实性、因果性、泛化性和隔离性具体化，并比较不同表示学习方法在未见实体和上下文上能否同时满足。

**方法。** RAVEL 为交换干预构造基础/来源提示对：把属性 (A) 的候选特征在样本间交换后，Cause 衡量目标属性是否正确改变，Isolation 衡量其他属性是否保持不变，两者相加形成 Disentangle 分数。比较主成分、稀疏自编码器、松弛线性对抗探针、差分二值掩码（Differential Binary Masking, DBM）和分布式对齐搜索（Distributed Alignment Search, DAS）；多任务 DBM/DAS 联合监督所有属性，使每个子空间因改变其他属性而受罚。

**实验验证。** 完整数据涵盖城市、诺奖得主、动词、物体和职业，共 6,828 个实体、420 个模板和 23 个属性。筛选后的 Llama-2-7B 实例含模型能可靠预测的 2,800 个实体，并在留出实体或上下文上做干预。方法搜索实体末词元上方的残差流状态，交换后逐属性计算 Cause、Isolation 和 Disentangle。多任务监督在实体/上下文划分上分别使 DBM 提高 1.5/4.1 点、DAS 提高 3.6/8.3 点；多任务 DAS 最佳，主成分和稀疏自编码器最低。逐层扫描中 Isolation 约从第 8 层的 0.5 升到第 16 层的 0.8。

**结论与证据。** 可解码不等于可解耦；直接以反事实因果目标训练的方法，尤其多任务 DAS，比无监督分解更能隔离属性。大规模受控干预和留出实体/上下文划分为方法比较提供强证据。但基准筛选的是 Llama-2-7B 已能回答的事实，只评一个模型和一个残差位置，并依赖具有明确反事实值的构造属性，尚不能证明优胜方法适用于自由形式概念或跨词元分布式机制。

p_2024_jin_cutting_off_the.title: Cutting Off the Head Ends the Conflict: A Mechanism for Interpreting and Mitigating Knowledge Conflicts in Language Models
p_2024_jin_cutting_off_the.venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics

abstract.en: Recently, retrieval augmentation and tool augmentation have demonstrated a remarkable capability to expand the internal memory boundaries of language models (LMs) by providing external context. However, internal memory and external context inevitably clash, leading to knowledge conflicts within LMs. In this paper, we aim to interpret the mechanism of knowledge conflicts through the lens of information flow, and then mitigate conflicts by precise interventions at the pivotal point. We find there are some attention heads with opposite effects in the later layers, where memory heads can recall knowledge from internal memory, and context heads can retrieve knowledge from external context. Moreover, we reveal that the pivotal point at which knowledge conflicts emerge in LMs is the integration of inconsistent information flows by memory heads and context heads. Inspired by the insights, we propose a novel method called Pruning Head via PatH PatcHing (PH3), which can efficiently mitigate knowledge conflicts by pruning conflicting attention heads without updating model parameters. PH3 can flexibly control eight LMs to use internal memory ($\uparrow$ 44.0%) or external context ($\uparrow$ 38.5%). Moreover, PH3 can also improve the performance of LMs on open-domain QA tasks. We also conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate the cross-model, cross-relation, and cross-format generalization of our method.
abstract.zh: 近年来，检索增强和工具增强通过提供外部上下文，展现出扩展语言模型（LM）内部记忆边界的显著能力。然而，内部记忆与外部上下文不可避免地会发生冲突，从而在语言模型内部引发知识冲突。本文旨在从信息流的角度解释知识冲突的机制，并通过在关键位置进行精确干预来缓解冲突。我们发现，后部层中存在一些作用相反的注意力头：记忆头可以从内部记忆中召回知识，而上下文头可以从外部上下文中检索知识。我们进一步揭示，语言模型中知识冲突出现的关键点，是记忆头与上下文头对不一致信息流的整合。受这些认识启发，我们提出一种名为“通过路径修补剪枝注意力头”（Pruning Head via PatH PatcHing，PH3）的新方法；它无需更新模型参数，只需剪除发生冲突的注意力头，便能高效缓解知识冲突。PH3 可以灵活控制八种语言模型使用内部记忆（$\uparrow$ 44.0%）或外部上下文（$\uparrow$ 38.5%）。此外，PH3 还能提升语言模型在开放域问答任务上的表现。我们还进行了广泛实验，证明该方法能够跨模型、跨关系和跨格式泛化。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks how a language model resolves a conflict between a factual association in its parameters and a contradictory value supplied in context. It seeks the point where the two information streams interact, whether distinct attention heads retrieve each source, and whether selective head pruning can choose which knowledge source controls the answer.

**Method.** Component knockout and causal tracing first compare memory-consistent, context-consistent, and conflict prompts. Gradient sensitivity and path patching identify late-layer “memory heads” and “context heads” that move different attributes to the final token. Pruning Head via PatH PatcHing (PH3) ranks heads by their patched effect, then masks the small opposing set at inference to favor either parametric memory or external context without updating weights.

**Validation.** Mechanistic studies use factual subject–attribute conflicts in GPT-2 XL and GPT-J; extraction tests compare the top 5% memory/context heads with a random 5%. Mitigation is evaluated on World Capital, a distractor-formatted capital set, Official Language, Country, and Continent, plus 1,000 Natural Questions examples supplied with five retrieved passages. Cross-model tests cover eight models, including OPT-1.3B/2.7B, Pythia-6.9B/12B, Llama-2-7B/13B, GPT-2 XL, and GPT-J. Heads selected only on World Capital generalize across relations and formats: PH3 raises use of internal memory by up to 44.0% or external context by 38.5%, beats prompt, contrastive-decoding, gradient-ranking, and random-pruning controls, and improves retrieval-based question-answer recall.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Knowledge conflict emerges when late attention heads carrying parametric and contextual attributes converge at the answer position; selectively suppressing one group can causally shift the model's source preference. Path-specific interventions, randomized controls, and transfer across eight models and several relations provide substantial causal evidence for this routing account. It remains a simplified factual-recall setting: head labels summarize average behavior rather than exclusive functions, pruning may alter unrelated tasks, Natural Questions evidence is aggregate, and the analysis does not fully explain upstream retrieval or conflicts requiring multi-step reasoning.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究语言模型如何处理参数中事实关联与上下文所给矛盾值的冲突；具体寻找两条信息流相互作用的位置、是否由不同注意力头提取各自来源，以及选择性剪枝能否决定哪类知识控制答案。

**方法。** 组件敲除和因果追踪先比较与记忆一致、与上下文一致及冲突提示；梯度敏感性与路径修补定位晚层“记忆头”和“上下文头”，它们把不同属性搬运到末词元。通过路径修补剪枝注意力头（Pruning Head via PatH PatcHing, PH3）按修补效应排序，并在推理时屏蔽少量对立注意力头，以偏向参数记忆或外部上下文，无需更新权重。

**实验验证。** GPT-2 XL 和 GPT-J 上用事实主语—属性冲突做机制分析；提取实验把前 5% 记忆/上下文头与随机 5% 比较。缓解评测含 World Capital、带干扰格式的首都集、Official Language、Country、Continent，以及附有 5 段检索文本的 1,000 条 Natural Questions。跨模型覆盖 8 个模型，包括 OPT-1.3B/2.7B、Pythia-6.9B/12B、Llama-2-7B/13B、GPT-2 XL 和 GPT-J。仅在 World Capital 上选出的头可跨关系和格式迁移：PH3 最高使内部记忆使用率提高 44.0%、外部上下文提高 38.5%，优于提示、对比解码、梯度排序和随机剪枝，并改善检索问答召回率。

**结论与证据。** 知识冲突在携带参数属性与上下文属性的晚层注意力头汇聚到答案位置时形成；选择性抑制一组可以因果改变模型的知识来源偏好。路径级干预、随机对照及八模型多关系迁移为这种路由解释提供较强因果证据。但任务仍是简化事实回忆：注意力头标签描述平均作用而非排他功能，剪枝可能影响无关任务，Natural Questions 证据是总体指标，分析也未完整解释上游检索或多步推理冲突。

p_2024_lieberum_gemma_scope_open.title: Gemma Scope: Open Sparse Autoencoders Everywhere All At Once on Gemma 2
p_2024_lieberum_gemma_scope_open.venue: BlackboxNLP Workshop on Analyzing and Interpreting Neural Networks for NLP

abstract.en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are an unsupervised method for learning a sparse decomposition of a neural network’s latent representations into seemingly interpretable features.Despite recent excitement about their potential, research applications outside of industry are limited by the high cost of training a comprehensive suite of SAEs.In this work, we introduce Gemma Scope, an open suite of JumpReLU SAEs trained on all layers and sub-layers of Gemma 2 2B and 9B and select layers of Gemma 2 27B base models.We primarily train SAEs on the Gemma 2 pre-trained models, but additionally release SAEs trained on instruction-tuned Gemma 2 9B for comparison.We evaluate the quality of each SAE on standard metrics and release these results.We hope that by releasing these SAE weights, we can help make more ambitious safety and interpretability research easier for the community. Weights and a tutorial can be found at https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-scope and an interactive demo can be found at https://neuronpedia.org/gemma-scope.
abstract.zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）是一种无监督方法，用于把神经网络的潜在表征稀疏分解为看似可解释的特征。尽管近期研究者对其潜力十分关注，但训练一套覆盖全面的 SAE 成本很高，限制了工业界之外的研究应用。本文推出 Gemma Scope：一套开放的 JumpReLU SAE，覆盖 Gemma 2 2B 和 9B 基础模型的所有层与子层，以及 Gemma 2 27B 基础模型的若干选定层。我们主要在 Gemma 2 预训练模型上训练 SAE，同时也发布在经过指令调优的 Gemma 2 9B 上训练的 SAE 以供比较。我们使用标准指标评估每个 SAE 的质量，并公开评估结果。我们希望通过发布这些 SAE 权重，帮助研究社区更容易开展更具雄心的安全性与可解释性研究。权重和教程见 https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-scope，交互式演示见 https://neuronpedia.org/gemma-scope。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether sparse autoencoder (SAE) research can be made practical on modern open language models by releasing comprehensive dictionaries across layers, sublayers, widths, and sparsity levels. It also studies how width, sequence position, domain shift, numerical precision, and transfer from base to instruction-tuned models affect standard SAE quality measures.

**Method.** Gemma Scope trains JumpReLU SAEs, whose learned thresholds directly penalize the number of active latents, on attention outputs, multilayer-perceptron outputs, and post-multilayer perceptron (MLP) residual streams. It covers every layer of Gemma-2-2B and 9B, selected residual layers of 27B, an instruction-tuned 9B suite, and a 2B transcoder suite. Widths and sparsity coefficients are swept, with normalized activations and a high-throughput sharded activation pipeline.

**Validation.** The main release contains over 400 configurations and more than 30 million learned latents; counting sparsity variants, over 2,000 checkpoints are released. Each SAE sees 4–16 billion pretraining-distribution tokens. Evaluation on 2,048 sequences of length 1,024 reports mean (L_0), language-model cross-entropy increase after insertion, and fraction of variance unexplained. Wider dictionaries improve fidelity at matched sparsity but exhibit feature splitting; errors vary systematically with sequence position and Pile domain, with Europarl worst. On 1,024 instruction-model rollouts, base-model SAEs cause nearly as little loss increase as SAEs trained directly on instruction-model activations. Float32-to-bfloat16 inference has negligible effect.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Comprehensive open SAE infrastructure can be trained at multi-billion-token scale and transferred usefully across closely related base/chat models, enabling downstream circuit and safety studies that would otherwise be prohibitively expensive. The engineering evidence is extensive, but standard reconstruction metrics do not validate semantic truth or causal usefulness of latents. Width can split or compose features, transfer is tested within one model family, no consensus quality metric exists, and several proposed safety applications remain future work rather than demonstrated outcomes.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究能否通过发布覆盖不同层、子层、宽度和稀疏度的完整字典，使现代开放语言模型上的稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoder, SAE）研究变得可行；并考察宽度、序列位置、领域偏移、数值精度及基础模型到指令模型迁移如何影响常用质量指标。

**方法。** Gemma Scope 训练 JumpReLU SAE：学习得到的阈值直接配合活跃潜变量数惩罚；训练位置包括注意力输出、多层感知机输出和 MLP 后残差流。覆盖 Gemma-2-2B/9B 每一层、27B 若干残差层、9B 指令模型套件及 2B 转码器套件，并扫描宽度和稀疏系数，配合激活归一化与高吞吐分片流水线。

**实验验证。** 主发布含 400 多个配置和 3,000 多万潜变量；计入稀疏度变体共发布 2,000 多个检查点。每个 SAE 使用 40—160 亿预训练分布词元。2,048 条长度 1,024 序列上报告平均 (L_0)、插入后的语言模型交叉熵增量和未解释方差比例。更宽字典在相同稀疏度下保真更好，但出现特征分裂；误差随序列位置和 Pile 子领域系统变化，Europarl 最差。1,024 条指令模型生成上，基础模型 SAE 导致的损失增量几乎与直接在指令激活上训练者相同；float32 改为 bfloat16 推理影响可忽略。

**结论与证据。** 可以在数十亿词元规模训练完整开放 SAE 基础设施，并在近缘基础/聊天模型间有效迁移，从而支持原本代价过高的电路与安全研究。工程证据很充分，但标准重构指标不能验证潜变量的语义真实性或因果用途。扩大宽度可能分裂或组合特征，迁移只在一个模型家族内测试，质量指标尚无共识，多项安全应用仍是未来方向而非已验证结果。

p_2024_makelov_towards_principled_evalua.title: Towards Principled Evaluations of Sparse Autoencoders for Interpretability and Control

abstract.en: Disentangling model activations into meaningful features is a central problem in interpretability. However, the absence of ground-truth for these features in realistic scenarios makes validating recent approaches, such as sparse dictionary learning, elusive. To address this challenge, we propose a framework for evaluating feature dictionaries in the context of specific tasks, by comparing them against \emph{supervised} feature dictionaries. First, we demonstrate that supervised dictionaries achieve excellent approximation, control, and interpretability of model computations on the task. Second, we use the supervised dictionaries to develop and contextualize evaluations of unsupervised dictionaries along the same three axes. We apply this framework to the indirect object identification (IOI) task using GPT-2 Small, with sparse autoencoders (SAEs) trained on either the IOI or OpenWebText datasets. We find that these SAEs capture interpretable features for the IOI task, but they are less successful than supervised features in controlling the model. Finally, we observe two qualitative phenomena in SAE training: feature occlusion (where a causally relevant concept is robustly overshadowed by even slightly higher-magnitude ones in the learned features), and feature over-splitting (where binary features split into many smaller, less interpretable features). We hope that our framework will provide a useful step towards more objective and grounded evaluations of sparse dictionary learning methods.
abstract.zh: 把模型激活解耦为有意义的特征，是可解释性研究的核心问题。然而，在真实场景中缺少这些特征的真值，使稀疏字典学习等近期方法难以得到验证。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一个在具体任务语境下评估特征字典的框架，方法是将其与监督式特征字典进行比较。首先，我们证明监督式字典能够出色地近似、控制和解释模型在任务上的计算。其次，我们使用监督式字典，围绕同样三个维度开发无监督字典的评估方法并为其提供参照语境。我们把该框架应用于 GPT-2 Small 上的间接宾语识别（IOI）任务，所用稀疏自编码器（SAE）分别在 IOI 或 OpenWebText 数据集上训练。我们发现，这些 SAE 能捕捉 IOI 任务的可解释特征，但在控制模型方面不如监督式特征。最后，我们观察到 SAE 训练中的两种定性现象：特征遮蔽，即具有因果相关性的概念会被幅度只略高的其他概念稳定地掩盖；特征过度拆分，即二元特征被拆成许多更小、可解释性更差的特征。我们希望该框架能推动稀疏字典学习方法获得更加客观且有依据的评估。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks how sparse feature dictionaries should be evaluated when no ground-truth features exist. It proposes task-grounded tests of whether reconstructions are sufficient and necessary for behavior, whether a small number of features can controllably edit task attributes, and whether human interpretations match causal roles.

**Method.** Prompt attributes define a supervised “skyline” dictionary whose vectors are estimated from conditional activation means. Replacing an internal cross-section with its dictionary reconstruction tests sufficiency; reconstructing only the residual error tests necessity. Counterfactual feature addition/subtraction is compared with full activation patching for controllability, and feature activation labels plus feature-to-feature interactions test interpretability. The same tests are applied without assuming that unsupervised dictionaries recover identical concepts.

**Validation.** GPT-2 Small is studied at main cross-sections of its Indirect Object Identification (IOI) circuit. The dataset varies names, objects, places, and templates, with 216 single-token names, 144 objects, and 75 places split equally between train and test; held-out data use unseen values and templates. Supervised edits agree with ground-truth activation interventions more than 80% of the time and obtain perfect label F1 by construction. Sparse autoencoders trained either on IOI activations or OpenWebText are compared on reconstruction necessity/sufficiency, minimal greedy edit size, and interpretation. Both expose IOI-relevant features, but task-trained dictionaries require fewer features to perform counterfactual edits; controlled examples reveal feature occlusion and over-splitting.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Reconstruction loss and sparsity alone are inadequate SAE evaluations; task-level causal preservation, controllability, and interpretation–function agreement expose meaningful differences between dictionaries. Held-out counterfactual interventions and a supervised skyline give strong diagnostics for the studied circuit. The evaluation is not a universal ground truth: its supervised variables are analyst-chosen, only GPT-2 Small and IOI are tested, greedy edits approximate an NP-hard search, and good performance may miss model features outside the selected task ontology.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究在不存在“真实特征”标签时，应如何评价稀疏特征字典。它提出任务落地的三类检验：重构对行为是否充分且必要，少量特征能否可控地编辑任务属性，以及人类解释是否与特征的因果角色一致。

**方法。** 研究用提示属性定义监督式“天花板”字典，向量由条件激活均值估计。用字典重构替换内部截面检验充分性，只保留重构残差检验必要性；特征加减的反事实编辑与完整激活修补比较可控性，特征激活标签和特征间相互作用检验可解释性。相同测试用于无监督字典时，不要求其恢复完全相同概念。

**实验验证。** 在 GPT-2 Small 的间接宾语识别（Indirect Object Identification, IOI）电路主要截面上实验。数据改变姓名、物体、地点和模板，含 216 个单词元姓名、144 个物体和 75 个地点，训练/测试各半；测试使用未见取值和模板。监督编辑与真值激活干预的一致率始终高于 80%，标签 F1 因定义方式为满分。随后比较在 IOI 激活或 OpenWebText 上训练的稀疏自编码器，指标含重构必要/充分性、贪心最小编辑规模和解释性。两者都发现 IOI 特征，但任务字典用更少特征完成反事实编辑；受控案例还揭示特征遮蔽与过度分裂。

**结论与证据。** 仅用重构损失和稀疏度评价 SAE 不够；任务级因果保持、可控性及解释—功能一致能揭示字典间实质差异。留出反事实干预与监督天花板为该电路提供强诊断。但它不是普适真值：监督变量由分析者选择，只测试 GPT-2 Small 与 IOI，贪心编辑近似一个 NP 困难搜索，而且好成绩仍可能漏掉任务本体之外的模型特征。

p_2024_marks_enhancing_neural_network.title: Enhancing Neural Network Interpretability with Feature-Aligned Sparse Autoencoders

abstract.en: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have shown promise in improving the interpretability of neural network activations, but can learn features that are not features of the input, limiting their effectiveness. We propose \textsc{Mutual Feature Regularization} \textbf{(MFR)}, a regularization technique for improving feature learning by encouraging SAEs trained in parallel to learn similar features. We motivate \textsc{MFR} by showing that features learned by multiple SAEs are more likely to correlate with features of the input. By training on synthetic data with known features of the input, we show that \textsc{MFR} can help SAEs learn those features, as we can directly compare the features learned by the SAE with the input features for the synthetic data. We then scale \textsc{MFR} to SAEs that are trained to denoise electroencephalography (EEG) data and SAEs that are trained to reconstruct GPT-2 Small activations. We show that \textsc{MFR} can improve the reconstruction loss of SAEs by up to 21.21\% on GPT-2 Small, and 6.67\% on EEG data. Our results suggest that the similarity between features learned by different SAEs can be leveraged to improve SAE training, thereby enhancing performance and the usefulness of SAEs for model interpretability.
abstract.zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）在提高神经网络激活的可解释性方面展现出潜力，但也可能学到并非输入本身特征的特征，从而限制其有效性。我们提出互特征正则化（Mutual Feature Regularization，MFR），这是一种通过鼓励并行训练的 SAE 学习相似特征来改进特征学习的正则化技术。我们发现，由多个 SAE 共同学到的特征更可能与输入特征相关，这为 MFR 提供了动机。通过在输入特征已知的合成数据上训练，我们可以直接比较 SAE 所学特征与合成数据的输入特征，并由此证明 MFR 能帮助 SAE 学到这些特征。随后，我们把 MFR 扩展到用于脑电图（EEG）数据去噪的 SAE，以及用于重构 GPT-2 Small 激活的 SAE。结果表明，MFR 可使 SAE 在 GPT-2 Small 上的重构损失最多改善 21.21%，在 EEG 数据上最多改善 6.67%。研究结果说明，可以利用不同 SAE 所学特征之间的相似性改进 SAE 训练，从而提升其性能以及在模型可解释性中的实用价值。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether features independently rediscovered by multiple sparse autoencoders are more likely to reflect true input structure than run-specific artifacts, and whether this cross-run agreement can be used during training to improve feature recovery and reconstruction on realistic activations.

**Method.** Mutual Feature Regularization (MFR) trains several autoencoders in parallel and adds a decoder-alignment penalty that rewards each learned direction for matching a direction learned by another run. Synthetic superposition data supply known generating features for direct recovery measurement. An early reinitialization rule detects poor runs from persistently inactive Top-(K) latents, while ablations separate the effects of reinitialization and mutual regularization.

**Validation.** On synthetic vectors with more generating features than dimensions, decoder directions shared across independent runs correlate more strongly with the known feature matrix; MFR increases the fraction recovered across seeds and sparsity settings. The method is then applied to Top-(K) autoencoders over GPT-2 Small activations and to denoising autoencoders for electroencephalography (EEG) data. Relative to matched independently trained baselines, reconstruction loss improves by as much as 21.21% for GPT-2 activations and 6.67% for EEG. Reinitialization-only, penalty-only, and weight-distance analyses test whether gains arise merely from lucky initialization; adding the penalty changes final synthetic reconstruction loss by only about 2.4% while improving feature alignment.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Agreement among independently trained dictionaries is a useful weak signal for real features, and explicitly aligning those dictionaries can improve both known-feature recovery and reconstruction. Ground-truth synthetic tests plus two real-data domains support the optimization claim. For real activations the actual features remain unknown, so lower reconstruction loss does not establish greater interpretability; correlated artifacts could also be shared, alignment may reduce legitimate feature diversity, and MFR requires the extra compute and memory of training multiple SAEs.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究多个独立稀疏自编码器反复发现的特征，是否比单次运行特有方向更可能对应真实输入结构，以及能否在训练中利用这种跨运行一致性，提高真实激活上的特征恢复和重构。

**方法。** 互特征正则化（Mutual Feature Regularization, MFR）并行训练多个自编码器，并加入解码器对齐惩罚，使每个学习方向匹配另一运行的某个方向。合成叠加数据提供已知生成特征，可直接测量恢复率；早期重初始化规则用长期不活跃的 Top-(K) 潜变量识别差初始化，并通过只重初始化、只加惩罚等消融分离作用。

**实验验证。** 在生成特征数多于维度的合成向量上，独立运行共同学到的解码方向与已知特征矩阵相关更强；MFR 跨随机种子和稀疏设置提高恢复比例。随后把方法用于 GPT-2 Small 激活上的 Top-(K) 自编码器，以及脑电图（Electroencephalography, EEG）去噪自编码器。相对匹配独立训练基线，重构损失最高分别改善 21.21% 和 6.67%。重初始化/惩罚消融与权重距离分析检查增益是否只来自幸运初始化；合成数据中加入惩罚对最终重构损失仅约 2.4% 相对影响，却改善特征对齐。

**结论与证据。** 独立字典间的一致性可作为真实特征的弱信号，显式对齐能同时改善已知特征恢复和重构。具有真值的合成实验及两个真实数据领域支持优化结论。但真实激活的实际特征未知，较低重构损失不等于更可解释；相关伪特征也可能被共同学到，对齐可能压制合理特征多样性，MFR 还需并行训练多个 SAE 的额外算力和内存。

p_2024_marks_sparse_feature_circuits.title: Sparse Feature Circuits: Discovering and Editing Interpretable Causal Graphs in Language Models

abstract.en: We introduce methods for discovering and applying sparse feature circuits. These are causally implicated subnetworks of human-interpretable features for explaining language model behaviors. Circuits identified in prior work consist of polysemantic and difficult-to-interpret units like attention heads or neurons, rendering them unsuitable for many downstream applications. In contrast, sparse feature circuits enable detailed understanding of unanticipated mechanisms. Because they are based on fine-grained units, sparse feature circuits are useful for downstream tasks: We introduce SHIFT, where we improve the generalization of a classifier by ablating features that a human judges to be task-irrelevant. Finally, we demonstrate an entirely unsupervised and scalable interpretability pipeline by discovering thousands of sparse feature circuits for automatically discovered model behaviors.
abstract.zh: 我们提出用于发现和应用稀疏特征回路的方法。稀疏特征回路是由人类可解释特征组成、与因果作用相关的子网络，用于解释语言模型行为。以往工作识别的回路由注意力头或神经元等多义且难以解释的单元构成，因此不适合许多下游应用。相比之下，稀疏特征回路能够帮助我们细致理解未曾预料的机制。由于它们以细粒度单元为基础，稀疏特征回路也适用于下游任务。我们提出 SHIFT：消融经人类判断与任务无关的特征，以改善分类器的泛化能力。最后，我们通过为自动发现的模型行为找出数千个稀疏特征回路，展示了一条完全无监督且可扩展的可解释性流水线。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether sparse-autoencoder features can replace polysemantic heads or neurons as circuit nodes, allowing scalable causal graphs that are both interpretable and useful for editing. It tests known linguistic behavior, removal of an unknown spurious classifier signal, and fully unsupervised discovery of many behaviors.

**Method.** Sparse features and autoencoder reconstruction errors are inserted as nodes in the model computation graph. Attribution patching with integrated gradients estimates node and feature-to-feature edge effects from contrastive inputs; thresholding forms a circuit, and outside-circuit mean ablation measures faithfulness. Sparse Human-Interpretable Feature Trimming (SHIFT) lets an annotator remove circuit features judged task-irrelevant. A separate pipeline clusters low-loss Pile predictions by internal activations or gradients, then builds a circuit for each cluster.

**Validation.** Subject–verb agreement across four syntactic structures is tested on Pythia-70M with 64×-width trained dictionaries and Gemma-2-2B with 8× Gemma Scope dictionaries. About 100/500 feature nodes explain most Pythia/Gemma behavior, versus roughly 1,500/50,000 neurons for half; human raters find sparse features more interpretable. Relative-clause case circuits contain 86 and 223 nodes at faithfulness 0.21 and expose number detectors, boundary detectors, and two routing paths. On Bias in Bios, classifiers trained where gender perfectly predicts professor/nurse labels are edited without balanced labels: SHIFT plus head retraining yields profession/worst-group accuracies of 93.1/89.0% for Pythia and 95.0/92.9% for Gemma, while gender prediction falls near chance. Clustering 8,192 to 100,000 confident Pile predictions produces thousands of circuits.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Sparse features support finer and more readable causal graphs than native neurons, and their semantic labels can guide useful interventions even when the spurious variable was not named in training. Held-out ablations, neuron comparisons, human ratings, and the SHIFT intervention provide strong task-level evidence. Circuits depend on Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) approximation and chosen thresholds, error nodes remain uninterpretable, highlighted small circuits explain only about 21% of behavior, human annotation can be subjective, and large-scale clustered circuits receive less causal and semantic validation.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究稀疏自编码器特征能否取代多义注意力头或神经元作为电路节点，从而形成既可解释又可用于编辑的可扩展因果图；并分别在已知语言行为、未知虚假分类信号移除及大规模无监督行为发现上检验。

**方法。** 稀疏特征与自编码器重构误差被插入模型计算图作为节点。带积分梯度的归因修补从对比输入估计节点和特征间边效应，阈值化形成电路，子图外均值消融衡量保真度。稀疏人类可解释特征修剪（Sparse Human-Interpretable Feature Trimming, SHIFT）让标注者删除被判断为任务无关的电路特征。另一流水线按内部激活或梯度聚类 Pile 中低损失预测，再为每个簇建电路。

**实验验证。** 在四种句法结构的主谓一致上，测试使用 64 倍宽自训字典的 Pythia-70M 和使用 8 倍 Gemma Scope 字典的 Gemma-2-2B。约 100/500 个特征节点解释两模型大部分行为，而解释一半表现需约 1,500/50,000 个神经元；人工也判定稀疏特征更可解释。关系从句案例电路含 86/223 节点，保真度均为 0.21，揭示数检测器、边界检测器和两条路由。在 Bias in Bios 中，用“性别完美预测教授/护士”的数据训练分类器，且不使用平衡标签编辑；SHIFT 加重训分类头后，Pythia 职业/最差组准确率为 93.1/89.0%，Gemma 为 95.0/92.9%，性别预测降到接近随机。对 8,192 至 100,000 条高置信 Pile 预测聚类得到数千电路。

**结论与证据。** 稀疏特征比原生神经元支持更细、更可读的因果图，其语义标签即使在训练时未命名虚假变量，也能指导有效干预。留出消融、神经元对比、人工评分和 SHIFT 干预提供强任务级证据。但电路依赖 SAE 近似和阈值，误差节点仍不可解释，小型案例只解释约 21% 行为，人工标注有主观性，大规模聚类电路的因果与语义验证也较弱。

p_2024_mcdougall_copy_suppression_compre.title: Copy Suppression: Comprehensively Understanding a Motif in Language Model Attention Heads
p_2024_mcdougall_copy_suppression_compre.venue: BlackboxNLP Workshop on Analyzing and Interpreting Neural Networks for NLP

abstract.en: We present the copy suppression motif: an algorithm implemented by attention heads in large language models that reduces loss.If i) language model components in earlier layers predict a certain token, ii) this token appears earlier in the context and iii) later attention heads in the model suppress prediction of the token, then this is copy suppression. To show the importance of copy suppression, we focus on reverse-engineering attention head 10.7 (L10H7) in GPT-2 Small. This head suppresses naive copying behavior which improves overall model calibration, which explains why multiple prior works studying certain narrow tasks found negative heads that systematically favored the wrong answer. We uncover the mechanism that the negative heads use for copy suppression with weights-based evidence and are able to explain 76.9% of the impact of L10H7 in GPT-2 Small, by this motif alone.To the best of our knowledge, this is the most comprehensive description of the complete role of a component in a language model to date. One major effect of copy suppression is its role in self-repair. Self-repair refers to how ablating crucial model components results in downstream neural network parts compensating for this ablation. Copy suppression leads to self-repair: if an initial overconfident copier is ablated, then there is nothing to suppress. We show that self-repair is implemented by several mechanisms, one of which is copy suppression, which explains 39% of the behavior in a narrow task. Interactive visualizations of the copy suppression phenomena may be seen at our web app https://copy-suppression.streamlit.app/.
abstract.zh: 我们提出“复制抑制”模体：这是大语言模型中的注意力头为降低损失而实现的一种算法。如果（i）较早层中的语言模型组件预测某个 token，（ii）该 token 先前已在上下文中出现，并且（iii）模型中较后的注意力头抑制对该 token 的预测，那么这一过程就是复制抑制。为说明复制抑制的重要性，我们重点对 GPT-2 Small 的注意力头 10.7（L10H7）进行逆向工程。该注意力头通过抑制朴素复制行为来改善模型整体校准，这也解释了为何此前多项研究在某些狭窄任务中发现了系统性偏向错误答案的负向注意力头。我们利用基于权重的证据揭示负向注意力头实施复制抑制的机制，并且仅凭这一模体便能解释 L10H7 在 GPT-2 Small 中 76.9% 的影响。据我们所知，这是迄今对语言模型中单个组件完整作用最全面的描述。复制抑制的一项重要影响体现在自修复中。自修复是指：消融关键模型组件后，下游神经网络部分会对该消融进行补偿。复制抑制会导致自修复——如果最初那个过度自信的复制组件被消融，便不再有需要抑制的对象。我们表明，自修复由多种机制实现，其中之一就是复制抑制；在一个狭窄任务中，它可以解释 39% 的行为。复制抑制现象的交互式可视化可见于我们的 Web 应用：https://copy-suppression.streamlit.app/。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether one attention head can be explained across the natural-text distribution rather than only on a narrow task. It tests whether GPT-2 Small head L10H7 implements copy suppression—detecting a token that an earlier component is overconfidently copying from context and writing a negative logit for that token—and whether this motif explains anti-induction and part of ablation self-repair.

**Method.** The output–value (OV) circuit is analyzed to identify which attended token logits the head suppresses, while the query–key (QK) circuit tests whether attention targets tokens currently overpredicted by the residual stream. Copy-Suppression-Preserving Ablation (CSPA) retains only value directions that suppress the source token and only attention from sources meeting the copy-suppression conditions. Its explained-effect metric is (1-D_{\mathrm{CSPA}}/D_{\mathrm{MA}}), where each (D) is the Kullback–Leibler divergence from the intact output and MA is mean ablation.

**Validation.** On OpenWebText, the top 5% of completions by L10H7 loss impact account for half its total loss reduction; 80% of a sample satisfy three preregistered-style behavioral conditions. Weight and prompt analyses find 84.70%/95.72% agreement for the OV/QK predictions, and when attention exceeds 10%, 78.24% of source tokens are among the ten most suppressed. Full CSPA explains 76.9% of the head's distributional effect; OV-only and QK-only variants explain 81.1% and 95.2%, and full CSPA reaches 88.1% in the most affected percentile. In the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) task, ablating three Name Mover Heads and measuring correct-minus-incorrect-name logits shows L10H7 plus L11H10 account for 39% of downstream self-repair. Model-family checks test related heads in larger systems.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** L10H7 is primarily a copy-suppression head: it reads both contextual token identity and current prediction confidence, then reduces naive repeated-token probability; the same negative feedback creates apparent self-repair when upstream copiers are ablated. Converging weight analysis, natural-data statistics, mechanism-preserving ablation, and the IOI intervention provide unusually strong evidence for this head's dominant function. CSPA still leaves 23.1% unexplained, QK inputs to repair heads are not fully understood, IOI is narrow, and larger-model results identify the motif behaviorally without the same mechanistic completeness.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究能否在自然文本分布而非单一狭窄任务上解释一个注意力头。具体检验 GPT-2 Small 的 L10H7 是否执行“复制抑制”：发现早层组件从上下文中过度自信复制的词元，并为该词元写入负 logit；以及这一母题能否解释反归纳与部分消融自修复。

**方法。** 输出—值（Output–Value, OV）电路分析该头会压制所关注词元中的哪些 logit，查询—键（Query–Key, QK）电路检验注意力是否指向残差流当前过度预测的词元。复制抑制保持消融（Copy-Suppression-Preserving Ablation, CSPA）只保留压制来源词元的值方向，并只保留满足复制抑制条件的来源注意力。解释比例定义为 (1-D_{\mathrm{CSPA}}/D_{\mathrm{MA}})，其中 (D) 是相对完整输出的 Kullback–Leibler 散度，MA 为均值消融。

**实验验证。** OpenWebText 上，按 L10H7 损失影响排名前 5% 的补全贡献了该头总降损作用的一半；抽样中 80% 同时满足三项预设行为条件。权重和提示分析对 OV/QK 预测的一致率分别为 84.70%/95.72%；当注意力超过 10% 时，78.24% 的来源词元位列该头最强压制的前十。完整 CSPA 解释 76.9% 的分布效应，只有 OV/QK 的变体分别为 81.1%/95.2%，在影响最大的百分位完整 CSPA 达 88.1%。间接宾语识别（Indirect Object Identification, IOI）中，消融三个姓名搬运头并用正确—错误姓名 logit 差衡量，L10H7 与 L11H10 合计解释下游自修复的 39%；另在更大模型家族中检查相关注意力头。

**结论与证据。** L10H7 的主要功能是复制抑制：它同时读取上下文词元身份与当前预测置信度，再降低朴素重复词元的概率；当上游复制头被消融时，同一负反馈减少，从而表现为自修复。权重分析、自然数据统计、机制保持消融和 IOI 干预汇聚，为该头主导功能提供异常强的证据。但 CSPA 仍有 23.1% 未解释，自修复头的 QK 输入未完全理解，IOI 较狭窄，而大模型中只在行为层面识别母题，未达到同等机制完整度。

p_2024_muhamed_decoding_dark_matter.title: Decoding Dark Matter: Specialized Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Rare Concepts in Foundation Models
p_2024_muhamed_decoding_dark_matter.venue: North American Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics

abstract.en: Understanding and mitigating the potential risks associated with foundation models (FMs) hinges on developing effective interpretability methods. Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a promising tool for disentangling FM representations, but they struggle to capture rare, yet crucial concepts in the data. We introduce Specialized Sparse Autoencoders (SSAEs), designed to illuminate these elusive dark matter features by focusing on specific subdomains. We present a practical recipe for training SSAEs, demonstrating the efficacy of dense retrieval for data selection and the benefits of Tilted Empirical Risk Minimization as a training objective to improve concept recall. Our evaluation of SSAEs on standard metrics, such as downstream perplexity and $L_0$ sparsity, show that they effectively capture subdomain tail concepts, exceeding the capabilities of general-purpose SAEs. We showcase the practical utility of SSAEs in a case study on the Bias in Bios dataset, where SSAEs achieve a 12.5\% increase in worst-group classification accuracy when applied to remove spurious gender information. SSAEs provide a powerful new lens for peering into the inner workings of FMs in subdomains.
abstract.zh: 理解并缓解基础模型（FM）的潜在风险，有赖于开发有效的可解释性方法。稀疏自编码器（SAE）已成为解耦基础模型表征的一种有前景的工具，但它们难以捕捉数据中罕见却至关重要的概念。我们提出专用稀疏自编码器（SSAE），通过聚焦特定子领域来揭示这些难以捕捉的“暗物质”特征。我们给出训练 SSAE 的实用方案，展示使用稠密检索选择数据的有效性，以及把倾斜经验风险最小化作为训练目标以提高概念召回率的益处。使用下游困惑度和 $L_0$ 稀疏性等标准指标进行的评估表明，SSAE 能有效捕捉子领域的长尾概念，其能力超过通用 SAE。我们还在 Bias in Bios 数据集的案例研究中展示 SSAE 的实际用途：使用 SSAE 去除虚假的性别信息后，最差群体分类准确率提高了 12.5%。SSAE 为深入观察基础模型在子领域中的内部运作提供了一种强有力的新视角。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks how sparse autoencoders (SAEs) can capture rare, safety- or domain-relevant concepts without scaling a general dictionary to billions of features. It tests whether subdomain-focused data retrieval and a tail-sensitive training objective improve rare-concept representation, interpretability, detection, and control.

**Method.** A Specialized Sparse Autoencoder (SSAE) starts from a general-purpose SAE and fine-tunes on pretraining examples retrieved from a small seed set by BM25, dense embeddings, and optional TracIn gradient reranking. Tilted Empirical Risk Minimization (TERM) replaces average reconstruction risk with a log-sum-exp tilt, increasingly emphasizing high-error examples as the tilt grows. Perplexity after SAE insertion and latent (L_0) measure fidelity/sparsity; logit-lens coverage, probes, automated explanations, and feature ablation measure tail concepts.

**Validation.** Gemma-2B layer-12, 16,384-feature SAEs are specialized from OpenWebText using a 9.2K-token physics seed expanded to 13.9M tokens, then evaluated on 4.8M arXiv-physics tokens and 700K out-of-distribution physics-instruction tokens; toxicity experiments replicate the ranking. Dense retrieval beats BM25, with TracIn providing a smaller additional gain, and covers more low-frequency physics/toxicity tokens at matched (L_0). For Bias in Bios, Pythia-70M dictionaries pretrained on 2B Pile tokens are fine-tuned on 8M tokens retrieved from five seeds; SSAE-guided spurious-feature removal raises profession accuracy 1.7 points and worst-group accuracy 12.5 points versus the general SAE while lowering gender predictability. TERM reduces tail reconstruction error and improves concept recall with comparable perplexity.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Targeted retrieval is a more efficient route to rare, domain-specific features than indiscriminately widening a general SAE, while TERM shifts the precision–recall trade-off toward detecting rare concepts. In/out-of-domain Pareto tests, tail coverage, and a causal fairness edit provide substantial support. Specialization depends on seed and retriever quality, may reduce general-domain coverage, TERM sacrifices some fine-grained control, automated interpretations rely on another model, and only physics, toxicity, biographies, and TinyStories are tested.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究如何在不把通用字典扩展到数十亿特征的情况下，让稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoder, SAE）捕获稀有但与安全或领域相关的概念；并检验子领域数据检索和偏重尾部的训练目标能否改善稀有概念的表示、解释、检测与控制。

**方法。** 专用稀疏自编码器（Specialized Sparse Autoencoder, SSAE）从通用 SAE 出发，用少量种子经 BM25、稠密嵌入及可选 TracIn 梯度重排，从预训练语料检索样本再微调。倾斜经验风险最小化（Tilted Empirical Risk Minimization, TERM）用 log-sum-exp 倾斜替代平均重构风险，倾斜越大越关注高误差样本。插入 SAE 后困惑度与潜变量 (L_0) 衡量保真/稀疏，logit-lens 覆盖、探针、自动解释和特征消融衡量尾部概念。

**实验验证。** Gemma-2B 第 12 层、16,384 特征 SAE 从 OpenWebText 出发，用 9,200 词元物理种子扩到 1,390 万词元，随后在 480 万 arXiv 物理词元和 70 万分布外物理指令词元上评测；毒性实验复现排序。稠密检索优于 BM25，TracIn 带来较小附加增益，并在相同 (L_0) 下覆盖更多低频物理/毒性词元。Bias in Bios 中，Pythia-70M 字典先用 20 亿 Pile 词元训练，再用 5 个种子检索的 800 万词元专门化；相对通用 SAE，基于 SSAE 的虚假特征移除使职业准确率提高 1.7 点、最差组准确率提高 12.5 点，并降低性别可预测性。TERM 降低尾部重构误差，以近似困惑度提高概念召回。

**结论与证据。** 定向检索比无差别扩大通用 SAE 更高效地获得稀有领域特征，TERM 则把精确率—召回率权衡推向稀有概念检测。分布内外 Pareto 测试、尾部覆盖及因果公平编辑提供较强支持。但专门化依赖种子和检索器，可能损失通用覆盖，TERM 会牺牲部分细粒度控制，自动解释依赖另一模型，实验领域也仅限物理、毒性、人物简介与 TinyStories。

p_2024_neo_towards_interpreting_visual.title: Towards Interpreting Visual Information Processing in Vision-Language Models

abstract.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are powerful tools for processing and understanding text and images. We study the processing of visual tokens in the language model component of LLaVA, a prominent VLM. Our approach focuses on analyzing the localization of object information, the evolution of visual token representations across layers, and the mechanism of integrating visual information for predictions. Through ablation studies, we demonstrated that object identification accuracy drops by over 70\% when object-specific tokens are removed. We observed that visual token representations become increasingly interpretable in the vocabulary space across layers, suggesting an alignment with textual tokens corresponding to image content. Finally, we found that the model extracts object information from these refined representations at the last token position for prediction, mirroring the process in text-only language models for factual association tasks. These findings provide crucial insights into how VLMs process and integrate visual information, bridging the gap between our understanding of language and vision models, and paving the way for more interpretable and controllable multimodal systems.
abstract.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）是处理和理解文本与图像的强大工具。我们研究代表性视觉语言模型 LLaVA 的语言模型组件如何处理视觉 token。研究方法聚焦于分析物体信息的定位、视觉 token 表征跨层的演变，以及整合视觉信息用于预测的机制。消融研究显示，移除物体特定 token 后，物体识别准确率下降超过 70%。我们观察到，视觉 token 表征在跨层传播时，在词汇空间中变得越来越可解释，这表明它们逐渐与对应图像内容的文本 token 对齐。最后，我们发现，模型会在最后一个 token 位置从这些经过细化的表征中提取物体信息用于预测，这与纯文本语言模型处理事实关联任务的过程相似。这些发现为视觉语言模型如何处理和整合视觉信息提供了关键认识，弥合了语言模型与视觉模型之间的理解差距，并为构建更具可解释性和可控性的多模态系统铺平道路。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks where object information resides after image patches are mapped into a language model, how those visual-token states evolve across layers, and whether object information is directly extracted to the answer position or first summarized elsewhere. It tests whether mechanisms known from text-only factual recall transfer to adapter-style vision–language models.

**Method.** Spatially targeted mean ablation replaces object-region visual tokens, buffered regions, high-norm “register” tokens, random tokens, or integrated-gradient-selected tokens. A logit lens maps each intermediate visual state through the vocabulary unembedding to track text alignment. Attention knockout blocks selected source–destination token links in sliding layer windows, distinguishing direct object-to-answer extraction from global or last-visual-row summarization.

**Validation.** The main model is LLaVA-1.5 with 576 visual tokens, with LLaVA-Phi-3 and Qwen2-VL-2B replications. From COCO Detection, 4,318 simple images are retained only when masking the target object breaks recognition; three tests use free descriptions, yes/no polling, and a manually curated 100-image visual-question-answering set. Ablating spatial object tokens causes over 70% loss in identification and exceeds random, register, and gradient baselines at matched counts. On 170 COCO images, 23.7% of object patches decode to the correct class at each image's best layer, averaging layer 25.7/33; Qwen2-VL obtains 6.5% at 25.1/29 on 253 images. Blocking object-to-final-token attention is most damaging in middle-to-late layers, whereas blocking transfers into the final visual row has little effect.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Object evidence remains strongly localized to its original spatial patches, is progressively refined toward language-like vocabulary directions, and is read directly into the answer position mainly in middle-to-late language-model layers. Targeted ablations and attention blocking give local causal support, with cross-model replication for representation and routing trends. Logit-lens matches are correlational and sparse, filtering selects cases the model already handles, tasks are simple object identification rather than reasoning, and results may not generalize beyond adapter-style architectures.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究图像块映射进语言模型后，物体信息位于何处、视觉词元状态如何跨层演化，以及信息是直接提取到答案位置还是先在其他位置汇总；并检验纯文本事实回忆中的机制是否迁移到适配器式视觉—语言模型。

**方法。** 空间定向均值消融分别替换物体区域视觉词元、带缓冲区域、高范数“寄存器”词元、随机词元或积分梯度选出的词元。logit lens 把每层视觉状态经反嵌入映射到词表，追踪文本对齐；注意力敲除在滑动层窗口中阻断指定来源—目标词元连接，区分直接物体到答案提取、全局汇总和最后视觉行汇总。

**实验验证。** 主模型为含 576 个视觉词元的 LLaVA-1.5，并在 LLaVA-Phi-3 与 Qwen2-VL-2B 复现。COCO Detection 中筛得 4,318 张简单图像，只有遮盖目标物体会破坏识别者才保留；三项测试含自由描述、是/否询问及人工整理的 100 图视觉问答集。消融空间物体词元使识别下降超过 70%，在相同数量下大于随机、寄存器和梯度基线。170 张 COCO 图像上，每图最佳层平均有 23.7% 物体块解码为正确类别，最佳层均值 25.7/33；Qwen2-VL 在 253 图上为 6.5%、25.1/29。阻断物体到末词元注意力在中后层破坏最大，而阻断信息进入最后视觉行几乎无效。

**结论与证据。** 物体证据强烈局限于原空间块，随后逐层细化为更接近语言词表的方向，并主要在语言模型中后层直接读入答案位置。定向消融和注意力阻断提供局部因果支持，表示与路由趋势也跨模型复现。但 logit-lens 匹配相关性强且比例不高，筛选只保留模型本来能做的案例，任务是简单物体识别而非推理，结果也未必适用于非适配器架构。

p_2024_nichani_how_transformers_learn.title: How Transformers Learn Causal Structure with Gradient Descent

abstract.en: The incredible success of transformers on sequence modeling tasks can be largely attributed to the self-attention mechanism, which allows information to be transferred between different parts of a sequence. Self-attention allows transformers to encode causal structure which makes them particularly suitable for sequence modeling. However, the process by which transformers learn such causal structure via gradient-based training algorithms remains poorly understood. To better understand this process, we introduce an in-context learning task that requires learning latent causal structure. We prove that gradient descent on a simplified two-layer transformer learns to solve this task by encoding the latent causal graph in the first attention layer. The key insight of our proof is that the gradient of the attention matrix encodes the mutual information between tokens. As a consequence of the data processing inequality, the largest entries of this gradient correspond to edges in the latent causal graph. As a special case, when the sequences are generated from in-context Markov chains, we prove that transformers learn an induction head (Olsson et al., 2022). We confirm our theoretical findings by showing that transformers trained on our in-context learning task are able to recover a wide variety of causal structures.
abstract.zh: Transformer 在序列建模任务上的巨大成功，很大程度上归功于自注意力机制；该机制使信息能够在序列的不同部分之间传递。自注意力使 Transformer 可以编码因果结构，因此尤其适合序列建模。然而，Transformer 如何通过基于梯度的训练算法学到这类因果结构，目前仍未得到充分理解。为更好地理解这一过程，我们引入一个需要学习潜在因果结构的上下文学习任务。我们证明，在一个简化的两层 Transformer 上，梯度下降会通过在第一注意力层中编码潜在因果图来学会解决该任务。证明的关键认识是，注意力矩阵的梯度编码 token 之间的互信息。根据数据处理不等式，该梯度中最大的条目对应潜在因果图中的边。作为一个特例，当序列由上下文中的马尔可夫链生成时，我们证明 Transformer 会学到归纳注意力头（Olsson 等，2022）。我们还发现，在该上下文学习任务上训练的 Transformer 能恢复多种因果结构，从而验证了理论结果。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks how gradient descent causes a randomly initialized Transformer to discover latent causal dependencies needed for in-context prediction. It seeks both the circuit learned by a two-layer model and a training-dynamics explanation, including induction heads as a special case.

**Method.** Sequences are generated from a latent directed graph whose parent-token conditionals are resampled between contexts, so prediction requires inferring graph edges and then estimating the relevant conditional. A disentangled two-layer Transformer is reduced to trainable positional attention matrices. Stage-wise population gradient descent first learns a first-layer adjacency matrix and then a second-layer matching/aggregation operation. The proof relates the initial attention gradient to token mutual information; data processing makes direct parent edges dominate indirect relations.

**Validation.** Synthetic experiments use vocabulary size 10, sequence length 20, batches of 1,024, and Dirichlet-sampled conditionals; a two-attention-layer decoder is also trained with standard embeddings. Weight visualizations show the first-layer block converging to the true graph adjacency and later blocks to identity-style copying. Single-parent, random-graph, multiple-parent, and Markov-chain structures are tested. A quantitative replication over 20 random graphs with 20 vertices and vocabulary size 3 compares learned edge patterns, while loss and adjacency recovery across training track the two theoretical stages.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Under the stated generative and architectural assumptions, gradient descent learns causal structure because early gradients rank direct parents by mutual information, after which a second attention layer retrieves matching precedents; an in-context Markov chain yields an induction-head circuit. The theorem and diverse synthetic graph recovery provide strong evidence within this model. The result uses population/stage-wise training, a reduced sparse parameterization, controlled discrete data, and separation assumptions on mutual information, so it does not explain how full-scale language models learn arbitrary real-world causal structure.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究梯度下降如何使随机初始化 Transformer 发现上下文预测所需的潜在因果依赖；目标既包括两层模型学到的电路，也包括训练动力学解释，并把归纳注意力头作为特例。

**方法。** 序列由潜在有向图生成，各父词元条件分布在不同上下文间重采样，因此预测必须先推断图边，再估计相应条件分布。研究把解耦两层 Transformer 约化为可训练的位置注意力矩阵；分阶段总体梯度下降先学习第一层邻接矩阵，再学习第二层匹配/聚合操作。证明把初始注意力梯度与词元互信息联系起来，并利用数据处理不等式说明直接父边强于间接关系。

**实验验证。** 合成实验使用词表 10、序列长度 20、批量 1,024 和 Dirichlet 条件分布，也训练带标准嵌入的两注意力层解码器。权重图显示第一层块收敛到真实图邻接矩阵，后层块收敛到类似恒等复制；测试单父、随机图、多父和马尔可夫链结构。20 个顶点、词表 3 的 20 张随机图用于量化复现，并以训练过程中的损失和邻接恢复追踪理论两阶段。

**结论与证据。** 在给定生成与架构假设下，梯度下降之所以学到因果结构，是因为早期梯度按互信息突出直接父节点，第二注意力层再检索匹配先例；上下文马尔可夫链由此产生归纳头电路。定理和多种合成图恢复在该模型内提供强证据。但结论依赖总体/分阶段训练、约化稀疏参数化、受控离散数据及互信息分离假设，不能解释大规模语言模型如何学习任意现实因果结构。
