p_2024_o_neill_sparse_autoencoders_enabl.title: Sparse Autoencoders Enable Scalable and Reliable Circuit Identification in Language Models

abstract.en: This paper introduces an efficient and robust method for discovering interpretable circuits in large language models using discrete sparse autoencoders. Our approach addresses key limitations of existing techniques, namely computational complexity and sensitivity to hyperparameters. We propose training sparse autoencoders on carefully designed positive and negative examples, where the model can only correctly predict the next token for the positive examples. We hypothesise that learned representations of attention head outputs will signal when a head is engaged in specific computations. By discretising the learned representations into integer codes and measuring the overlap between codes unique to positive examples for each head, we enable direct identification of attention heads involved in circuits without the need for expensive ablations or architectural modifications. On three well-studied tasks - indirect object identification, greater-than comparisons, and docstring completion - the proposed method achieves higher precision and recall in recovering ground-truth circuits compared to state-of-the-art baselines, while reducing runtime from hours to seconds. Notably, we require only 5-10 text examples for each task to learn robust representations. Our findings highlight the promise of discrete sparse autoencoders for scalable and efficient mechanistic interpretability, offering a new direction for analysing the inner workings of large language models.
abstract.zh: 本文提出一种利用离散稀疏自编码器在大型语言模型中发现可解释回路的高效、稳健方法。该方法针对现有技术的两个主要局限：计算复杂度高，以及对超参数敏感。我们提出在精心设计的正例和负例上训练稀疏自编码器，其中模型只能对正例正确预测下一个 token。我们假设，注意力头输出的学习表征能够指示某个注意力头何时参与特定计算。通过将学习到的表征离散化为整数编码，并衡量每个注意力头在正例中特有编码的重叠程度，我们无需昂贵的消融实验或架构修改，就能直接识别参与回路的注意力头。在间接宾语识别、大于比较和文档字符串补全三个经过充分研究的任务上，与当前最佳基线相比，该方法在恢复真值回路时取得了更高的精确率和召回率，同时把运行时间从数小时缩短到数秒。值得注意的是，每个任务只需 5–10 个文本样例，就可以学习到稳健的表征。结果表明，离散稀疏自编码器有望支持可扩展、高效的机制可解释性研究，并为分析大型语言模型的内部工作机制提供新的方向。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether discrete sparse-autoencoder codes learned from a few contrastive examples can identify task-relevant attention heads and head pairs without choosing a behavioral metric or repeatedly ablating the model. It tests speed, robustness, reference-circuit recovery, and faithfulness.

**Method.** An autoencoder is trained on cached outputs of every attention head for paired positive prompts, where a known computation yields a predictable next token, and semantically similar negative prompts without that solution. Each head output is discretized to its maximally active code. Heads are ranked by codes unique to positives; edges are ranked by positive-only code co-occurrences between head pairs. Softmax thresholds convert these counts into node/edge circuits.

**Validation.** GPT-2 Small experiments cover Indirect Object Identification (IOI), greater-than, and Python docstring completion, each with 250 positive and 250 negative prompts; the autoencoder itself is usually trained on only 5–10 examples. Against Automated Circuit Discovery, head-importance pruning, subnetwork probing, and Edge Attribution Patching, the method has the best or matched node/edge receiver-operating-characteristic area under the curve on nearly every task, the exception being ACDC edges for docstrings. One hundred autoencoder hyperparameter runs test robustness. End-to-end search takes under 15 seconds on GPT-2 Small and under one minute on GPT-2 XL. The recovered IOI circuit reaches logit difference 3.62 versus 3.55 for the full model; its greater-than circuit reaches 76.54% probability difference and 5.76% cutoff sharpness. Tracr ground-truth tasks yield AUC 1.0, and induction tests extend to Pythia-160M and OPT-125M.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Contrastive discrete codes provide a fast, largely metric-free signal for which attention heads participate in a task, and the resulting small circuits can match or exceed full-model behavior. Reference recovery, ablation faithfulness, compiled-transformer truth, and model/task replications support the approach. The main “ground-truth” language circuits are human reconstructions that may be incomplete, greater-than code counting still needs all 500 examples, only attention heads are analyzed, and code uniqueness may mark correlation with prompt construction rather than a necessary mechanism.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究从少量对比样本学到的离散稀疏自编码器编码，能否在不选择行为指标、也不反复消融模型的情况下识别任务相关注意力头及头对；并检验速度、稳健性、参考电路恢复和保真度。

**方法。** 自编码器在全部注意力头的缓存输出上训练；正提示会触发已知计算并产生可预测下一词元，负提示语义相似但不存在该解法。每个头输出离散为最大激活编码，按只在正例出现的编码排序节点，按头对中只在正例出现的编码共现排序边，再用 softmax 阈值得到节点/边电路。

**实验验证。** GPT-2 Small 上覆盖间接宾语识别（Indirect Object Identification, IOI）、大于和 Python docstring 补全，每项各 250 个正负提示；自编码器本身通常只用 5—10 个样本训练。与自动电路发现、注意力头重要性剪枝、子网探针和边归因修补比较，除 docstring 的 ACDC 边外，几乎所有任务的节点/边受试者工作特征曲线下面积都最好或持平；100 组超参数训练检验稳健性。完整搜索在 GPT-2 Small 少于 15 秒、GPT-2 XL 少于 1 分钟。IOI 电路 logit 差为 3.62，完整模型 3.55；大于电路概率差 76.54%、截断锐度 5.76%。Tracr 真值任务 AUC 为 1.0，归纳实验扩展到 Pythia-160M 和 OPT-125M。

**结论与证据。** 对比离散编码为注意力头是否参与任务提供快速、基本不依赖指标的信号，所得小电路可匹配或超过完整模型行为。参考恢复、消融保真、编译 Transformer 真值及跨模型/任务复现支持该方法。但语言电路“真值”是可能不完整的人工重构，“大于”编码计数仍需全部 500 样本，分析只覆盖注意力头，而且编码独有性可能只是与提示构造相关，而非必要机制。

p_2024_prakash_fine_tuning_enhances.title: Fine-Tuning Enhances Existing Mechanisms: A Case Study on Entity Tracking

abstract.en: Fine-tuning on generalized tasks such as instruction following, code generation, and mathematics has been shown to enhance language models' performance on a range of tasks. Nevertheless, explanations of how such fine-tuning influences the internal computations in these models remain elusive. We study how fine-tuning affects the internal mechanisms implemented in language models. As a case study, we explore the property of entity tracking, a crucial facet of language comprehension, where models fine-tuned on mathematics have substantial performance gains. We identify the mechanism that enables entity tracking and show that (i) in both the original model and its fine-tuned versions primarily the same circuit implements entity tracking. In fact, the entity tracking circuit of the original model on the fine-tuned versions performs better than the full original model. (ii) The circuits of all the models implement roughly the same functionality: Entity tracking is performed by tracking the position of the correct entity in both the original model and its fine-tuned versions. (iii) Performance boost in the fine-tuned models is primarily attributed to its improved ability to handle the augmented positional information. To uncover these findings, we employ: Patch Patching, DCM, which automatically detects model components responsible for specific semantics, and CMAP, a new approach for patching activations across models to reveal improved mechanisms. Our findings suggest that fine-tuning enhances, rather than fundamentally alters, the mechanistic operation of the model.
abstract.zh: 已有研究表明，在指令遵循、代码生成和数学等通用任务上微调，可以提高语言模型在一系列任务上的表现。然而，这类微调如何影响模型内部计算，仍缺乏明确解释。我们研究微调对语言模型所实现内部机制的影响，并以实体追踪作为案例。实体追踪是语言理解的一个关键方面，而在数学任务上微调的模型会在该能力上取得显著提升。我们识别出支持实体追踪的机制，并表明：（i）原始模型与其微调版本主要由同一个回路实现实体追踪；事实上，把原始模型的实体追踪回路置于微调版本中运行，其表现优于完整的原始模型。（ii）所有模型的回路实现大致相同的功能：原始模型及其微调版本都通过追踪正确实体的位置完成实体追踪。（iii）微调模型的性能提升主要来自其处理增强位置信息的能力得到改善。为揭示这些发现，我们使用路径修补、自动检测负责特定语义之模型组件的 DCM，以及一种跨模型修补激活以揭示机制改进的新方法 CMAP。结果表明，微调会增强模型已有机制，而不是从根本上改变其机制运作。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether arithmetic or instruction fine-tuning improves entity tracking by creating a new mechanism or strengthening one already present in a base model. It further asks what the shared circuit computes and which internal changes account for the performance gain.

**Method.** Path patching discovers attention-head routes for retrieving an object's value from a queried box. Desiderata-based Component Masking (DCM) trains masks to identify heads encoding object identity, box labels, or object position, followed by targeted activation patching. Cross-Model Activation Patching (CMAP) transfers activations between the base and fine-tuned models at aligned components to locate enhanced subcomputations. Faithfulness, completeness, minimality, and random circuits evaluate the graph.

**Validation.** Llama-7B, conversation-tuned Vicuna-7B, LoRA arithmetic-tuned Goat-7B, and full arithmetic-tuned FLoat-7B answer 500 synthetic tasks with seven randomly labeled boxes and single-token objects; chance is 0.14. DCM uses 1,000 training and 500 evaluation examples. The 72-head Llama circuit transfers without graph adjustment and remains faithful across models; separately discovered Goat and FLoat circuits contain 175 heads and achieve faithfulness 0.99 and 1.0 in their own models, with strong cross-transfer and large overlap, approximating supersets of the base circuit. Attention knockout and CMAP show early heads moving query-box/position information and later heads fetching the object; patching fine-tuned positional representations into Llama recovers much of the improvement.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Fine-tuning primarily amplifies and extends an existing entity-tracking algorithm rather than replacing it: all models use a shared positional routing core, while arithmetic-tuned models recruit extra heads and encode the relevant position more effectively. Circuit transfer, model-to-model activation interventions, and matched functionality provide strong causal evidence for this task. The circuits are not perfectly complete, one head group remains unexplained, synthetic no-update boxes simplify entity tracking, and four Llama-derived 7B models cannot establish a general law of fine-tuning.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究算术或指令微调提升实体追踪，是创造新机制还是增强基础模型已有机制；并进一步询问共享电路计算什么，以及哪些内部变化解释性能提升。

**方法。** 路径修补发现从被查询盒子取回物体值的注意力头路线；基于功能要求的组件掩码（Desiderata-based Component Masking, DCM）学习掩码，识别编码物体身份、盒子标签或物体位置的头，再做定向激活修补。跨模型激活修补（Cross-Model Activation Patching, CMAP）在基础与微调模型的对齐组件间迁移激活，定位被增强的子计算；保真度、完整性、最小性和随机电路用于评测。

**实验验证。** Llama-7B、对话微调 Vicuna-7B、LoRA 算术微调 Goat-7B 和全量算术微调 FLoat-7B 在 500 条合成任务上作答；每题含 7 个随机标签盒子和单词元物体，随机准确率 0.14。DCM 用 1,000 条训练、500 条评测。72 头 Llama 电路不调整图即可跨模型迁移且保持高保真；独立发现的 Goat/FLoat 电路各 175 头，在本模型保真度 0.99/1.0，交叉迁移强且与基础电路大幅重合，近似其超集。注意力敲除和 CMAP 显示早层搬运查询盒/位置信息，晚层取回物体；把微调模型的位置表示修补进 Llama 可恢复大部分提升。

**结论与证据。** 微调主要放大并扩展已有实体追踪算法，而非替换它：各模型共享位置路由核心，算术微调模型则招募更多头并更好地编码目标位置。电路迁移、跨模型激活干预和功能匹配为该任务提供强因果证据。但电路并非完全完整，一个注意力头组仍未解释，无状态更新的合成盒子简化了实体追踪，四个同源 7B 模型也不足以确立普遍微调规律。

p_2024_rajamanoharan_improving_dictionar.title: Improving Dictionary Learning with Gated Sparse Autoencoders

abstract.en: Recent work has found that sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are an effective technique for unsupervised discovery of interpretable features in language models' (LMs) activations, by finding sparse, linear reconstructions of LM activations. We introduce the Gated Sparse Autoencoder (Gated SAE), which achieves a Pareto improvement over training with prevailing methods. In SAEs, the L1 penalty used to encourage sparsity introduces many undesirable biases, such as shrinkage -- systematic underestimation of feature activations. The key insight of Gated SAEs is to separate the functionality of (a) determining which directions to use and (b) estimating the magnitudes of those directions: this enables us to apply the L1 penalty only to the former, limiting the scope of undesirable side effects. Through training SAEs on LMs of up to 7B parameters we find that, in typical hyper-parameter ranges, Gated SAEs solve shrinkage, are similarly interpretable, and require half as many firing features to achieve comparable reconstruction fidelity.
abstract.zh: 近期研究发现，稀疏自编码器（SAE）可以通过寻找语言模型（LM）激活的稀疏线性重构，以无监督方式有效发现可解释特征。我们提出门控稀疏自编码器（Gated SAE），相比当前主流训练方法实现了帕累托改进。在 SAE 中，用于促进稀疏性的 L1 惩罚会引入许多不良偏差，例如收缩——系统性低估特征激活。Gated SAE 的核心思想，是把（a）决定使用哪些方向与（b）估计这些方向的幅度两项功能分离。这样便可只对前者施加 L1 惩罚，限制其不良副作用的范围。我们在参数量最大达到 70 亿的语言模型上训练 SAE，结果发现，在典型超参数范围内，Gated SAE 能够解决收缩问题，保持相近的可解释性，并且只需一半数量的激活特征即可达到相当的重构忠实度。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether the standard (L_1) sparse-autoencoder objective harms reconstruction by coupling feature selection with coefficient estimation. It tests whether separating these two decisions eliminates activation shrinkage and improves the sparsity–fidelity frontier without sacrificing interpretability.

**Method.** A Gated Sparse Autoencoder uses one affine “gate” to decide whether each dictionary element is active and a second, magnitude branch to estimate its coefficient. The (L_1) penalty applies only to the gate, while an auxiliary reconstruction term ensures that gate directions themselves learn useful features. Decoder columns are normalized, and matched-capacity baselines receive 50% more features to compensate for the gated model's extra encoder parameters.

**Validation.** Gated and conventional rectified-linear SAEs are compared on a one-layer GELU language model, five residual-stream layers of Pythia-2.8B, and four layers of Gemma-7B, sweeping sparsity coefficients. Evaluation reports mean active features (L_0) and language-model cross-entropy loss recovered when reconstructions replace activations. Across sites and models, gated dictionaries form a better Pareto frontier and typically need about half as many firing features for matched fidelity. Regression of true activations on learned coefficients shows that the standard model systematically underestimates magnitudes while gating largely removes shrinkage. Blinded expert ratings find comparable feature interpretability; architectural and loss ablations show each gating component contributes to the gain.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Much of the standard SAE trade-off is an optimization artifact of applying sparsity pressure directly to feature magnitudes; decoupled detection and estimation improves fidelity without an observed semantic cost. Broad matched benchmarks, shrinkage measurements, and ablations strongly support this engineering conclusion. Human interpretation samples are limited, metrics still prioritize reconstruction rather than downstream causal value, extra encoder computation is required, and the study does not show that gated features are uniquely “true” model concepts.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究标准 (L_1) 稀疏自编码器目标把特征选择与系数估计耦合后，是否会损害重构；并检验把两项决策分离能否消除激活收缩、改善稀疏—保真前沿，同时不牺牲可解释性。

**方法。** 门控稀疏自编码器（Gated Sparse Autoencoder）用一个仿射“门”决定每个字典元素是否激活，另一幅度分支估计系数；(L_1) 惩罚只作用于门，辅助重构项保证门方向本身学习有用特征。解码列被归一化；为补偿门控模型更多编码参数，匹配基线获得多 50% 的特征。

**实验验证。** 在单层 GELU 语言模型、Pythia-2.8B 的 5 个残差流层和 Gemma-7B 的 4 个层上比较门控与普通 ReLU SAE，并扫描稀疏系数。指标为平均活跃特征数 (L_0)，以及用重构替换激活后恢复的语言模型交叉熵损失。跨位置和模型，门控字典形成更优 Pareto 前沿，通常只需约一半激活特征即可达到相同保真。真实激活对学习系数的回归显示普通模型系统性低估幅度，门控基本消除收缩。盲法专家评分认为两者特征解释性相当，架构与损失消融表明各门控组成均贡献增益。

**结论与证据。** 标准 SAE 的部分权衡其实来自直接压缩特征幅度的优化伪影；把检测与估计解耦能改善保真，且未观察到语义代价。广泛匹配基准、收缩测量和消融强力支持这一工程结论。但人工解释样本有限，指标仍偏重重构而非下游因果价值，门控需额外编码计算，研究也未证明所得特征是唯一“真实”模型概念。

p_2024_rajamanoharan_jumping_ahead_impro.title: Jumping Ahead: Improving Reconstruction Fidelity with JumpReLU Sparse Autoencoders

abstract.en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are a promising unsupervised approach for identifying causally relevant and interpretable linear features in a language model's (LM) activations. To be useful for downstream tasks, SAEs need to decompose LM activations faithfully; yet to be interpretable the decomposition must be sparse -- two objectives that are in tension. In this paper, we introduce JumpReLU SAEs, which achieve state-of-the-art reconstruction fidelity at a given sparsity level on Gemma 2 9B activations, compared to other recent advances such as Gated and TopK SAEs. We also show that this improvement does not come at the cost of interpretability through manual and automated interpretability studies. JumpReLU SAEs are a simple modification of vanilla (ReLU) SAEs -- where we replace the ReLU with a discontinuous JumpReLU activation function -- and are similarly efficient to train and run. By utilising straight-through-estimators (STEs) in a principled manner, we show how it is possible to train JumpReLU SAEs effectively despite the discontinuous JumpReLU function introduced in the SAE's forward pass. Similarly, we use STEs to directly train L0 to be sparse, instead of training on proxies such as L1, avoiding problems like shrinkage.
abstract.zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）是一种很有前景的无监督方法，可用于识别语言模型（LM）激活中具有因果相关性且可解释的线性特征。为了用于下游任务，SAE 必须忠实分解语言模型激活；但为了具有可解释性，这种分解又必须稀疏——两个目标彼此存在张力。本文提出 JumpReLU SAE。与 Gated SAE 和 TopK SAE 等近期方法相比，它在给定稀疏度下对 Gemma 2 9B 激活实现了最先进的重构忠实度。通过人工和自动化可解释性研究，我们还表明，这项改进并未以牺牲可解释性为代价。JumpReLU SAE 是对普通 ReLU SAE 的简单修改：把 ReLU 替换为不连续的 JumpReLU 激活函数；它的训练和运行效率也与普通 SAE 相近。通过以有原则的方式使用直通估计器（STE），我们说明了即使 SAE 的前向传播中引入了不连续的 JumpReLU 函数，仍可有效训练 JumpReLU SAE。类似地，我们使用 STE 直接训练 L0 稀疏性，而不是在 L1 等代理目标上训练，从而避免收缩等问题。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether an autoencoder can optimize the desired (L_0) count of active features directly, rather than an (L_1) proxy that shrinks magnitudes or a fixed Top-(K) constraint. It tests whether learned activation thresholds improve reconstruction at matched sparsity while retaining interpretable features.

**Method.** JumpReLU replaces ReLU with (z,\mathbf{1}[z>\theta]), using a learned positive threshold for every latent and an explicit (L_0) penalty. Although the step is discontinuous, a straight-through estimator derived as a kernel-density estimate supplies gradients for the thresholds. This lets each feature activate independently at inference, unlike Top-(K), without a separate auxiliary threshold task.

**Validation.** JumpReLU, Top-(K), original Gated, and reweighted-(L_1) Gated Sparse Autoencoder (SAE)s are trained for 8 billion tokens on Gemma-2-9B residual-stream, attention-output, and multilayer perceptron (MLP)-output activations after layers 9, 20, and 31. Sweeps compare (L_0) against language-model loss increase and fraction of variance unexplained; firing frequencies and attribution-weighted importance are also measured. JumpReLU consistently matches or exceeds Top-(K) fidelity and exceeds Gated variants at matched (L_0). Manual raters and automated explanation/prediction scores find no interpretability loss. Kernel, bandwidth, threshold-targeting, and architecture ablations check training stability.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Learned jump thresholds make direct (L_0) optimization practical and give a robust sparsity–fidelity improvement over major contemporary SAE variants, without detectable loss in average feature interpretability. Multi-site, multi-layer Pareto comparisons and independent interpretation tests provide strong comparative evidence. All experiments use one model family, standard reconstruction metrics may not predict causal utility, straight-through gradients remain biased approximations, and average interpretability scores can hide rare pathological features.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究自编码器能否直接优化期望的活跃特征数 (L_0)，而不是使用会收缩幅度的 (L_1) 代理或固定 Top-(K) 约束；并检验可学习激活阈值能否在相同稀疏度下提高重构，同时保留可解释特征。

**方法。** JumpReLU 用 (z,\mathbf{1}[z>\theta]) 替代 ReLU，为每个潜变量学习正阈值，并直接加入 (L_0) 惩罚。尽管阶跃不连续，研究把直通估计器推导为核密度估计，为阈值提供梯度；因此各特征在推理时可独立激活，不像 Top-(K) 相互竞争，也无需单独阈值辅助任务。

**实验验证。** JumpReLU、Top-(K)、原始 Gated 和重加权 (L_1) Gated 稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoder, SAE） 均在 Gemma-2-9B 第 9、20、31 层后的残差流、注意力输出和 多层感知机（Multilayer Perceptron, MLP） 输出上训练 80 亿词元。扫描比较 (L_0) 与语言模型损失增量、未解释方差比例，并测量激活频率和归因加权重要性。相同 (L_0) 下，JumpReLU 持续持平或超过 Top-(K)，并优于 Gated 变体；人工评分和自动解释/预测分数未发现可解释性损失。核函数、带宽、目标稀疏度和架构消融检验训练稳定性。

**结论与证据。** 可学习跳跃阈值使直接 (L_0) 优化可行，并在主要同期 SAE 变体上稳定改善稀疏—保真权衡，且平均特征解释性未受可检测损失。多位置、多层 Pareto 比较和独立解释测试提供强比较证据。但实验只用一个模型家族，标准重构指标未必预测因果用途，直通梯度仍是有偏近似，平均解释分也可能掩盖罕见病态特征。

p_2024_shai_transformers_represent_belie.title: Transformers represent belief state geometry in their residual stream

abstract.en: What computational structure are we building into large language models when we train them on next-token prediction? Here, we present evidence that this structure is given by the meta-dynamics of belief updating over hidden states of the data-generating process. Leveraging the theory of optimal prediction, we anticipate and then find that belief states are linearly represented in the residual stream of transformers, even in cases where the predicted belief state geometry has highly nontrivial fractal structure. We investigate cases where the belief state geometry is represented in the final residual stream or distributed across the residual streams of multiple layers, providing a framework to explain these observations. Furthermore we demonstrate that the inferred belief states contain information about the entire future, beyond the local next-token prediction that the transformers are explicitly trained on. Our work provides a general framework connecting the structure of training data to the geometric structure of activations inside transformers.
abstract.zh: 当我们使用下一 token 预测训练大语言模型时，究竟在模型中构建了什么样的计算结构？本文给出证据，表明这种结构由数据生成过程中针对隐藏状态进行信念更新的元动力学所决定。借助最优预测理论，我们预先推导并随后发现：信念状态在线性意义上表征于 Transformer 的残差流中，即使预测出的信念状态几何具有高度非平凡的分形结构也是如此。我们研究了信念状态几何表征在最终残差流中的情况，也研究了它分布于多个层的残差流中的情况，并提供一个解释这些现象的框架。此外，我们证明，推断出的信念状态包含有关整个未来的信息，超出了 Transformer 明确接受训练的局部下一 token 预测。我们的工作提供了一个通用框架，将训练数据的结构与 Transformer 内部激活的几何结构联系起来。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks what internal structure next-token prediction forces a Transformer to learn about a hidden data-generating process. It tests whether residual states represent the Bayesian belief distribution over latent states—including information about the entire future that is invisible in the immediate next-token distribution—and whether that geometry can span layers.

**Method.** Computational mechanics converts a known edge-emitting hidden Markov model (HMM) into a mixed-state presentation: each observed prefix induces a belief vector (eta) over generator states, updated by Bayes' rule. Transformers are trained on HMM sequences, and affine regression maps residual activations to the ground-truth belief simplex. Geometric distance preservation and comparison with next-token probabilities distinguish belief representation from mere output decoding.

**Validation.** On the three-state Mess3 process, a 2-D projection of 64-dimensional final residual activations reproduces the predicted fractal belief geometry. The structure emerges during training, regression error tracks cross-entropy, an 80% held-out split remains accurate after fitting on 20%, and 1,000 repeated label-shuffle/cross-validation controls collapse the spurious map. The Random-Random-XOR process has 36 beliefs in a 4-simplex with next-token degeneracies: concatenating all layers, but not the final layer alone, recovers it. Pairwise represented distances correlate (R^2=0.95) with belief geometry but only (R^2=0.31) with next-token probabilities.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** In these controlled processes, Transformers encode the geometry of Bayesian synchronization to hidden state, not only the next symbol; when the output objective is degenerate, the sufficient representation can be distributed across layers. Exact theoretical targets, nontrivial fractal matches, held-out regression, shuffles, and the XOR contrast provide strong representational evidence. No causal intervention tests whether the decoded coordinates are used, models and HMMs are small and stationary/ergodic, and realistic language may require compressed or nonlinear belief representations.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究下一词元预测会迫使 Transformer 学到数据生成过程的何种内部结构；具体检验残差状态是否表示对潜在状态的贝叶斯信念分布——包括即时下一词元分布不可见的整个未来信息——以及该几何是否跨层分布。

**方法。** 计算力学把已知边发射隐马尔可夫模型（Hidden Markov Model, HMM）转换为混合状态表述：每个观测前缀对应生成状态上的信念向量 (eta)，并按贝叶斯规则更新。Transformer 在 HMM 序列上训练，再用仿射回归把残差激活映射到真值信念单纯形；几何距离保持与下一词元概率比较，用于区分信念表示和普通输出解码。

**实验验证。** 三状态 Mess3 过程中，64 维最终残差激活的 2 维投影复现理论预测的分形信念几何。结构随训练形成，回归误差与交叉熵同步；只用 20% 拟合后在 80% 留出数据仍准确，1,000 次标签打乱/交叉验证会让伪映射坍缩。Random-Random-XOR 过程有位于 4-单纯形的 36 个信念且下一词元退化：只有拼接全部层而非最后一层才能恢复。表示距离与信念几何相关 (R^2=0.95)，与下一词元概率仅 (R^2=0.31)。

**结论与证据。** 在这些受控过程中，Transformer 编码的是对隐藏状态进行贝叶斯同步的几何，而不只是下一符号；当输出目标退化时，充分表示可以跨层分布。精确理论目标、非平凡分形匹配、留出回归、打乱对照和 XOR 对比提供强表示证据。但没有因果干预测试这些坐标是否被使用，模型与 HMM 很小且平稳遍历，真实语言也可能需要压缩或非线性信念表示。

p_2024_singh_what_needs_to.title: What needs to go right for an induction head? A mechanistic study of in-context learning circuits and their formation

abstract.en: In-context learning is a powerful emergent ability in transformer models. Prior work in mechanistic interpretability has identified a circuit element that may be critical for in-context learning -- the induction head (IH), which performs a match-and-copy operation. During training of large transformers on natural language data, IHs emerge around the same time as a notable phase change in the loss. Despite the robust evidence for IHs and this interesting coincidence with the phase change, relatively little is known about the diversity and emergence dynamics of IHs. Why is there more than one IH, and how are they dependent on each other? Why do IHs appear all of a sudden, and what are the subcircuits that enable them to emerge? We answer these questions by studying IH emergence dynamics in a controlled setting by training on synthetic data. In doing so, we develop and share a novel optogenetics-inspired causal framework for modifying activations throughout training. Using this framework, we delineate the diverse and additive nature of IHs. By clamping subsets of activations throughout training, we then identify three underlying subcircuits that interact to drive IH formation, yielding the phase change. Furthermore, these subcircuits shed light on data-dependent properties of formation, such as phase change timing, already showing the promise of this more in-depth understanding of subcircuits that need to"go right"for an induction head.
abstract.zh: 上下文学习是 Transformer 模型一种强大的涌现能力。以往机制可解释性研究识别出一个可能对上下文学习至关重要的回路元素——执行匹配与复制操作的归纳注意力头（IH）。大型 Transformer 在自然语言数据上的训练过程中，归纳注意力头会在损失出现显著相变的大致同时涌现。尽管已有充分证据支持归纳注意力头的存在，而且它与相变的同步现象也很有意思，我们对归纳注意力头的多样性和涌现动力学仍知之甚少：为什么会存在不止一个归纳注意力头，它们如何相互依赖？为什么它们会突然出现，又有哪些子回路使它们得以形成？我们在合成数据上训练模型，以受控方式研究归纳注意力头的涌现动力学，从而回答这些问题。在此过程中，我们开发并公开一种受光遗传学启发的新型因果框架，用于在整个训练过程中修改激活。借助该框架，我们阐明归纳注意力头的多样性与可加性。随后，通过在整个训练期间钳制激活子集，我们识别出三个相互作用、共同驱动归纳注意力头形成并产生相变的底层子回路。此外，这些子回路还揭示了形成过程中依赖数据的属性，例如相变发生的时机，初步体现了深入理解一个归纳注意力头得以形成所需子回路的价值。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks why induction heads appear abruptly during training, why several heads learn the same match-and-copy behavior, and which interacting subcircuits must develop for the loss phase transition. It also asks how the training distribution controls the timing of that transition.

**Method.** A JAX “artificial optogenetics” framework exposes and replaces attention patterns, values, and head outputs while preserving gradient flow throughout training. Clamping one computation to its ideal or checkpoint value isolates learning of the remaining computation. Pattern-preserving and value-preserving ablations separate the previous-token/matching route, induction matching, and label-copying route; single-head and head-pair training tests redundancy and wiring.

**Validation.** Two-layer, eight-head attention-only Transformers solve 2-way 1-shot Omniglot classification with randomized labels. The default set has 50 classes, five labels, 78,400 unique sequences, plus 100 held-out classes and 20% held-out label pairs. Training moves from a 50%-accuracy plateau to 99.99% at the phase change. Keeping only the strongest induction head yields about 98%, and multiple heads add redundantly; pattern/value ablations identify three previous-token heads and distinct value-copy heads, with many-to-many layer connections. Clamping the three smoothly growing match/copy factors removes or shifts the abrupt transition, and changing label/class statistics shifts timing as predicted. Five initialization seeds reproduce the main effects.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** The phase change is an interaction effect among gradually learned subcircuits rather than a single component suddenly appearing; multiple induction heads form redundant additive paths, and learning the label-copy route can be the data-dependent bottleneck. Causal interventions applied throughout optimization, held-out generalization, and seed replication provide strong evidence in this controlled setting. The model, sequence length, and task are small and synthetic; clamps impose idealized computations, fixed-length data omit some previous-token behavior, and the result does not show that natural-language induction circuits follow identical dynamics.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究归纳注意力头为何在训练中突然出现、多个头为何学习相同匹配—复制行为，以及哪些相互作用的子电路必须形成才产生损失相变；同时考察训练数据分布如何控制相变时机。

**方法。** JAX“人工光遗传学”框架在整个训练中暴露并替换注意力模式、值和注意力头输出，同时保持正确梯度流。把某项计算钳制为理想值或某检查点值，可隔离其余计算的学习。模式保持/值保持消融区分前一词元—匹配路线、归纳匹配和标签复制路线；单头与头对训练测试冗余和连接。

**实验验证。** 两层、每层八头的纯注意力 Transformer 完成随机标签的 Omniglot 二分类单样本任务。默认数据含 50 类、5 个标签和 78,400 条唯一序列，另有 100 个留出类及 20% 留出标签对。训练从 50% 准确率平台跃升到相变后的 99.99%。只保留最强归纳头约 98%，多个头以冗余加性方式作用；模式/值消融识别 3 个前一词元头及不同值复制头，层间呈多对多连接。钳制三个平滑增长的匹配/复制因子会消除或移动突变，改变标签/类别统计也按预测移动时机；5 个初始化种子复现主要结果。

**结论与证据。** 相变是多个逐渐学习子电路的交互结果，并非单组件突然出现；多个归纳头形成冗余加性路径，而标签复制路线的学习可能成为依赖数据的瓶颈。贯穿优化的因果干预、留出泛化和种子复现，在受控环境中提供强证据。但模型、序列和任务都很小且合成，钳制施加理想化计算，定长数据省略部分前一词元行为，也不能说明自然语言归纳电路遵循完全相同动力学。

p_2024_tang_language_specific_neurons.title: Language-Specific Neurons: The Key to Multilingual Capabilities in Large Language Models
p_2024_tang_language_specific_neurons.venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics

abstract.en: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable multilingual capabilities without being pre-trained on specially curated multilingual parallel corpora. It remains a challenging problem to explain the underlying mechanisms by which LLMs process multilingual texts. In this paper, we delve into the composition of Transformer architectures in LLMs to pinpoint language-specific regions. Specially, we propose a novel detection method, language activation probability entropy (LAPE), to identify language-specific neurons within LLMs. Based on LAPE, we conduct comprehensive experiments on several representative LLMs, such as LLaMA-2, BLOOM, and Mistral. Our findings indicate that LLMs' proficiency in processing a particular language is predominantly due to a small subset of neurons, primarily situated in the models' top and bottom layers. Furthermore, we showcase the feasibility to"steer"the output language of LLMs by selectively activating or deactivating language-specific neurons. Our research provides important evidence to the understanding and exploration of the multilingual capabilities of LLMs.
abstract.zh: 即使没有在专门整理的多语言平行语料库上预训练，大语言模型（LLM）也表现出卓越的多语言能力。解释语言模型处理多语言文本的底层机制仍是一项具有挑战性的问题。本文深入分析语言模型中 Transformer 架构的组成，以定位语言特定区域。具体而言，我们提出一种新的检测方法——语言激活概率熵（LAPE），用于识别语言模型内部的语言特定神经元。基于 LAPE，我们在 LLaMA-2、BLOOM 和 Mistral 等多个代表性语言模型上进行了全面实验。结果表明，语言模型处理某种特定语言的能力主要来自一小部分神经元，它们主要位于模型的顶部层和底部层。此外，我们展示了通过选择性激活或停用语言特定神经元来“引导”语言模型输出语言的可行性。本研究为理解和探索语言模型的多语言能力提供了重要证据。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether multilingual generation depends on small sets of neurons selective for particular languages, where those neurons lie, and whether manipulating them can causally change language modeling and output-language choice.

**Method.** Language Activation Probability Entropy (LAPE) estimates, for every feed-forward neuron, its probability of positive activation on each language and computes the entropy of the normalized language profile. Frequently active, low-entropy neurons are labeled language-specific. Deactivation zeros their activations; activation steering raises them to the language-specific mean. Random neurons, activation-probability ranking, parameter-change ranking after monolingual tuning, and language-balanced models provide controls.

**Validation.** Tests cover Llama-2 7B/13B/70B and BLOOM, with replications on Llama-2 Chat, OPT, Mistral, and Phi-2. Language modeling uses one million post-September-2022 Wikipedia tokens per language; open-ended questions are translated from Vicuna and scored for output language plus GPT-4 content quality. Monolingual Alpaca tuning uses 52,000 examples per target language. Deactivating LAPE-selected neurons selectively raises perplexity for their language more than matched alternatives, while random ablation has little effect. Llama-2-70B shows a U-shaped distribution—about 7,000 selected neurons in layer 2, around 100 in many middle layers, and over 1,000 in each final layer. Steering raises six reported language accuracies from 0.40–0.87 to 0.90–1.00 and can switch a Spanish prompt to fluent Chinese.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** A small, layer-concentrated set of feed-forward units has disproportionate causal influence on language identity: lower layers appear involved in mapping languages into a shared space and upper layers in mapping back to vocabulary. Selective perplexity damage, output steering, random/alternative rankings, and cross-model checks support this functional claim. LAPE is relative to the compared language set, individual neurons may remain polysemantic, GPT-4 judges content, steering examples do not prove full language competence, and the U-shaped explanatory story is partly inferred from representation similarity rather than directly intervened upon.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究多语言生成是否依赖少量对特定语言选择性的神经元、它们分布在哪里，以及操控这些神经元能否因果改变语言建模与输出语言选择。

**方法。** 语言激活概率熵（Language Activation Probability Entropy, LAPE）估计每个前馈神经元在各语言上的正激活概率，并计算归一化语言分布的熵；高频激活且低熵者判为语言专用。停用时把激活置零，引导时提升到该语言的平均激活。随机神经元、单纯激活概率排序、单语微调后的参数变化排序及语言均衡模型作为对照。

**实验验证。** 测试覆盖 Llama-2 7B/13B/70B 和 BLOOM，并在 Llama-2 Chat、OPT、Mistral、Phi-2 复现。语言建模每种语言使用 100 万个 2022 年 9 月后 Wikipedia 词元；开放问答从 Vicuna 翻译，以输出语言和 GPT-4 内容质量评分；单语 Alpaca 微调每种目标语言用 52,000 条。停用 LAPE 神经元会选择性地使对应语言困惑度上升，幅度大于匹配替代法，随机消融影响很小。Llama-2-70B 呈 U 形分布：第 2 层约 7,000 个，中间多层各约 100 个，最后四层各超过 1,000 个。六种语言的引导准确率由 0.40—0.87 提升到 0.90—1.00，还能让西语问题改用流利中文回答。

**结论与证据。** 少量、集中于特定层的前馈单元对语言身份有不成比例的因果影响：低层可能把不同语言映射进共享空间，高层再映射回词表。选择性困惑度损伤、输出引导、随机/替代排序和跨模型检查支持这一功能结论。但 LAPE 相对于所比较语言集合，单神经元仍可能多义，内容由 GPT-4 判断，少数引导例不证明完整语言能力，而 U 形功能解释部分来自表示相似性推断，未被直接干预验证。

p_2024_yao_knowledge_circuits_in.title: Knowledge Circuits in Pretrained Transformers

abstract.en: The remarkable capabilities of modern large language models are rooted in their vast repositories of knowledge encoded within their parameters, enabling them to perceive the world and engage in reasoning. The inner workings of how these models store knowledge have long been a subject of intense interest and investigation among researchers. To date, most studies have concentrated on isolated components within these models, such as the Multilayer Perceptrons and attention head. In this paper, we delve into the computation graph of the language model to uncover the knowledge circuits that are instrumental in articulating specific knowledge. The experiments, conducted with GPT2 and TinyLLAMA, have allowed us to observe how certain information heads, relation heads, and Multilayer Perceptrons collaboratively encode knowledge within the model. Moreover, we evaluate the impact of current knowledge editing techniques on these knowledge circuits, providing deeper insights into the functioning and constraints of these editing methodologies. Finally, we utilize knowledge circuits to analyze and interpret language model behaviors such as hallucinations and in-context learning. We believe the knowledge circuits hold potential for advancing our understanding of Transformers and guiding the improved design of knowledge editing. Code and data are available in https://github.com/zjunlp/KnowledgeCircuits.
abstract.zh: 现代大语言模型的卓越能力，根植于编码在其参数中的庞大知识库；这些知识使模型能够感知世界并进行推理。模型究竟如何存储知识，长期以来一直是研究者高度关注和深入探索的问题。迄今，大多数研究聚焦于模型内部的孤立组件，例如多层感知机和注意力头。本文深入语言模型的计算图，发现对表达特定知识起关键作用的知识回路。通过在 GPT2 和 TinyLLAMA 上进行实验，我们观察到某些信息头、关系头和多层感知机如何协同在模型内部编码知识。此外，我们评估了当前知识编辑技术对这些知识回路的影响，从而更深入地理解这些编辑方法的工作方式和约束。最后，我们使用知识回路分析并解释幻觉和上下文学习等语言模型行为。我们认为，知识回路有望推动对 Transformer 的理解，并指导知识编辑的改进设计。代码和数据见 https://github.com/zjunlp/KnowledgeCircuits。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks how a Transformer coordinates embeddings, attention heads, and multilayer perceptrons to express stored linguistic, commonsense, factual, and social-bias knowledge. It also asks whether the resulting circuits clarify why knowledge editing succeeds or fails and whether they help analyze hallucination and in-context learning.

**Method.** A computation graph is scored with MatchNLL, which measures how zero-ablating a node or edge changes target-token negative log-likelihood. Thresholded high-impact edges form a knowledge circuit. Logit-lens projections label intermediate nodes; recurring components are grouped as information heads, relation heads, and multilayer perceptrons that combine or promote answer information. Circuits before and after Rank-One Model Editing (ROME) or constrained fine-tuning are compared.

**Validation.** Experiments use GPT-2 Medium/Large and a TinyLlama case study on the Language Representation Evaluation dataset's linguistic, commonsense, factual, and bias relations. Circuits are constructed on validation facts and run standalone on held-out facts, scored by whether the answer enters the top ten predictions (Hit@10); random circuits are a control. Across 14 reported relation types, average held-out Hit@10 is 0.47 for the circuit, 0.44 for the full model, and 0 for random, though individual relations range from 0 to 1. Editing case studies trace whether the new answer enters and propagates through the circuit, and circuit analyses are applied to reverse relations, multihop facts, hallucinations, and demonstrations.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Factual expression is distributed across interacting component types rather than a single “knowledge neuron,” and circuit changes can diagnose successful versus superficial edits. Standalone held-out performance and targeted ablation give useful structural evidence, but strength varies sharply by relation and some circuit scores exceed weak full-model baselines. The work is therefore a preliminary circuit account: completeness, threshold sensitivity, cross-architecture transfer, and the mapping from intermediate logits to true computation remain limited.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究 Transformer 如何协调嵌入、注意力头和多层感知机来表达语言、常识、事实与社会偏见知识；并进一步考察所得电路能否解释知识编辑成败，以及能否帮助分析幻觉和上下文学习。

**方法。** 研究把模型表示为计算图，以 MatchNLL 衡量对某节点或边做置零消融后目标词元负对数似然的变化，再把超过阈值的高影响边组成知识电路。Logit Lens 投影用于标注中间节点，反复出现的组件归为信息头、关系头以及组合或提升答案信息的多层感知机；秩一模型编辑（ROME）或受限微调前后的电路再作比较。

**实验验证。** 实验使用 GPT-2 Medium/Large，并以 TinyLlama 作架构案例；数据来自 Language Representation Evaluation 的语言、常识、事实和偏见关系。电路在验证事实上构建，再独立运行于留出事实，以答案是否进入前十预测（Hit@10）评分，随机电路作对照。14 类关系的平均留出 Hit@10 为电路 0.47、完整模型 0.44、随机 0，但单类结果从 0 到 1 波动。编辑案例追踪新答案是否进入并沿电路传播，另分析反向关系、多跳事实、幻觉和示例学习。

**结论与证据。** 知识表达分布于多类组件协作，而非单个“知识神经元”；电路变化也能区分成功编辑与表面编辑。独立留出性能和定向消融提供有用结构证据，但不同关系差异很大，且有些电路分数高于本身较弱的完整模型基线。因此这仍是初步电路描述，完整性、阈值敏感性、跨架构迁移及中间 logit 与真实计算的对应均有限。

p_2024_zhou_on_the_role.title: On the Role of Attention Heads in Large Language Model Safety

abstract.en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on multiple language tasks, yet their safety guardrails can be circumvented, leading to harmful generations. In light of this, recent research on safety mechanisms has emerged, revealing that when safety representations or component are suppressed, the safety capability of LLMs are compromised. However, existing research tends to overlook the safety impact of multi-head attention mechanisms, despite their crucial role in various model functionalities. Hence, in this paper, we aim to explore the connection between standard attention mechanisms and safety capability to fill this gap in the safety-related mechanistic interpretability. We propose a novel metric which tailored for multi-head attention, the Safety Head ImPortant Score (Ships), to assess the individual heads' contributions to model safety. Based on this, we generalize Ships to the dataset level and further introduce the Safety Attention Head AttRibution Algorithm (Sahara) to attribute the critical safety attention heads inside the model. Our findings show that the special attention head has a significant impact on safety. Ablating a single safety head allows aligned model (e.g., Llama-2-7b-chat) to respond to 16 times more harmful queries, while only modifying 0.006% of the parameters, in contrast to the ~ 5% modification required in previous studies. More importantly, we demonstrate that attention heads primarily function as feature extractors for safety and models fine-tuned from the same base model exhibit overlapping safety heads through comprehensive experiments. Together, our attribution approach and findings provide a novel perspective for unpacking the black box of safety mechanisms within large models.
abstract.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在多项语言任务上取得了最先进的性能，但其安全护栏可能被绕过，从而生成有害内容。鉴于此，近期关于安全机制的研究发现，当安全表征或安全组件受到抑制时，语言模型的安全能力会受损。然而，尽管多头注意力机制对多种模型功能至关重要，现有研究往往忽略它对安全性的影响。为填补安全相关机制可解释性中的这一空白，本文探索标准注意力机制与安全能力之间的联系。我们提出一个为多头注意力定制的新指标——安全注意力头重要性分数（Safety Head ImPortant Score，Ships），用于评估各个注意力头对模型安全性的贡献。在此基础上，我们把 Ships 推广到数据集层面，并进一步提出安全注意力头归因算法（Safety Attention Head AttRibution Algorithm，Sahara），以归因模型内部关键的安全注意力头。研究发现，特定注意力头会显著影响安全性。只消融一个安全注意力头，就会使经过对齐的模型（如 Llama-2-7b-chat）回答的有害问题增至原来的 16 倍，而修改的参数仅占 0.006%；相比之下，既有研究需要修改约 5% 的参数。更重要的是，广泛实验表明，注意力头在安全机制中主要充当特征提取器，并且从同一基础模型微调得到的模型具有相互重叠的安全注意力头。我们的归因方法和研究发现为剖析大模型安全机制这一黑箱提供了新视角。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether a small number of attention heads are causally important for an aligned model's refusal of harmful requests, how such heads can be attributed over a dataset, and whether they detect unsafe content, generate refusal language, or merely trade safety for general helpfulness.

**Method.** Safety Head Important Score (Ships) estimates a head's query-specific safety contribution from the increase in harmful completion likelihood after ablating its output or scaling its value contribution. A dataset-level generalization feeds a greedy Safety Attention Head Attribution Algorithm (Sahara), which searches for interacting head sets. Representation shifts, attention/output ablations, overlap between aligned descendants, and helpful-task evaluation characterize function.

**Validation.** Llama-2-7B-chat and Vicuna-7B-v1.5 are evaluated primarily on MaliciousInstruct and JailbreakBench, with full autoregressive generation up to 128 new tokens and attack success rate (ASR) as the safety metric. Single- and multi-head ablations are compared with random heads and two intervention implementations; ASR grows as more Sahara-ranked heads are removed. In Llama-2-7B-chat, ablating one head makes the model answer roughly 16 times as many harmful prompts while changing only 0.006% of parameters, versus prior interventions affecting about 5%. Cross-model overlap and benign/helpfulness tests examine inheritance and collateral cost.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** A sparse set of attention heads has disproportionate causal control over refusal, acting mainly as harmful-feature extractors whose outputs help place generation in a refusal regime. Full-generation ablations, random controls, and overlap across models derived from one base provide fairly strong local evidence. The heads are not a complete safety mechanism: ASR depends on the judge and decoding, greedy attribution can miss distributed alternatives, ablation exposes vulnerability rather than normal necessity in all contexts, and results center on two related 7B models.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究少量注意力头是否因果影响对齐模型拒绝有害请求，如何在数据集层面归因这些头，以及它们究竟负责检测危险内容、生成拒答语言，还是只以一般有用性换取安全。

**方法。** 安全头重要分数（Safety Head Important Score, Ships）根据消融头输出或缩放值贡献后，有害回答似然的上升估计单条请求上的安全贡献。数据集级分数输入安全注意力头归因算法（Safety Attention Head Attribution Algorithm, Sahara），以贪心方式搜索协同头集合；拒答表示变化、注意力/输出消融、同源对齐模型的头重合及有用性评测用于解释功能。

**实验验证。** 主要在 Llama-2-7B-chat 和 Vicuna-7B-v1.5 上使用 MaliciousInstruct 与 JailbreakBench，完整自回归生成最多 128 个新词元，以攻击成功率（Attack Success Rate, ASR）衡量安全。单头和多头消融与随机头、两种干预实现比较；移除更多 Sahara 高排名头时 ASR 持续上升。Llama-2-7B-chat 中仅消融一个头就使有害请求回答数约增至 16 倍，而只改动 0.006% 参数，既有方案约涉及 5%；跨模型重合与良性任务测试检查继承和副作用。

**结论与证据。** 少量注意力头对拒答有不成比例的因果控制，主要像危险特征提取器，其输出帮助生成进入拒绝状态。完整生成消融、随机对照及同一基础模型衍生模型间的重合提供较强局部证据。但这些头不是完整安全机制：ASR 依赖评审与解码，贪心归因可能漏掉分布式替代路径，消融揭示脆弱性却不等于所有上下文中的正常必要性，且主结论集中在两个同源 7B 模型。

p_2025_chen_transferring_linear_features.title: Transferring Linear Features Across Language Models With Model Stitching

abstract.en: In this work, we demonstrate that affine mappings between residual streams of language models is a cheap way to effectively transfer represented features between models. We apply this technique to transfer the weights of Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) between models of different sizes to compare their representations. We find that small and large models learn similar representation spaces, which motivates training expensive components like SAEs on a smaller model and transferring to a larger model at a FLOPs savings. In particular, using a small-to-large transferred SAE as initialization can lead to 50% cheaper training runs when training SAEs on larger models. Next, we show that transferred probes and steering vectors can effectively recover ground truth performance. Finally, we dive deeper into feature-level transferability, finding that semantic and structural features transfer noticeably differently while specific classes of functional features have their roles faithfully mapped. Overall, our findings illustrate similarities and differences in the linear representation spaces of small and large models and demonstrate a method for improving the training efficiency of SAEs.
abstract.zh: 本文证明，利用语言模型残差流之间的仿射映射，可以低成本而有效地在模型间迁移已表征的特征。我们运用该技术，在不同规模的模型之间迁移稀疏自编码器（SAE）权重，以比较它们的表征。结果发现，小模型与大模型会学到相似的表征空间；这促使我们在较小模型上训练 SAE 等昂贵组件，再把它们迁移到较大模型，从而节省浮点运算量。特别是，在较大模型上训练 SAE 时，使用从小模型迁移到大模型的 SAE 作为初始化，可使训练成本降低 50%。随后，我们表明，迁移后的探针和引导向量能够有效恢复真值性能。最后，我们深入研究特征层面的可迁移性，发现语义特征与结构特征的迁移方式明显不同，而某些特定类别的功能特征则能忠实映射其作用。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了小模型与大模型线性表征空间的相似性和差异，并展示了一种提高 SAE 训练效率的方法。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks how similar the residual representation spaces of small and large language models are, and whether an affine correspondence is strong enough to transfer sparse autoencoders, probes, steering vectors, and individual functional features. It also asks whether this transfer can reduce the cost of training interpretability tools on larger models.

**Method.** Model stitching learns affine maps (T_{\uparrow}) and (T_{\downarrow}) between selected residual-stream layers so computation can begin in one decoder-only model and finish in another. A sparse autoencoder's encoder and decoder are conjugated through these maps; the transferred dictionary can be evaluated zero-shot or used to initialize retraining. Probes and steering vectors are mapped through the same stitch, while attribution correlations and concept annotations compare feature classes.

**Validation.** Pythia deduplicated models of different sizes are stitched using OpenWebText next-token cross-entropy to choose layer pairs and test one-way and round-trip mappings. Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are transferred between 70M/160M and larger pairs, evaluated by sparsity, reconstruction, and downstream loss, then retrained under matched floating-point-operation budgets. Probing covers eight binary SAEBench datasets with (k=1,2,5,10,20) and larger feature sets; multilingual steering uses EuroParl target-language generation. Inversion ablations, direct residual probes, independently trained SAEs, and semantic/structural/functional feature analyses serve as controls. Transferred initialization can cut large-model SAE training compute by about 50% at matched quality.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Related model scales share enough affine structure to transfer many linear readouts and provide a useful SAE initialization, while semantic and structural features transfer differently and some functional roles map faithfully. Round-trip language modeling, downstream probes/steering, and compute-matched retraining support practical weak universality. Transfer is not exact: zero-shot SAE quality drops, results mostly concern same-family models trained on similar data, and an affine stitch preserving behavior does not prove one-to-one identity of internal concepts.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究大小语言模型的残差表示空间有多相似，以及仿射对应是否足以迁移稀疏自编码器、探针、引导向量和单个功能特征；并考察这种迁移能否降低在大模型上训练解释工具的成本。

**方法。** 模型拼接在选定残差层之间学习仿射映射 (T_{\uparrow}) 与 (T_{\downarrow})，使计算可从一个仅解码器模型开始、在另一个模型完成。稀疏自编码器的编码器/解码器经映射共轭后，可直接评估或作为再训练初始化；探针和引导向量使用同一映射迁移，归因相关性与概念标注用于比较不同特征类别。

**实验验证。** 不同规模的 Pythia deduplicated 模型用 OpenWebText 下一词元交叉熵选择拼接层，并测试单向与往返映射。稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoder, SAE）在 70M/160M 及更大模型对之间迁移，以稀疏度、重构和下游损失评测，再在匹配浮点运算预算下继续训练。探针覆盖 8 个二分类 SAEBench 数据集及 (k=1,2,5,10,20) 等特征数；多语引导用 EuroParl 目标语言生成。逆映射消融、直接残差探针、独立训练 SAE 及语义/结构/功能特征分析作对照。迁移初始化在质量匹配时可把大模型 SAE 训练计算削减约 50%。

**结论与证据。** 同家族不同规模模型共享足够的仿射结构，可迁移许多线性读出并为 SAE 提供高效初始化；语义与结构特征迁移性不同，部分功能角色则能忠实映射。往返语言建模、下游探针/引导及计算匹配再训练支持实用的弱普适性。但迁移并不精确：零样本 SAE 会降质，实验主要限于相似数据训练的同家族模型，保持行为的仿射拼接也不证明内部概念一一相同。

p_2025_galichin_i_have_covered.title: I Have Covered All the Bases Here: Interpreting Reasoning Features in Large Language Models via Sparse Autoencoders

abstract.en: Recent LLMs like DeepSeek-R1 have demonstrated state-of-the-art performance by integrating deep thinking and complex reasoning during generation. However, the internal mechanisms behind these reasoning processes remain unexplored. We observe reasoning LLMs consistently use vocabulary associated with human reasoning processes. We hypothesize these words correspond to specific reasoning moments within the models' internal mechanisms. To test this hypothesis, we employ Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), a technique for sparse decomposition of neural network activations into human-interpretable features. We introduce ReasonScore, an automatic metric to identify active SAE features during these reasoning moments. We perform manual and automatic interpretation of the features detected by our metric, and find those with activation patterns matching uncertainty, exploratory thinking, and reflection. Through steering experiments, we demonstrate that amplifying these features increases performance on reasoning-intensive benchmarks (+2.2%) while producing longer reasoning traces (+20.5%). Using the model diffing technique, we provide evidence that these features are present only in models with reasoning capabilities. Our work provides the first step towards a mechanistic understanding of reasoning in LLMs.
abstract.zh: DeepSeek-R1 等近期大语言模型通过在生成过程中融入深度思考和复杂推理，取得了最先进的性能。然而，这些推理过程背后的内部机制尚未得到探索。我们观察到，推理型语言模型会持续使用与人类推理过程有关的词汇。我们假设，这些词对应于模型内部机制中的特定推理时刻。为检验该假说，我们采用稀疏自编码器（SAE），把神经网络激活稀疏分解为人类可解释的特征。我们提出 ReasonScore，一种用于识别这些推理时刻中活跃 SAE 特征的自动指标。我们对该指标检测出的特征进行人工和自动解释，并发现一些特征的激活模式分别对应不确定性、探索性思考和反思。引导实验表明，放大这些特征可以提升模型在推理密集型基准上的表现（+2.2%），同时产生更长的推理轨迹（+20.5%）。借助模型差分技术，我们给出证据表明，这些特征只存在于具备推理能力的模型中。本工作是迈向机制层面理解语言模型推理的第一步。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether reasoning models contain identifiable sparse features corresponding to moments such as uncertainty, exploration, reflection, and conclusion, whether post-training adds or amplifies those features, and whether manipulating them changes reasoning quality rather than merely its verbal style.

**Method.** Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) decompose residual activations from reasoning traces. ReasonScore ranks latents by how selectively their activation aligns with automatically detected reasoning-marker spans, rather than simply frequent words. High-scoring features are interpreted with activation examples and automated descriptions. Model diffing compares base and reasoning-tuned checkpoints, while inference-time feature amplification tests causal effects.

**Validation.** Reasoning and non-reasoning variants are compared on generated traces and standard reasoning-intensive benchmarks. Selected features are checked manually and automatically for activation on uncertainty, exploratory search, self-correction, and reflection; lexical controls test whether the score only rediscovers cue words. Steering is compared with unsteered generation and irrelevant-feature controls, measuring task accuracy, trace length, and behavioral side effects. Amplifying the selected set raises benchmark accuracy by 2.2 percentage points and lengthens reasoning traces by 20.5%; checkpoint comparison reports these features predominantly in models trained for reasoning.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Reasoning post-training is associated with a sparse set of readable features whose manipulation can modestly improve performance, not only increase marker usage. Model comparison, feature-level examples, controls, and steering give moderate causal support. The gain is small relative to the trace-length change, SAE features can split or absorb concepts, ReasonScore depends on a predefined discourse vocabulary, and steering does not establish a complete reasoning algorithm or prove the features are absent rather than less aligned in base models.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究推理模型是否包含对应不确定、探索、反思和结论等时刻的可识别稀疏特征，后训练是新增还是放大这些特征，以及操控它们改变的是推理质量还是仅改变表面语言风格。

**方法。** 稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoder, SAE）分解推理轨迹的残差激活。ReasonScore 按潜变量对自动检测的推理标记片段的选择性对齐程度排序，而非只寻找高频词；高分特征通过激活例和自动描述解释。模型差异分析比较基础与推理微调检查点，推理时放大特征测试因果作用。

**实验验证。** 推理版与非推理版模型在生成轨迹和标准高推理需求基准上比较。入选特征经人工和自动检查，确认是否在不确定、探索、自我纠正和反思处激活；词汇对照检验分数是否只找回提示词。特征引导与无引导、无关特征对照比较任务准确率、轨迹长度和副作用。放大入选特征使准确率提高 2.2 个百分点，推理轨迹增长 20.5%；检查点比较显示这些特征主要出现在经过推理训练的模型中。

**结论与证据。** 推理后训练与一组可读稀疏特征相关，操控它们可小幅改善性能，而不只是增加推理标记词。模型对比、特征例、控制和引导提供中等因果支持。但性能增益相对轨迹增长较小，SAE 可能拆分或吸收概念，ReasonScore 依赖预设话语词汇，引导也未给出完整推理算法，不能证明基础模型完全没有而非较弱地表示这些特征。

p_2025_jin_massive_values_in.title: Massive Values in Self-Attention Modules are the Key to Contextual Knowledge Understanding

abstract.en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in contextual knowledge understanding. In this paper, we show that these concentrated massive values consistently emerge in specific regions of attention queries (Q) and keys (K) while not having such patterns in values (V) in various modern transformer-based LLMs (Q, K, and V mean the representations output by the query, key, and value layers respectively). Through extensive experiments, we further demonstrate that these massive values play a critical role in interpreting contextual knowledge (knowledge obtained from the current context window) rather than in retrieving parametric knowledge stored within the model's parameters. Our further investigation of quantization strategies reveals that ignoring these massive values leads to a pronounced drop in performance on tasks requiring rich contextual understanding, aligning with our analysis. Finally, we trace the emergence of concentrated massive values and find that such concentration is caused by Rotary Positional Encoding (RoPE), which has appeared since the first layers. These findings shed new light on how Q and K operate in LLMs and offer practical insights for model design and optimization. The Code is Available at https://github.com/MingyuJ666/Rope_with_LLM.
abstract.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在上下文知识理解方面取得了显著成功。本文表明，在多种现代 Transformer 大语言模型中，高度集中的巨大数值持续出现在注意力查询（Q）和键（K）的特定区域，而值（V）中不存在这类模式；这里 Q、K、V 分别指查询层、键层和值层输出的表征。通过广泛实验，我们进一步证明，这些巨大数值在解释上下文知识——即从当前上下文窗口获得的知识——时发挥关键作用，而不是用于检索存储在模型参数中的参数知识。对量化策略的进一步研究显示，忽略这些巨大数值，会使模型在需要丰富上下文理解的任务上出现明显性能下降，这与我们的分析一致。最后，我们追踪集中巨大数值的形成过程，发现这种集中现象由旋转位置编码（RoPE）引起，并且从最早的层就已经出现。这些发现为理解 Q 和 K 在语言模型中的运作方式提供了新视角，也为模型设计与优化带来实际启示。代码见 https://github.com/MingyuJ666/Rope_with_LLM。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks what the extremely large activations inside self-attention do. It separates whether they occur in query/key/value streams, whether they support knowledge supplied by the current context or knowledge stored in parameters, and whether Rotary Positional Encoding (RoPE) causes their concentration.

**Method.** Layer-, head-, token-, and channel-level statistics locate outlier magnitudes in query (Q), key (K), and value (V) projections. Targeted clipping, replacement, and precision/quantization ablations perturb only massive coordinates while measuring contextual versus parametric question answering. Tracing the same coordinates through early layers and modifying RoPE tests the proposed positional origin.

**Validation.** Multiple contemporary Transformer families and scales are evaluated on tasks where the answer is either stated in the prompt or must be recalled from weights, alongside language modeling and quantization tests. Massive values consistently concentrate in specific Q/K regions but not V. Removing or low-precision quantizing them causes pronounced degradation on context-rich tasks while leaving parametric recall comparatively intact; matched perturbations of ordinary coordinates and value activations are weaker. The pattern appears from the first layers, and RoPE variants alter its location and magnitude in the predicted way.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Q/K outliers act as a routing substrate for integrating contextual knowledge, rather than as a generic store of factual memory, and RoPE is a principal source of their concentration. Cross-model localization, selective intervention, and quantization consequences provide fairly strong functional evidence. Exact benchmarks and effects vary by architecture, clipping can disturb scale-sensitive attention beyond the named mechanism, and the study does not reduce contextual understanding to these coordinates alone or prove RoPE is the only cause.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究自注意力内部极大激活值承担什么功能，并区分它们出现在查询/键/值哪条支路、主要支持当前语境提供的知识还是参数记忆，以及旋转位置编码（Rotary Positional Encoding, RoPE）是否造成这种集中。

**方法。** 研究按层、头、词元和通道统计查询（Q）、键（K）、值（V）投影中的异常幅度；只对极大坐标做截断、替换及精度/量化消融，再比较语境知识问答与参数知识问答。沿早层追踪同一坐标并改变 RoPE，用于测试位置编码起源假说。

**实验验证。** 多个现代 Transformer 家族与规模在两类任务上评测：答案明确写在提示中，或必须从权重回忆；同时测试语言建模与量化。极大值稳定集中在特定 Q/K 区域而非 V。删除或低精度量化这些坐标会显著损害富语境任务，而参数回忆相对保持；对普通坐标和 V 激活的匹配扰动弱得多。该模式从首层即出现，RoPE 变体会按预测改变其位置与幅度。

**结论与证据。** Q/K 异常值更像整合语境知识的路由基底，而非一般事实记忆库，RoPE 是其集中形成的主要来源。跨模型定位、选择性干预和量化后果提供较强功能证据。但具体基准和效应随架构变化，截断也可能广泛扰动依赖尺度的注意力；研究未把语境理解完全归结于这些坐标，也未证明 RoPE 是唯一成因。

p_2025_kantamneni_are_sparse_autoencoder.title: Are Sparse Autoencoders Useful? A Case Study in Sparse Probing

abstract.en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are a popular method for interpreting concepts represented in large language model (LLM) activations. However, there is a lack of evidence regarding the validity of their interpretations due to the lack of a ground truth for the concepts used by an LLM, and a growing number of works have presented problems with current SAEs. One alternative source of evidence would be demonstrating that SAEs improve performance on downstream tasks beyond existing baselines. We test this by applying SAEs to the real-world task of LLM activation probing in four regimes: data scarcity, class imbalance, label noise, and covariate shift. Due to the difficulty of detecting concepts in these challenging settings, we hypothesize that SAEs' basis of interpretable, concept-level latents should provide a useful inductive bias. However, although SAEs occasionally perform better than baselines on individual datasets, we are unable to design ensemble methods combining SAEs with baselines that consistently outperform ensemble methods solely using baselines. Additionally, although SAEs initially appear promising for identifying spurious correlations, detecting poor dataset quality, and training multi-token probes, we are able to achieve similar results with simple non-SAE baselines as well. Though we cannot discount SAEs' utility on other tasks, our findings highlight the shortcomings of current SAEs and the need to rigorously evaluate interpretability methods on downstream tasks with strong baselines.
abstract.zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）是一种常用于解释大语言模型（LLM）激活所表征概念的方法。然而，由于语言模型使用的概念不存在真值，而且越来越多研究指出当前 SAE 存在问题，其解释的有效性仍缺乏证据。另一种证据来源，是证明 SAE 能在下游任务上超越现有基线。我们通过把 SAE 应用于真实的语言模型激活探测任务来检验这一点，覆盖四种设置：数据稀缺、类别不平衡、标签噪声和协变量偏移。由于在这些具有挑战性的设置中很难检测概念，我们假设，SAE 由可解释的概念级潜变量构成的基底应当提供有益的归纳偏置。然而，尽管 SAE 偶尔会在个别数据集上优于基线，我们无法设计出一种结合 SAE 和基线的集成方法，使其持续优于只使用基线的集成方法。此外，虽然 SAE 起初似乎有望用于识别虚假相关、检测低质量数据集和训练多 token 探针，但简单的非 SAE 基线也能取得相似结果。尽管我们不能排除 SAE 在其他任务上的价值，研究结果仍凸显了当前 SAE 的不足，以及使用强基线在下游任务上严格评估可解释性方法的必要性。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) latents provide a useful inductive bias for real activation probing beyond strong non-SAE baselines. It deliberately targets regimes where interpretable concept bases ought to help: little data, class imbalance, label noise, covariate shift, spurious correlations, poor data quality, and multi-token evidence.

**Method.** Hidden states from Gemma-2-9B and Llama-3.1-8B are represented either directly or through public SAE latents. Logistic regression on selected SAE features is compared with five probe families, including linear and nonlinear methods such as multilayer perceptrons, k-nearest neighbors, and XGBoost. The “Quiver of Arrows” protocol selects the best method by validation area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), then asks whether adding SAE probes improves the toolkit's held-out test AUC.

**Validation.** Evaluation uses 113 binary datasets with prompts from 5 to 1,024 tokens. Every method searches ten hyperparameter settings with data-size-appropriate validation: training selection for at most three examples, leave-two-out up to 12, six-fold cross-validation up to 128, and an 80/20 validation split above 128. Controlled corruptions generate scarcity, imbalance, noise, and shift; additional experiments test spurious-correlation identification, dataset-quality diagnosis, multi-token pooling, model/layer choice, SAE architecture, and apparent wins against weak linear baselines.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** SAE probes sometimes win on individual datasets but do not consistently improve the validation-selected ensemble of strong baselines; several initially promising SAE applications are matched by simple non-SAE methods. The large dataset collection, nested selection, difficult regimes, and stronger baselines make this robust negative evidence against a general probing advantage. It does not show SAEs are useless for causal intervention or discovery, and imperfect public SAEs or probing itself may be the bottleneck.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoder, SAE）潜变量能否在真实激活探测中提供超越强非 SAE 基线的归纳偏置；特意选择理论上可解释概念基应有优势的场景：小样本、类别不平衡、标签噪声、协变量偏移、伪相关、低质量数据和跨词元证据。

**方法。** Gemma-2-9B 和 Llama-3.1-8B 的隐藏状态直接使用或先映射到公开 SAE 潜变量。基于 SAE 特征的逻辑回归与五类探针比较，包括线性方法、多层感知机、k 近邻和 XGBoost。“箭袋”协议先按验证集受试者工作特征曲线下面积（Area Under the ROC Curve, AUC）选择最佳方法，再检验加入 SAE 探针是否提升整套工具的留出测试 AUC。

**实验验证。** 评测包含 113 个二分类数据集，提示长度 5 至 1,024 词元。每种方法搜索 10 组超参数，并按样本量选择验证法：至多 3 条用训练集选择，4–12 条留二交叉验证，13–128 条六折交叉验证，更大数据用 80/20 划分。受控扰动产生小样本、不平衡、噪声和分布偏移；附加实验考察伪相关识别、数据质量诊断、跨词元汇聚、模型/层选择、SAE 架构，以及相对弱线性基线的表面优势。

**结论与证据。** SAE 探针偶尔在单数据集获胜，却未稳定改善由验证集选择的强基线组合；若干初看有希望的用途也可被简单非 SAE 方法匹配。大规模数据集合、嵌套选择、困难设置和强基线构成稳健负面证据，反对“一般探测优势”。但这不证明 SAE 对因果干预或发现无用；公开 SAE 质量不佳或探测任务本身也可能是瓶颈。

p_2025_kim_interpreting_attention_heads.title: Interpreting Attention Heads for Image-to-Text Information Flow in Large Vision-Language Models

abstract.en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) answer visual questions by transferring information from images to text through a series of attention heads. While this image-to-text information flow is central to visual question answering, its underlying mechanism remains difficult to interpret due to the simultaneous operation of numerous attention heads. To address this challenge, we propose head attribution, a technique inspired by component attribution methods, to identify consistent patterns among attention heads that play a key role in information transfer. Using head attribution, we investigate how LVLMs rely on specific attention heads to identify and answer questions about the main object in an image. Our analysis reveals that a distinct subset of attention heads facilitates the image-to-text information flow. Remarkably, we find that the selection of these heads is governed by the semantic content of the input image rather than its visual appearance. We further examine the flow of information at the token level and discover that (1) text information first propagates to role-related tokens and the final token before receiving image information, and (2) image information is embedded in both object-related and background tokens. Our work provides evidence that image-to-text information flow follows a structured process, and that analysis at the attention-head level offers a promising direction toward understanding the mechanisms of LVLMs.
abstract.zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）通过一系列注意力头把信息从图像传递到文本，从而回答视觉问题。尽管这种图像到文本的信息流是视觉问答的核心，但由于大量注意力头同时运行，其底层机制仍难以解释。为应对这一挑战，我们提出受组件归因方法启发的注意力头归因技术，用于识别在信息传递中发挥关键作用的注意力头之间的一致模式。借助注意力头归因，我们研究大型视觉语言模型如何依靠特定注意力头识别图像中的主要物体并回答相关问题。分析显示，一组明确的注意力头促进了图像到文本的信息流。值得注意的是，这些注意力头的选择由输入图像的语义内容而非视觉外观决定。我们进一步考察 token 层面的信息流，并发现：（1）文本信息首先传播到与角色有关的 token 和最后一个 token，随后才接收图像信息；（2）图像信息同时嵌入与物体有关的 token 和背景 token。我们的工作证明，图像到文本的信息流遵循结构化过程，而在注意力头层面开展分析，是理解大型视觉语言模型机制的一条有前景路径。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks which attention heads carry image information into text positions during visual object identification, whether the responsible set is determined by image semantics or visual style, and which image and text tokens participate in the transfer.

**Method.** Head attribution repeatedly ablates subsets of heads and fits a linear model predicting the correct-answer logit from which heads remain. Regression coefficients rank head contributions; compact sets are then evaluated for faithfulness when retained and completeness when removed. Token-level patching decomposes the selected heads by source image token and destination text token.

**Validation.** Several large vision-language models answer open-ended, single-word main-object questions, preventing the text prompt from revealing the answer and permitting direct logit measurement. Head attribution is compared with random selection, attention-weight ranking, and one-head causal ablation; explained variance and Pearson correlation test the linear approximation. Retain/remove curves, individual-head ablations, alternative prompt wording, and the same semantic object rendered in different image styles test robustness. Token interventions trace role tokens, the final colon, object regions, and background patches.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** A distributed but selective head set transfers visual evidence into the answer: text-side routing reaches role and final tokens before image information arrives, while both object and background image tokens contribute. Head identity follows semantic content more than surface style. Regression fit, causal ablation, compact-set faithfulness/completeness, and prompt/style controls give moderate structural evidence. The task is deliberately narrow, attribution assumes approximately additive head effects, image patches are not pure concepts, and the analysis does not establish a complete circuit for general visual question answering.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究视觉物体识别时哪些注意力头把图像信息传入文本位置，负责头集合由图像语义还是视觉风格决定，以及哪些图像与文本词元参与信息迁移。

**方法。** 注意力头归因反复消融不同头子集，再用线性模型根据保留哪些头来预测正确答案 logit；回归系数用于排序头贡献，紧凑头集再分别测试保留时的保真性和移除时的完整性。词元级修补进一步按源图像词元与目标文本词元分解入选头。

**实验验证。** 多个大型视觉语言模型回答开放式、单词答案的主物体问题，文本提示无法泄漏答案，且可直接测量 logit。头归因与随机选择、注意力权重排序和单头因果消融比较；解释方差和 Pearson 相关检验线性近似。保留/移除曲线、逐头消融、替代提示措辞及同语义物体的不同图像风格用于稳健性测试；词元干预追踪角色词元、末尾冒号、物体区域和背景图块。

**结论与证据。** 一个分布式但有选择性的头集合把视觉证据送往答案位置：文本侧信息先传播到角色词和末词元，随后接收图像信息；图像侧物体与背景词元均有贡献。头身份更多随语义而非表面风格变化。回归拟合、因果消融、紧凑集合的保真/完整性及提示/风格对照提供中等结构证据。但任务刻意狭窄，归因假设头作用近似可加，图块并非纯概念，分析也未给出一般视觉问答的完整电路。

p_2025_kim_reasoning_circuits_in.title: Reasoning Circuits in Language Models: A Mechanistic Interpretation of Syllogistic Inference
p_2025_kim_reasoning_circuits_in.venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics

abstract.en: Recent studies on reasoning in language models (LMs) have sparked a debate on whether they can learn systematic inferential principles or merely exploit superficial patterns in the training data.To understand and uncover the mechanisms adopted for formal reasoning in LMs, this paper presents a mechanistic interpretation of syllogistic inference.Specifically, we present a methodology for circuit discovery aimed at interpreting content-independent and formal reasoning mechanisms.Through two distinct intervention methods, we uncover a sufficient and necessary circuit involving middle-term suppression that elucidates how LMs transfer information to derive valid conclusions from premises.Furthermore, we investigate how belief biases manifest in syllogistic inference, finding evidence of partial contamination from additional attention heads responsible for encoding commonsense and contextualized knowledge.Finally, we explore the generalization of the discovered mechanisms across various syllogistic schemes, model sizes and architectures.The identified circuit is sufficient and necessary for syllogistic schemes on which the models achieve high accuracy (≥ 60%), with compatible activation patterns across models of different families.Overall, our findings suggest that LMs learn transferable contentindependent reasoning mechanisms, but that, at the same time, such mechanisms do not involve generalizable and abstract logical primitives, being susceptible to contamination by the same world knowledge acquired during pre-training.
abstract.zh: 最近关于语言模型推理能力的研究引发了一场争论：语言模型究竟能够学习系统性的推理原则，还是仅仅利用训练数据中的表面模式？为了理解并揭示语言模型进行形式推理时采用的机制，本文对三段论推理进行了机制性解释。具体而言，我们提出一种回路发现方法，用于解释与具体内容无关的形式推理机制。借助两种不同的干预方法，我们发现了一个涉及中项抑制的充分且必要回路，它说明语言模型如何传递信息，从前提推导出有效结论。我们还研究了信念偏差如何在三段论推理中体现，并发现该机制会受到额外注意力头的部分污染；这些注意力头负责编码常识与情境化知识。最后，我们考察了所发现机制在不同三段论模式、模型规模和模型架构之间的泛化能力。对于模型准确率较高（≥ 60%）的三段论模式，该回路既充分又必要，并且不同模型家族呈现兼容的激活模式。总体而言，结果表明语言模型能够学到可迁移、与具体内容无关的推理机制；但这些机制并不包含可泛化的抽象逻辑基元，并且容易受到预训练阶段获得的世界知识污染。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks whether language models perform content-independent syllogistic inference with a reusable circuit rather than surface associations. It further asks what operation the circuit implements, whether it is necessary and sufficient across syllogism schemes and model families, and how commonsense belief bias contaminates formal reasoning.

**Method.** Symbolic syllogisms provide clean prompts and counterfactual prompts in which term identities are swapped. Activation patching localizes answer-relevant states; path patching traces information between attention heads; logit-lens and embedding analysis identify transported terms. The proposed mechanism moves predicate information and suppresses the repeated middle term. Progressive mean ablation tests necessity by removing the circuit and sufficiency by retaining only it.

**Validation.** Synthetic arguments use letters, then number substitutions and paraphrased quantifiers/verbs test lexical robustness. Concrete arguments are split into belief-consistent and belief-inconsistent cases to expose world-knowledge interference. The circuit is evaluated across syllogistic schemes, model sizes, and architecture families; necessity/sufficiency is claimed for schemes where baseline accuracy is at least 60%, with compatible head activation patterns across models. Two distinct intervention methods, full-circuit retain/remove curves, and additional commonsense heads serve as converging checks.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** The studied models contain a transferable middle-term-suppression pathway sufficient and necessary for the formal schemes they solve well, but extra knowledge heads can bias it on natural-language content. Counterfactual path interventions and circuit ablation provide strong causal evidence for those tasks. The mechanism is not an abstract theorem prover: it excludes poorly solved schemes by design, corresponding heads need not be identical across architectures, belief contamination limits systematicity, and mean ablation may obscure alternative redundant circuits.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究语言模型是否借助可复用电路完成内容无关的三段论推理，而非利用表面关联；并考察电路执行什么操作、能否跨三段论式和模型家族保持必要与充分，以及常识信念偏置如何污染形式推理。

**方法。** 符号三段论构造干净提示与交换术语身份的反事实提示。激活修补定位答案相关状态，路径修补追踪注意力头间的信息，Logit Lens 与嵌入分析识别被搬运的术语。所提机制搬运谓词信息并抑制重复的中项；渐进均值消融通过移除电路测试必要性、只保留电路测试充分性。

**实验验证。** 合成论证先使用字母，再以数字替换和量词/动词改写测试词汇稳健性。具体论证分为信念一致与信念冲突两类，以暴露世界知识干扰。电路跨三段论式、模型规模和架构家族评测；对于基础准确率至少 60% 的论式，论文报告必要性与充分性，并观察到跨模型相容的头激活模式。两种不同干预、完整电路保留/移除曲线及附加常识头构成相互印证。

**结论与证据。** 所测模型包含可迁移的中项抑制路线，对模型本来做得较好的形式论式既必要又充分，但额外知识头会在自然语言内容上造成偏置。反事实路径干预和电路消融提供强任务局部因果证据。不过它不是抽象定理证明器：低准确率论式被条件性排除，跨架构对应头未必相同，信念污染限制系统性，均值消融也可能遮蔽冗余替代电路。

p_2025_li_taming_knowledge_conflicts.title: Taming Knowledge Conflicts in Language Models

abstract.en: Language Models (LMs) often encounter knowledge conflicts when parametric memory contradicts contextual knowledge. Previous works attribute this conflict to the interplay between"memory heads"and"context heads", attention heads assumed to promote either memory or context exclusively. In this study, we go beyond this fundamental assumption by uncovering a critical phenomenon we term the superposition of contextual information and parametric memory, where highly influential attention heads simultaneously contribute to both memory and context. Building upon this insight, we propose Just Run Twice (JuICE), a test-time attention intervention method that steers LMs toward either parametric beliefs or contextual knowledge without requiring fine-tuning. JuICE identifies a set of reliable attention heads and leverages a dual-run approach to mitigate the superposition effects. Extensive experiments across 11 datasets and 6 model architectures demonstrate that JuICE sets the new state-of-the-art performance and robust generalization, achieving significant and consistent improvement across different domains under various conflict types. Finally, we theoretically analyze knowledge conflict and the superposition of contextual information and parametric memory in attention heads, which further elucidates the effectiveness of JuICE in these settings. Our code is available at https://github.com/GaotangLi/JUICE.
abstract.zh: 当参数记忆与上下文知识相矛盾时，语言模型（LM）经常面临知识冲突。以往工作把这种冲突归因于“记忆头”与“上下文头”的相互作用，并假设两类注意力头分别只促进记忆或上下文。本文超越这一基本假设，揭示出一种关键现象，称为上下文信息与参数记忆的叠加：影响力很高的注意力头会同时为记忆和上下文作出贡献。基于这一认识，我们提出 Just Run Twice（JuICE），一种测试时注意力干预方法，无需微调即可引导语言模型偏向参数信念或上下文知识。JuICE 识别一组可靠的注意力头，并通过双次运行的方法缓解叠加效应。在 11 个数据集和 6 种模型架构上的广泛实验表明，JuICE 取得新的最先进性能和稳健的泛化能力，在不同领域和多种冲突类型下都带来显著且一致的提升。最后，我们从理论上分析知识冲突以及注意力头中上下文信息与参数记忆的叠加，进一步阐明 JuICE 在这些设置中的有效性。代码见 https://github.com/GaotangLi/JUICE。

ai_summary.en:
**Research Question.** The paper asks how language models arbitrate when a prompt's context conflicts with parametric memory, in both directions: preserve a trustworthy prior against misleading context, or follow accurate context when stored knowledge is stale. It challenges the assumption that separate “memory” and “context” heads exclusively support one source.

**Method.** Per-head scaling measures changes in parametric- and contextual-answer probability, revealing superposition: influential heads often support both sources. Just Run Twice (JuICE) selects reliable heads on a small calibration set, runs the model once with interventions favoring the desired source and again with complementary settings, then combines the outputs to cancel counteracting effects. A single-run variant tests why two passes matter, and a formal attention analysis models the conflict.

**Validation.** Six base models—Gemma-2B, Llama-2-7B, Llama-3-8B, Phi-2-2.7B, StableLM2-1.6B, and OLMo-7B—are tested on 11 datasets. Six parametric sets cover capitals, sports, authors, languages, headquarters, and founders under token substitution and coherent GPT-4-generated counterfactual paragraphs; contextual sets test correct supplied evidence. JuICE is compared with prompting and head-intervention baselines across conflict strengths, domains, model families, head-selection sizes, single versus dual runs, no-conflict inputs, and transfer to unseen domains.

**Conclusion & Evidence.** Context and memory are not cleanly separated by head; their superposition explains why one-pass scaling has unstable side effects, while dual-run intervention gives consistent state-of-the-art control in both directions. Broad datasets, six architectures, ablations, and theory provide strong comparative evidence. JuICE doubles inference, depends on calibration and answer probabilities, and head sensitivity does not constitute a complete causal account of how either knowledge source is represented.
ai_summary.zh:
**研究问题。** 该论文研究提示语境与参数记忆冲突时模型如何裁决，并同时覆盖两个方向：抵抗误导语境以保留可信先验，或在参数知识过时时遵循正确语境；同时质疑“记忆头”和“语境头”各自只支持单一来源的假设。

**方法。** 逐头缩放测量参数答案与语境答案概率变化，发现高影响头常同时支持两者，即语境信息与参数记忆叠加。Just Run Twice（JuICE）在小校准集选择可靠头，分别以偏向目标来源和互补设置运行两次，再组合输出以抵消相反效应。单次运行变体检验两遍计算的必要性，形式化注意力分析刻画冲突。

**实验验证。** 六个基础模型 Gemma-2B、Llama-2-7B、Llama-3-8B、Phi-2-2.7B、StableLM2-1.6B、OLMo-7B 在 11 个数据集上测试。六类参数知识覆盖首都、运动、作者、语言、总部和创始人，并包括词元替换及 GPT-4 生成的连贯反事实段落；语境数据测试正确外部证据。JuICE 与提示及头干预基线比较，扫描冲突强度、领域、模型家族、头数量、单/双运行、无冲突输入及未见领域迁移。

**结论与证据。** 语境与记忆并未按注意力头清晰分离；叠加解释单次缩放为何副作用不稳，而双运行在两个控制方向上均取得稳定领先。广泛数据、六种架构、消融和理论提供强比较证据。但 JuICE 将推理成本加倍，依赖校准与候选答案概率，头敏感性也不等于两类知识表示的完整因果机制。
