edge_evidence_levels.analyst-inference: The connection is a synthesis proposed for this graph and is not attributed to the papers.

description.en: Describes the paper’s primary contribution to interpretability research. It captures the paper’s central scholarly role rather than every activity performed in the paper.
description.zh: 这篇论文对可解释性研究的主要贡献是什么。它概括论文最核心的学术角色，而不是罗列论文做过的所有工作。

description.en: Introduces or substantially improves a reusable technique, tool, workflow, or algorithm.
description.zh: 提出或显著改进一种可以复用的技术、工具、流程或算法。

description.en: Reports a substantive finding about how a model represents, computes, learns, or behaves.
description.zh: 通过实验发现模型如何表征、计算、学习或产生行为。

description.en: Develops a mathematical, conceptual, or formal account of a mechanism or interpretability method.
description.zh: 对模型机制或可解释性方法给出数学、概念或形式化解释。

description.en: Tests the validity, reliability, faithfulness, robustness, or usefulness of interpretability methods.
description.zh: 检验可解释性方法的有效性、可靠性、忠实性、稳健性或实用价值。

description.en: Applies interpretability or model-control techniques to a practical behavioral, safety, or scientific objective.
description.zh: 把可解释性或模型控制技术用于具体的行为、安全或科学问题。

description.en: Describes the main type of evidence supporting the paper’s central mechanistic claim. It is not a general quality score: formal and audit evidence are distinct from the empirical causal ladder.
description.zh: 论文使用哪一种主要证据来支持其核心机制主张。它不是简单的论文质量分数；formal 和 audit 与经验因果证据属于不同类型，不能机械地理解为“最高”或“最低”。

note.en: This field records the primary evidence supporting the paper’s central claim; a paper may also contain other forms of evidence.
note.zh: 该字段记录论文核心主张所依赖的主要证据类型，不代表论文只使用了这一种证据。

description.en: Identifies an internal pattern, feature, direction, component, or correlation without establishing its causal role.
description.zh: 观察到内部模式、特征、方向、组件或相关性，但尚未证明其因果作用。

description.en: Shows that information can be recovered from an internal state using a probe, lens, concept alignment, or related readout.
description.zh: 说明某种信息可以通过探针、lens、概念对齐等方法从内部状态中读出，但可读出不等于模型实际使用了它。

description.en: Estimates how a prediction or metric responds locally to a component using gradients, attribution, or approximated effects.
description.zh: 通过梯度、归因或近似效应衡量输出对某个组件的局部敏感程度，但通常不等同于直接干预。

description.en: Directly intervenes on an activation, feature, component, or parameter and observes a behavioral change or restoration.
description.zh: 直接修改激活、特征、组件或参数，并观察行为改变或恢复，从而支持局部因果作用。

description.en: Establishes how multiple components, paths, or edges jointly form a necessary, sufficient, or faithful mechanism.
description.zh: 说明多个组件、路径或边如何共同构成具有必要性、充分性或忠实性的机制。

description.en: Supports a claim through mathematical derivation, proof, formal specification, or solver-checkable verification.
description.zh: 通过数学推导、证明、形式规范或可由求解器检查的验证来支持结论。

description.en: Evaluates whether an interpretability method is reliable, robust, faithful, or useful under controlled tests.
description.zh: 通过受控实验评估一种可解释性方法是否可靠、稳健、忠实或有用；它主要评价方法，而不是直接证明模型机制。

description.en: Identifies the primary data modality in which the paper’s central claim is established. It reflects the main experimental setting rather than every dataset mentioned.
description.zh: 论文核心结论主要在哪一种数据模态上建立。以支撑核心结论的主要实验对象为准，而不是罗列论文使用过的全部数据集。

description.en: The central evidence comes from text, tokens, linguistic tasks, or language models.
description.zh: 核心证据来自文本、token、语言任务或语言模型。

description.en: The central evidence comes from images, visual representations, or vision models.
description.zh: 核心证据来自图像、视觉表征或视觉模型。

description.en: The central claim concerns interactions between visual and linguistic representations or multimodal models.
description.zh: 核心结论涉及视觉与语言表征之间的交互，或直接研究视觉—语言多模态模型。

description.en: The central evidence comes from proteins, DNA, RNA, or other biological sequences.
description.zh: 核心证据来自蛋白质、DNA、RNA 或其他生物序列。当前 corpus 中暂时没有此类论文。

description.en: The central claim is formulated independently of a particular data modality or model architecture.
description.zh: 核心结论不依赖某一种数据模态或模型架构，常见于一般理论、形式化框架和通用解释方法。

description.en: The technique that best represents the paper’s central methodological contribution or main analytical operation. Each paper has exactly one.
description.zh: 最能代表论文核心方法贡献或主要分析操作的技术。每篇论文恰好有一个。

description.en: Other techniques materially used in the paper’s main analysis or validation pipeline. Methods mentioned only as background, ordinary baselines, or incidental experiments are excluded.
description.zh: 论文主要分析或验证流程中实质使用的其他技术，不包括仅在相关工作、普通 baseline 或附带实验中出现的方法。
